en.objective:
The half-day workshop shall help participants, preferably those with experience using English to teach the Personal, Social and Humanities (PSHE) Key Learning Areas (KLAs) subjects concerned, achieve the following objectives:
(a) Refreshing strategies and pedagogy for enhancing classroom communication by using subject-specific language in English;
(b) Disseminating good practices in teaching the PSHE KLAs using English as the medium of instruction (EMI) and exchanging ideas through group discussions during the Workshop; and
(c) Designing and developing classroom learning and teaching tasks / instructional and assessment materials / e-learning tasks to support students’ learning of both the subject content / skills and the subject language through hands-on practices in the Workshop.
en.background: The half-day workshop will introduce participants the genres of PSHE subjects, share examples of good practice, etc. The half-day workshop will be based on sound educational theories and principles, highly practical teaching strategies and skills.

en.objective:
(1) To develop the capacity of school middle leaders and vice-principals in leading teachers to realise professional conduct and values
(2) To enhance teachers' understanding of the Constitution, Basic Law and National Security Education
(3) To deepen teachers' understanding of education policies
en.description: This 12-hour seminar is one of the core training programmes offered by the EDB for teachers aspiring for promotion. The content of this seminar covers teachers’ professional conduct and values, the Constitution, Basic Law, National Security Education and local education policies. After successful completion of the course, training hours will be recorded under the "Core Part" of the Training Requirements for Promotion. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDBC6/2020 and EDBC29/2024.
en.background:
According to EDBC6/2020, EDBC29/2024 and EDBIC1/2020, teachers in aided and government schools are required to meet the training requirements for promotion to SGM, PGM, PSM, SPSM, EO & SEO.
This programme is one of the core programmes under the training requirements for promotion.
For promotion to SGM, PSM and EO, teachers must also complete the training programme on "Professional Vision and Growth of School Leaders" and "Reflection and Practice of Professional Leadership".
For promotion to PGM, SPSM and SEO, teachers must also complete the training programme on "School Administration and Management".

zh.objective:
(一) 促進學校中高層人員帶領團隊實踐專業操守和價值觀
(二) 加深教師對《憲法》、《基本法》及國家安全教育的理解
(三) 深化教師對教育政策的理解
zh.description: 本12小時講座是教育局為擬晉升教師提供的核心培訓課程之一。講座內容涵蓋教師專業操守和價值觀、《憲法》、《基本法》、國家安全教育及本地教育政策。參加者成功完成活動後，培訓時數將計算在晉升培訓要求的「核心部分」內。有關培訓要求的詳情請參閱教育局通告第6/2020號及第29/2024號。
zh.background:
根據教育局通告第6/2020號、第29/2024號和教育局內部通告第1/2020號，於資助和官立學校任教的教師，必須在晉升前完成晉升培訓要求。
本課程為晉升培訓要求的核心課程之一。
擬晉升至 SGM、PSM和EO的教師，除本課程外，亦須完成「學校領導的視野及成長」和「領導能力的反思和實踐」兩項課程。
至於擬晉升至 PGM、SPSM和SEO的教師則須完成「學校行政及管理」課程。

en.objective: To support schools in driving digital education forward effectively, and to enhance the competence of school leaders and middle management in planning and executing school-based AI education.
en.description:
• Introduce the development directions and strategies of digital education in Hong Kong
• Use examples to help schools understand how to integrate digital education into the “Planning–Implementation–Evaluation” self-evaluation cycle for promoting the ongoing development and improvement of digital education
• Explore how curriculum leaders can promote the AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, guiding students to “Learn AI well”, “Use AI effectively” and “Use AI responsibly”
• Share good examples of school planning, such as School Development Plans and Annual School Plans
en.background: The EDB has recently announced the Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools (Blueprint), which comprehensively and systematically advances the digital transformation of education and contributes to the innovation and technology development of our country and society. Following the announcement of the Blueprint, the EDB will immediately launch training programmes. Schools will be provided with tiered, diversified professional development activities on digital education including basic and advanced levels of "AI Literacy" training to enhance teachers'AI literacy; "AI+ Subjects" training to equip teachers with professional pedagogical capabilities across various subjects and cross-disciplinary areas; and "AI Leadership" training to strengthen school leaders'competence to lead and strategically plan technology-empowered education.

zh.description:
• 介紹香港數字教育的發展方向與策略
• 運用例子幫助學校了解如何將數字教育融入「策劃—推行—評估」的自評循環，促進數字教育持續推展及優化

en.objective:
The workshop offers an overview of the theory of inclusive education within the Hong Kong setting in Key Stage 1 and Key Stage 2. It focuses on diversity in the mainstream classroom, the uniqueness of individual students and how they learn. A range of innovative support strategies will be explored to support and engage students with special educational needs (SEN) in the mainstream English Language lessons. This online workshop provides opportunities for teachers to gain an understanding of: inclusive education in Hong Kong settings; a class profile as a document and a tool to inform learning and teaching; the 3-tier Response to Intervention (RTI) framework to cater for learner diversity and how to use it when providing English Language learning experiences; identifying 4 possible types of SEN, i.e. AD/HD, SpLD (Dyslexia), ASD and SEBD in mainstream classrooms.
practical strategies to support the learning and teaching of students with SEN.
Remarks
This online workshop is designed for English Language teachers who want to enhance their knowledge and skills in teaching students with SEN in the mainstream classroom. This workshop can be done individually or by in groups.

en.objective:
This workshop builds on the prior workshop, "Catering for Students with SEN", which examined teaching students with special educational needs (SEN) in the mainstream English classroom. This workshop explores four more SEN categories: Intellectual Disability (ID), Physical Disability (PD), Sensory Impairment — Visual Impairment (VI) and Hearing Impairment (HI), and Gifted. For each SEN type, tools, resources and teaching strategies are examined, which identify, analyse and address the needs of these students.
In this workshop, teachers will:
gain an understanding of tools used to analyse and support the learning of students with SEN;
identify another four types of SEN in mainstream English classrooms: students with Intellectual Disability (ID), Physical Disability (PD), Sensory Impairment: Visual impairment (VI) and Hearing Impairment (HI), and Gifted Students; and
choose practical strategies to support the learning and teaching of these four types of SEN.
Remarks:
For English teachers new to SEN teaching, please consider completing the Catering for Students with SEN (Part 1).

This workshop builds on the prior workshop, "Catering for Students with SEN", which examined teaching students with special educational needs (SEN) in the mainstream English classroom. This workshop explores four more SEN categories: Intellectual Disability (ID), Physical Disability (PD), Sensory Impairment — Visual Impairment (VI) and Hearing Impairment (HI), and Gifted. For each SEN type, tools, resources and teaching strategies are examined, which identify, analyse and address the needs of these students.
In this workshop, teachers will:
gain an understanding of tools used to analyse and support the learning of students with SEN;
identify another four types of SEN in mainstream English classrooms: students with Intellectual Disability (ID), Physical Disability (PD), Sensory Impairment: Visual impairment (VI) and Hearing Impairment (HI), and Gifted Students; and
choose practical strategies to support the learning and teaching of these four types of SEN.
Remarks:
For English teachers new to SEN teaching, please consider completing the Catering for Students with SEN (Part 1).

en.objective:
The workshop offers an overview for creating an English-rich environment, both oral and visual for KS1 and KS2.
On completion of the online course, teachers will:
analyse what makes an English-rich environment that is effective for language learning;
explore how English-rich includes both aural (listening) and visual (print) strategies and resources;
explore the benefits of strategically planning for and using a language-rich environment to scaffold learning; and
examine resources and examples of good practice.
Remarks
This workshop is designed for all English teachers and is a required workshop for teachers in KIP and PLP-R/W schools.
Required workshops before this one are Introduction to PLP-R/W, and/or Introduction to KIP.

events.summaryZh: 教育局教師專業發展活動

events.format: Online Course
events.formatZh: Online Course

en.objective:
Through this online course, teachers will navigate the structure and organisation of the Learning Progression Framework (LPF). Teachers will expand knowledge on the ways to use the LPF as a tool for planning the school-based curriculum. Strategies to move students from one Attainment Milestone (ATM) to the next along the LPF learning continuum will be explored.
This online workshop provides opportunities for teachers to:
explore the structure and organisation of the LPF for English Language;
understand how to use the LPF as a tool for planning school-based English Language curriculum; and
be given suggestions on how to incorporate the LPF in designing activities to move students along the learning continuum of the four language skills.

en.objective:
This workshop offers a pedagogical framework on effective strategies of developing students’ listening and speaking skills that supports the primary schools in Hong Kong classrooms. identify the types and context of listening and speaking for the language activities conducted in English lessons that develop students’ listening and speaking skills; and
be introduced to a variety of resources (including e-learning tools) that develop students’ listening and speaking skills.

en.objective:
BLURB
This workshop explains the basic ideas of differentiated instruction. It focuses on using questions as a teaching strategy to help meet the different needs of students, based on Bloom’s Taxonomy. Although the workshop is designed for English teachers and uses examples from English Language Learning (ELL), the ideas and strategies can be applied in cross-curricular settings for KS1 and KS2.
In this course teachers will:
reflect on your beliefs, knowledge and practices about your students' diversity;
explore research and theories on "differentiated instruction," "higher order thinking," and "questioning";
examine examples of how to use questions in the classroom;and
apply new differentiation and cognition knowledge to plan a real learning and teaching.

en.objective:
How do you teach writing in an online environment to primary students learning English as a second language? This workshop offers you a series of core practical ideas to prepare you to teach writing online. It also provides curated resources that you can apply to your own contexts. In short, this workshop serves as a guide to help you take instructional strategies that have worked in your face-to-face learning and teaching and migrate them to the online environment.
This online workshop provides opportunities for teachers to:
explore best practices, educational technology tools, strategies for teaching writing online and blended learning experiences;
engage with educational technology tools, online teaching strategies and practical ideas for teaching writing; and
apply their understanding by completing the comparative table of face-to-face Vs virtual distance setting.

This online workshop provides opportunities for teachers to gain an understanding of:

en.objective: This online course aims to deepen newly-joined teachers' understanding of the "T-standard+" - Professional Standards for Teachers of Hong Kong and their professional roles, professional conduct and values.
en.description:
This online course explains the three professional roles stated in the "T-standard+" through scenario analysis, interactive games and videos. The course content is divided into the following five chapters:
1. Prologue
2. Caring Cultivators
3. Inspirational Co-constructors
4. Committed Role Models
5. Aspiration for self-advancement through self-reflection
To obtain CPD hours, participants are required to complete the entire course within the specified period. CPD hours will be recorded under the “Core Training” of newly-joined teachers.
en.background:
Starting from the 2020/21 school year, full-time teachers appointed to teach in publicly-funded schools, including government schools, aided schools, caput schools and Direct Subsidy Scheme (DSS) schools for the first time, are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs. This course is part of the Core Training (Category 1), accounting for 3 CPD hours.
For details of the training requirements, please refer to EDB Circular No.6/2020 and EDB Circular No.29/2024 .

zh.objective: 本網上課程旨在加深新入職教師對 「T-標準+」-「香港教師專業標準參照」 的理解，掌握其專業角色及專業操守和價值觀。
zh.description:
本網上課程通過情境分析、互動遊戲及短片等，讓教師掌握「T-標準+」所描述香港教師的三個專業角色。課程內容分以下五章：
1. 序章
2. 關愛學生的育才者
3. 啟發學生的共建者
4. 敬業樂群的典範
5. 反思求進以達自我完善的精神
參加者須於指定的日期內 完成整個課程 ，方可獲得培訓時數。有關時數將計算在新入職教師「核心培訓」部分內。
zh.background:
由2020/21學年起，首次於公帑資助學校，包括官立學校、資助學校、按位津貼學校及直接資助計劃（直資）學校任教的全職教師，必須於首三年內完成30小時的核心培訓，以及按個人專業發展需要參與不少於60小時的選修培訓。本課程屬核心培訓課程(範疇一)，佔3小時培訓時數。
培訓要求的詳情請參閱 教育局通告第6/2020號 及 教育局通告第29/2024號 。

en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) vigorously promotes digital education in primary and secondary schools through a diverse range of strategies to nurture students’ digital literacy and spirit of humanistic care. We continuously consolidate students’ learning and application of artificial intelligence through activities in and beyond the classroom, while providing ample opportunities for them to proficiently deploy digital technology tools including artificial intelligence and cultivate positive values and attitude. Working hand in hand with innovation and technology enterprises, non-governmental organisations and other government departments, the EDB organises a wide array of interesting learning activities centred on artificial intelligence education. These initiatives enrich students’ learning experiences in and beyond the classroom, strengthen their learning in innovation and digital technology, and embody the pursuit of technology for good.

zh.objective: 本課程旨在啟動「教育局 x 騰訊 WeTech Academy "AI for ALL"」 計劃，並介紹與人工智能相關的學生活動，即「微信小程序全球創新挑戰賽（香港區域賽）」2026/27 ，以及騰訊雲&教育城「教師AI素養及應用培訓聯合課程」資料。
zh.description:
本課程的詳情概述如下：
(1) 嘉賓致辭及分享；
(2) 教育局 x 騰訊 WeTech Academy「AI for All」啟動禮，項目包括：「微信小程序全球創新挑戰賽（香港區域賽）」2026/27 及 騰訊雲&教育城「教師AI素養及應用培訓聯合課程」；
(3) 騰訊雲&教育城「教師AI素養及應用培訓聯合課程」正式推出及培訓課程試用；
(4) 「微信小程序全球創新挑戰賽（香港區域賽）」2026/27簡介；
(5) 微信小程序挑戰賽2025/26優勝者分享；以及
(6) 問與答環節。
zh.background: 教育局於中小學大力推動數字教育，透過多元策略，提升學生的數字素養與人文關懷精神。我們持續透過課堂內外的活動，加強學生學習和應用人工智能，亦提供更多機會讓他們善用人工智能等數字科技工具，培養正確價值觀和態度。教育局持續聯同創科企業、非政府機構及其他政府部門攜手並肩，舉辦富趣味的人工智能教育相關的學習活動，豐富學生在課堂內外的學習經歴，從而強化創新及數字科技的學習，實踐科技向善。

en.background:
The Analytical Chemistry Challenge for Secondary Students (2025/26) was jointly organised by the Science Education Section of the Education Bureau and the Department of Chemistry, Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU). The Challenge aimed to promote students' engagement and interest in chemistry through practical activities and problem-solving involving real-life applications.
The Challenge was structured in three phases. It began with a Preliminary Heat, conducted in science laboratories of participating schools from February to April 2026, where teams of 2-3 students performed an assigned analytical chemistry experiment. The best-performing team from each school then advanced to the Shortlisting Assessment. Based on the results of this assessment, the top 15 teams were shortlisted for the Final Competition, held at the HKBU in June 2026, where they designed and conducted experiments to solve a complex analytical problem.
For details and the results of the Challenge, please visit:
https://www.edb.gov.hk/en/curriculum-development/kla/science-edu/anchem-challenge.html .

1. 就透過分析學生於「中學生分析化學挑戰賽（2025/26）」初賽實驗任務及甄選評估中的表現所識別的化學錯誤概念，討論相關教學策略；
2. 加強教師設計優質化學實驗活動及高階思維問題的能力，以培養學生的科學探究技能；以及

zh.description: 請參閱附件。
zh.background:
「中學生分析化學挑戰賽（2025/26）」由教育局科學教育組與香港浸會大學化學系聯合舉辦。挑戰賽旨在透過化學實驗及解決與日常生活相關的問題，提升學生對化學的投入及興趣。
挑戰賽分為三個階段。第一階段為初賽，於2026年2月至4月在參與學校的科學實驗室進行，學生以2至3人一組，進行指定的分析化學實驗。每所學校表現最佳的隊伍其後可晉級至甄選評估。根據評估結果，表現最佳的15支隊伍獲選進入於2026年6月在香港浸會大學進行的總決賽，參賽隊伍須於總決賽中設計並進行實驗，以解決複雜的分析化學問題。有關挑戰賽詳情及結果，請瀏覽：
https://www.edb.gov.hk/tc/curriculum-development/kla/science-edu/anchem-challenge.html 。

en.objective:
This cluster meeting is for teachers who are interested in integrating aspects of the NET Section competitions (i.e. Filmit: A Student Film Competition, Speak Up – Act Out Drama Competition, Time to Talk Public Speaking Competition, Once Upon A Book Storytelling Competition) into the English language programme at their schools.
In this cluster meeting, participants will:
observe student performances from the NET Section competitions and explore how the skills can be developed in the English language classroom;
gain insights from students and their supporting teachers about their learning journeys preparing for the NET Section competitions; and
explore ways of incorporating and adapting aspects of the NET Section competitions into the school English language programme.
Remarks
Cluster Meetings provide a platform for:
sharing effective English Language learning and teaching strategies;
enhancing collaboration between NETs and other English Panel Members;
supporting the implementation of the English language curriculum in schools; and
promoting communities of learning for ongoing professional development and support.

Upon the completion of the 3-hour seminar, participating SENCOs will be able to:
1. Precisely analyse the assessment report of students with SEN (e.g., dyslexia), understand the students’ cognitive profiles, learning difficulties and personal needs, hence formulate evidence-based support strategies.

1. 準確剖析有特殊教育需要的學生（如：讀寫障礙）的評估報告，掌握學生的認知特質、學習困難與個人需要，以此作為制定支援策略的實證基礎。

是次培訓活動旨在透過教育局代表的分享，介紹2026/27新學年推出的全港中國歷史科學生活動，及全新的學與教資源。與此同時，是次培訓亦邀請前線中國歷史科教師，分享如何以新近推出的教育局《趣看中史@文物》動畫設計初中中國歷史課堂活動及實踐策略。
透過是次活動，科組教師能以善用教育局資源，規劃及推動學生參與不同的中國歷史活動，開闊學生的學習視野及經歷。教師亦能認識及掌握教育局的教學資源，以能有效應用於課堂，豐富課堂學與教策略。
en.background: 初中中國歷史科是全港中學的獨立必修學科，而強化中國歷史及中華文化教育亦是中學教育的重點項目之一。為鼓勵教師運用多元化的學與教策略、營建良好的學習氛圍，以提升學生學習中國歷史的興趣，教育局個人、社會及人文教育組積極推展全港性的學生活動，開發不同類型的教學資源，並聯同前線中國歷史科教師分享教學實踐經驗，教學策略，以優化中國歷史教育。

en.objective:
The Reading Hub is for secondary English teachers interested in developing students’ reading skills through student-centred reading lessons that combine explicit instruction with supported practice.
Teachers who attend this event will:
consider how to motivate students to develop a love for reading;
explore the theoretical models of reading acquisition and consider the implications for effective reading instruction at the secondary level;
practise identifying target words (Tier 2 vocabulary) from instructional texts and creating student-friendly explanations; and
learn about a range of vocabulary building activities that encourage students to interact with target words before, during and after reading.
Remarks:
Learning Hubs are communities of practice that promote action learning and a culture of collaboration among secondary English teachers. Learning Hub Meetings provide a platform for:
exploring a range of innovative learning and teaching practices;
promoting effective instructional strategies in support of the latest English Language Education KLA curricular initiatives; and
encouraging relevant, adaptive and future-focused pedagogical practices.
There are three modes of participation in Learning Hubs: professional networking, sharing of learning and teaching practices and resources, and practising by implementing learning and teaching strategies in the school context.
An email will be sent to successful applicants with a link to the online platform where they can complete the pre-tasks in Part A before attending the meeting (Part B).
Both parts of the Reading Hub meeting must be completed in the given time to acquire the full 5 CPD hours.
There will be an optional post-task after the Reading Hub meeting and participants can earn up to 2 additional (self-input) CPD hours for completing the task.
This course is open to teachers of private schools in Hong Kong who do not have e-Services accounts and teachers teaching Hong Kong curriculum in schools in the GBA Mainland cities*. Teachers of these schools wishing to apply for the course should contact Ms Alice LEUNG at 3549 8315/ rnctnet@edb.gov.hk.
*The schools should meet the following criteria:
A. The schools have joined the “Scheme of Classes for Hong Kong Students” in Shenzhen; or
B. The schools have submitted their curriculum documents to the Education Bureau of Hong Kong, and been recognised to be offering subject curricula which are generally in line with the curriculum requirements of the respective subjects in Hong Ko

en.objective: This briefing session aims to assist schools in understanding the enhancement measures for the curriculum structure for senior secondary Science and Mathematics subjects. In addition to detailing the enhancement measures, the session will feature school experience-sharing on strengthening the learning atmosphere for senior secondary Science and Mathematics subjects, as well as on promoting students’ selection of these subjects, so as to provide schools with more references and support them to formulate specific school-based plans to implement the enhancement measures.
en.background: In response to the Chief Executive's 2025 Policy Address and the Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools, which called for a review of the curriculum structure for implementing senior secondary Science and Mathematics subjects, the Education Bureau (EDB) set up an related Ad Hoc Committee under the Standing Committee on STEAM Education of the Curriculum Development Council to conduct the review and formulate recommendations for the enhancement measures. The enhancement measures, announced via an EDB Circular in August 2026, include renewing the curriculum and assessment frameworks of senior secondary Science subjects and the Extended Part of Mathematics, optimising the subject combinations for taking senior secondary Science and Mathematics subjects and related support, and enhancing schools’ planning to nurture innovative and technology talents within and beyond the classroom.

zh.objective: 本簡介會旨在協助學校了解高中數理科目課程設置的優化措施。除詳細介紹優化措施外，簡介會亦會安排學校分享經驗，探討如何加強高中數理科的學習氛圍，以及如何促進學生修讀數理科目，從而為學校提供更多參考，並幫助學校擬定具體校本方案，以落實優化措施。
zh.description:
1. 介紹「優化高中數理科目課程設置」的背景及優化措施；
2. 學校分享促進學生於高中階段修讀數理科目的經驗；
3. 答問環節。
zh.background: 為回應《行政長官2025年施政報告》及《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》提出檢視高中數理科目的課程設置，教育局已於課程發展議會STEAM教育常務委員會下，成立了相關的專責委員會進行檢視工作及提出優化措施的建議。教育局已於2026年8月透過通告公布有關優化措施，當中包括：更新高中科學科及數學科延伸部分的課程及評核大綱、優化學校高中數理科目的選科組合安排及相關支援配套，以及學校加強課堂內外的規劃，以培育創科人才。

en.objective: To help schools gain a deeper understanding of how to integrate digital education into the Planning-Implementation-Evaluation (P-I-E) cycle, thereby promoting the ongoing development and improvement of digital education.
en.description: This programme focuses on “AI Leadership” training and aims to support schools in aligning with the “P-I-E” SSE cycle to incorporate digital education into their School Development Plans and/or Annual School Plans.
en.background: The EDB has recently announced the Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools (Blueprint), which comprehensively and systematically advances the digital transformation of education and contributes to the innovation and technology development of our country and society. Following the announcement of the Blueprint, the EDB will immediately launch training programmes. Schools will be provided with tiered, diversified professional development activities on digital education, including basic and advanced levels of “AI Literacy” training to enhance teachers’ AI literacy; “AI + Subjects” training to equip teachers with professional pedagogical capabilities across various subjects and cross-disciplinary areas; and “AI Leadership” training to strengthen school leaders’ competence to lead and strategically plan technology-empowered education.

zh.objective: 幫助學校進深理解如何將數字教育融入「策劃—推行—評估」的自評循環，促進數字教育持續推展及優化。
zh.description: 本課程屬「人工智能領導」培訓，旨在就數字教育的規劃，支援學校配合「策劃─推行─評估」自評循環，將數字教育納入學校發展及／或周年計劃。
zh.background:
教育局於日前公布《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》（《藍圖》），全面系統地推進教育數字轉型，為國家和社會的創科發展貢獻力量。緊接《藍圖》的公布，教育局隨即啓動培訓課程，為學校提供分層式、多元化的數字教育專業發展活動，包括：基礎和進深版的「人工智能素養」培訓，提升教師的人工智能素養；「人工智能+科目」培訓，裝備教師於不同學科和跨學科的教學專業能力；以及
「人工智能領導」培訓，強化學校領導推動科技賦能教育的領導和策劃能力。

en.objective: 本研討會旨在增進前線中小學教師對「抗日戰爭」的全面認識及相關教學的交流。
en.description: 請參閱附件。
en.background: 發生於1930年代至1940年代的「抗日戰爭」是中國現代史的重要史事。面對日本的侵略，國民發揮堅忍不拔的精神，勇敢抗敵，最終迎來日本戰敗投降，國家抗戰勝利的一天。 2025年為抗戰勝利80周年，教育局課程發展處個人、社會及人文教育組與香港城市大學中文及歷史學系合辦「紀念抗戰勝利八十周年學術研討會」，邀請不同的歷史學者及前線歷史教育工作者分享專業知識及教學資源，促進對歷史教學的彼此交流，以提升學與教的效能。 此次為VLE重辦課程。

en.objective: To help schools gain a deeper understanding of how to integrate digital education into the Planning-Implementation-Evaluation (P-I-E) cycle, thereby promoting the ongoing development and improvement of digital education.
en.description: This programme focuses on “AI Leadership” training and aims to support schools in aligning with the “P-I-E” SSE cycle to incorporate digital education into their School Development Plans and/or Annual School Plans.
en.background: The EDB has recently announced the Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools (Blueprint), which comprehensively and systematically advances the digital transformation of education and contributes to the innovation and technology development of our country and society. Following the announcement of the Blueprint, the EDB will immediately launch training programmes. Schools will be provided with tiered, diversified professional development activities on digital education, including basic and advanced levels of “AI Literacy” training to enhance teachers’ AI literacy; “AI + Subjects” training to equip teachers with professional pedagogical capabilities across various subjects and cross-disciplinary areas; and “AI Leadership” training to strengthen school leaders’ competence to lead and strategically plan technology-empowered education.

zh.objective: 幫助學校進深理解如何將數字教育融入「策劃—推行—評估」的自評循環，促進數字教育持續推展及優化。
zh.description: 本課程屬「人工智能領導」培訓，旨在就數字教育的規劃，支援學校配合「策劃─推行─評估」自評循環，將數字教育納入學校發展及／或周年計劃。
zh.background:
教育局於日前公布《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》（《藍圖》），全面系統地推進教育數字轉型，為國家和社會的創科發展貢獻力量。緊接《藍圖》的公布，教育局隨即啓動培訓課程，為學校提供分層式、多元化的數字教育專業發展活動，包括：基礎和進深版的「人工智能素養」培訓，提升教師的人工智能素養；「人工智能+科目」培訓，裝備教師於不同學科和跨學科的教學專業能力；以及
「人工智能領導」培訓，強化學校領導推動科技賦能教育的領導和策劃能力。

en.objective: This online course aims to deepen newly-joined teachers' understanding of the "T-standard+" - Professional Standards for Teachers of Hong Kong and their professional roles, professional conduct and values.
en.description:
This online course explains the three professional roles stated in the "T-standard+" through scenario analysis, interactive games and videos. The course content is divided into the following five chapters:
1. Prologue
2. Caring Cultivators
3. Inspirational Co-constructors
4. Committed Role Models
5. Aspiration for self-advancement through self-reflection
To obtain CPD hours, participants are required to complete the entire course within the specified period. CPD hours will be recorded under the “Core Training” of newly-joined teachers.
en.background:
Starting from the 2020/21 school year, full-time teachers appointed to teach in publicly-funded schools, including government schools, aided schools, caput schools and Direct Subsidy Scheme (DSS) schools for the first time, are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs. This course is part of the Core Training (Category 1), accounting for 3 CPD hours.
For details of the training requirements, please refer to EDB Circular No.6/2020 and EDB Circular No.29/2024 .

zh.objective: 本網上課程旨在加深新入職教師對 「T-標準+」-「香港教師專業標準參照」 的理解，掌握其專業角色及專業操守和價值觀。
zh.description:
本網上課程通過情境分析、互動遊戲及短片等，讓教師掌握「T-標準+」所描述香港教師的三個專業角色。課程內容分以下五章：
1. 序章
2. 關愛學生的育才者
3. 啟發學生的共建者
4. 敬業樂群的典範
5. 反思求進以達自我完善的精神
參加者須於指定的日期內 完成整個課程 ，方可獲得培訓時數。有關時數將計算在新入職教師「核心培訓」部分內。
zh.background:
由2020/21學年起，首次於公帑資助學校，包括官立學校、資助學校、按位津貼學校及直接資助計劃（直資）學校任教的全職教師，必須於首三年內完成30小時的核心培訓，以及按個人專業發展需要參與不少於60小時的選修培訓。本課程屬核心培訓課程(範疇一)，佔3小時培訓時數。
培訓要求的詳情請參閱 教育局通告第6/2020號 及 教育局通告第29/2024號 。

After successful completion of the course, training hours will be recorded under the "Core Part" of the Training Requirements for Promotion. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDB Circular No. 6/2020 and Circular No. 29/2024.
Remarks: There are four batches of application in the 2026/27 s.y. for the captioned course. The second batch of application will start in Dec 2026. For details, please refer to the training calendar in due course.
en.background:
According to EDBC6/2020, EDBC29/2024 and EDBIC1/2020, teachers in aided and government schools are required to meet the training requirements for promotion.
This programme is one of the core training programmes under the training requirements for promotion.
For promotion to SGM, PSM and EO, teachers must also complete the programmes on "Professional Conduct, Values and Education Policies" and "Reflection and Practice of Professional Leadership".

en.objective:
本課程旨在讓小學教師掌握新興技術在中國語文課程中的教學法知識和實踐，並增強教師在小學中國語文教學中運用新興技術的能力和信心。
完成本課程後，學員將在以下幾個方面得到提升：
1. 展現對在學校教育動態學習和教學範式中實現以學習者為中心的學習理論的理解；
2. 增進對人工智能 、擴增實境、虛擬實境和元宇宙等新興技術元素的教學整合原則和策略的應用，以促進有效學習；
3. 運用有關教學原則和策略知識及技能，將新興技術元素融入香港中國語文教育的特定學科教學設計中；
4. 增強資訊素養技能，以在新興技術的背景下有效評估和合乎道德地使用數位資源和訊息；和
5. 增強在小學中國語文課程中實現並持續應用新興技術的能力和信心。

en.objective:
修畢本課程後，學員應能：
1. 透過認識學校內外不同的領導模式，擴闊視野，並提升應對教育環境轉變和挑戰的能力；
2. 根據自己的個性和特質，識別個人的領導風格，並提升個人的領導能力；
3. 發展一套穩固有效的模式，以處理日常事務，包括：編制學校計劃，推展可持續發展項目，進行有效的學校評估，規劃具針對性的人力資源方案，並與社區保持良好的夥伴關係等；及
4. 建立小學副校長互助互勉的支援網絡，透過彼此分享和反思小學教育的專業發展、新措施和關注事項而獲益。

1. To inform teachers of the details of the Hong Kong Budding Scientists Award 2026/27.
2. To enhance teachers' understanding and deployment of inquiry-based learning activities to foster higher-order thinking skills of scientifically gifted/ more able students.
en.description:
1. To inform teachers of the details of the Hong Kong Budding Scientists Award 2026/27.
2. To explore how to deploy inquiry-based learning to enhance the higher-order thinking skills and creativity of gifted/ more able students through sharing of practical teaching ideas.
3. To share school-based experience.
en.background: Gifted/more able students generally possess distinct learning traits that differ from those of their peers. To cater for their learning needs, the Hong Kong Budding Scientists Award (BSA) has developed into an annual territory-wide competitions since its first launch in 2005. Participating students are required to investigate a science-related topic, then share their learning outcomes with adjudicators and fellow contestants. In guiding students, teachers may adopt inquiry-based learning activities to foster their creativity and higher-order thinking skills. The BSA 2026/27 has been refined to enhance its alignment with the curriculum, broaden student participation and further stimulate interest in STEAM-related areas.

zh.objective:
1. 介紹香港科學青苗獎 2026/27 的詳情。
2. 提升教師對探究式學習活動的理解與運用，以培養具科學資優/ 高能力學生的高層次思維技能。
zh.description:
1.介紹香港科學青苗獎 2026/27 的詳情。
2. 透過分享教學實踐示例，探討如何運用探究式學習提升資優／高能力學生的高層次思維技巧和創造力。
3. 校本經驗分享。
zh.background: 資優／高能力學生一般具備與同儕不同的學習特質，為了照顧這些學生的學習需要，自2005年首屆比賽以來，香港科學青苗獎已發展成為一年一度的全港比賽。參賽學生需探究一個與科學相關的課題，將學習成果向評判及其他參賽學生分享。教師在指導學生時，可透過探究式學習活動，培養他們的創造力與高層次思維技巧。本屆比賽於2026/27學年作出優化，以加強與課程的連貫性，擴闊學生的參與面，並進一步激發對 STEAM 相關領域的興趣。

en.description: This 12-hour seminar is one of the core training programmes offered by the EDB for teachers aspiring for promotion. The content of this seminar covers teachers’ professional conduct and values, the Constitution, Basic Law, National Security Education and local education policies. After successful completion of the course, training hours will be recorded under the "Core Part" of the Training Requirements for Promotion. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDBC6/2020 and EDBC29/2024.
en.background:
According to EDBC6/2020, EDBC29/2024 and EDBIC1/2020, teachers in aided and government schools are required to meet the training requirements for promotion to SGM, PGM, PSM, SPSM, EO & SEO.
This programme is one of the core programmes under the training requirements for promotion.
For promotion to SGM, PSM and EO, teachers must also complete the training programme on "Professional Vision and Growth of School Leaders" and "Reflection and Practice of Professional Leadership".
For promotion to PGM, SPSM and SEO, teachers must also complete the training programme on "School Administration and Management".

zh.description: 本12小時講座是教育局為擬晉升教師提供的核心培訓課程之一。講座內容涵蓋教師專業操守和價值觀、《憲法》、《基本法》、國家安全教育及本地教育政策。參加者成功完成活動後，培訓時數將計算在晉升培訓要求的「核心部分」內。有關培訓要求的詳情請參閱教育局通告第6/2020號及第29/2024號。
zh.background:
根據教育局通告第6/2020號、第29/2024號和教育局內部通告第1/2020號，於資助和官立學校任教的教師，必須在晉升前完成晉升培訓要求。
本課程為晉升培訓要求的核心課程之一。
擬晉升至 SGM、PSM和EO的教師，除本課程外，亦須完成「學校領導的視野及成長」和「領導能力的反思和實踐」兩項課程。
至於擬晉升至 PGM、SPSM和SEO的教師則須完成「學校行政及管理」課程。

en.objective:
In this hub meeting, participants will:
design a student-centred lesson plan by collaborating with AI;
align specific learner needs to pedagogical approaches;
create and evaluate AI prompts and resulting lesson plans and
explore how to adapt textbook materials to achieve learning outcomes.
Remarks
Learning Hubs are communities of practice that promote action learning and a culture of collaboration among secondary English teachers. Learning Hub Meetings provide a platform for:
exploring a range of innovative learning and teaching practices;
promoting effective instructional strategies in support of the latest English Language Education KLA curricular initiatives; and
encouraging relevant, adaptive and future-focused pedagogical practices.
There are three modes of participation in Learning Hubs: professional networking, sharing of learning and teaching practices and resources, and practising by implementing learning and teaching strategies in the school context.
Hub meetings will provide an opportunity for participants to differentiate and apply content to their own school context. Teachers are encouraged to adapt/ develop their own related resources either independently or with the Pedagogy Resource Team.
This course is open to teachers of private schools in Hong Kong who do not have e-Services accounts and teachers teaching Hong Kong curriculum in schools in the GBA Mainland cities*. Teachers of these schools wishing to apply for the course should contact Ms Alice LEUNG at 3549 8315/ rnctnet@edb.gov.hk.
*The schools should meet the following criteria:
A. The schools have joined the “Scheme of Classes for Hong Kong Students” in Shenzhen; or
B. The schools have submitted their curriculum documents to the Education Bureau of Hong Kong, and been recognised to be offering subject curricula which are generally in line with the curriculum requirements of the respective subjects in Hong Kong.

en.objective: To introduce the Chemistry Practical Learning Portfolio Scheme (2026/27) and the corresponding arrangements
en.background:
The Chemistry Practical Learning Portfolio Scheme (2026/27), organised by the Science Education Section of the Education Bureau, aims to promote quality practical learning in Chemistry among S4 and S5 students. By recording the number and types of Chemistry practical activities students complete during this school year and issuing individual learning portfolios and certificates, the scheme recognizes students’ practical learning experiences and acknowledging the efforts of Chemistry teachers and laboratory technicians in promoting practical learning. The Scheme also encourages the inclusion of higher-order thinking questions in practical activities to enhance students’ scientific inquiry and problem-solving skills.
The 2025/26 school year marks the first implementation of this scheme, with over 5,000 S4 students from 131 schools successfully completing the required number of experiments and attaining corresponding recognition levels.
For the details of the Portfolio Scheme, please refer to the EDB website: https://www.edb.gov.hk/en/curriculum-development/kla/science-edu/chem-student-activities.html .

en.objective:
1. To inform teachers of the details of the Hong Kong Budding Scientists Award 2026/27.
2. To enhance teachers' understanding and deployment of inquiry-based learning activities to foster higher-order thinking skills of scientifically gifted/ more able students.
en.description:
1. To inform teachers of the details of the Hong Kong Budding Scientists Award 2026/27.
2. To explore how to deploy inquiry-based learning to enhance the higher-order thinking skills and creativity of gifted/ more able students through sharing of practical teaching ideas.
3. To share school-based experience.
en.background: Gifted/more able students generally possess distinct learning traits that differ from those of their peers. To cater for their learning needs, the Hong Kong Budding Scientists Award (BSA) has developed into an annual territory-wide competitions since its first launch in 2005. Participating students are required to investigate a science-related topic, then share their learning outcomes with adjudicators and fellow contestants. In guiding students, teachers may adopt inquiry-based learning activities to foster their creativity and higher-order thinking skills. The BSA 2026/27 has been refined to enhance its alignment with the curriculum, broaden student participation and further stimulate interest in STEAM-related areas.

zh.background: 資優／高能力學生一般具備與同儕不同的學習特質，為了照顧這些學生的學習需要，自2005年首屆比賽以來，香港科學青苗獎已發展成為一年一度的全港比賽。參賽學生需探究一個與科學相關的課題，將學習成果向評判及其他參賽學生分享。教師在指導學生時，可透過探究式學習活動，培養他們的創造力與高層次思維技巧。本屆比賽於2026/27學年作出優化，以加強與課程的連貫性，擴闊學生的參與面，並進一步激發對 STEAM 相關領域的興趣。

en.objective: The webinar aims to enhance primary school teachers' capabilities in teaching AI literacy and cyber security. Through sharing by different speakers, the webinar will help teachers understand the applications of AI and the related risks related to technology crime, scams and cyber traps, as well as equip them with strategies for fostering students’ AI literacy, anti-scam awareness and cyber security awareness.
en.description: Please refer to the attached programme rundown for details.
en.background:
The Education Bureau (EDB) is actively promoting digital education in primary and secondary schools by strengthening students' ability to apply digital innovations, enhancing their media and information literacy, and nurturing them to become ethical users of technology in an era of rapid innovation and technological advancement.
To enhance teachers’ knowledge of emerging and advanced information technologies, technology-related crimes, cyberattacks, and data security, the Technology Education Section of the EDB and the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau (CSTCB) of the Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF) have jointly developed three editions of the “Cyber Security and Technology Crime Related Information” Learning and Teaching Resources, and launched the “CyberDefenders’ Alliance Card Game”. These initiatives aim to promote cyber security education and contribute to building a safer online environment.
The L&T resources have been uploaded to the EDB’s web page at https://www.edb.gov.hk/cybersecurity/en .

en.objective: This training programme aims to enhance teachers’ understanding of the Constitution, the Basic Law and National Security Education.
en.description:
The content of the training programe includes the relationship between the Constitution and the Basic Law, historical background of the Basic Law, importance of enacting the National Security Law and clarification of some of the misinterpretations on enactment of the Basic Law.
After successful completion of the course, in-service teachers’ training hours will be recorded under Enhanced Training for In-service Teachers (Category 1: Teachers' Professional Roles, Values and Conduct). For newly-joined teachers, training hours will be recorded under the "core training" of newly-joined teachers. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDB Circular No. 6/2020 and the EDB Circular No. 29/2024
Generally, participants are required to attend punctually and complete the three-hour training course, and to sign the “Attendance Slip” at the end of the course. Training hours will only be awarded to those who sign the slip. Participants being late for more than 30 minutes will not be allowed to attend the course (such participants will be considered absent, and no training hours will be awarded by the EDB).
en.background:
The Education Bureau (EDB) Circular No. 6/2020 issued on 10 June 2020 announced the establishment of Professional Ladder for Teachers and relevant measures. Starting from the 2020/21 school year, teachers are required to spare a minimum of 30 hours, in each three-year cycle, to take part in two categories of professional development programme/activity, namely “Teachers’ Professional Roles, Values and Conduct” and “Local, National and International Education Issues”, with not less than six hours spent on each category.
Besides, starting from the 2020/21 school year, teachers appointed to teach in public-funded schools for the first time are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs.

en.objective: 本課程旨在為在職教師提供實用策略，幫助他們識別和培養具有多元潛能的學生，為本港中小學不同學習需要的學生提供適切支援。學員將結合香港融合教育和資優教育發展趨勢，探索資優、高能力和雙重特殊資優學生的特徵，學習適切的識別方法，並應用實證教學方法，例如適異化教學、增潤教學、靈活分組教學和強項為本取向等。透過案例研究、反思性實踐和行動計劃等課程專題，學員將深入研習如何培養學生的學習、社交和情緒發展。學員修畢課程後，可將所學技能靈活應用於教學實務，培養學生的優勢，應對挑戰，並促進不同學習者的公平發展和卓越成長。

en.objective:
學員修畢本課程後，應能：
1. 瞭解愛國主義教育的元素和精神；
2. 運用多元策略，加強有關國家歷史、中華文化、國情、國家地理、《憲法》和《基本法》、國家象徵和標誌、國家安全的學與教，弘揚愛國主義精神；

en.objective: 本課程由資深專業團隊講授，透過系統化的專業培訓，協助學員深化國家安全知識，並能有效地將維護國家安全的信息在學校推廣。課程完成後，學員將能夠加深了解愛國的內涵、認識總體國家安全觀的意義及國家安全重點領域、如何貫徹落實總體國家安全觀等課題，以及透過其他學校在推動國家安全教育經驗以優化自身學校運作情況。
en.background: 為切實履行香港特別行政區維護國家安全的憲制責任，並落實總體國家安全觀，特區政府致力深化全港學校的國家安全教育工作，現舉辦「國安導師培訓課程（教育專業界別）」，邀請各校國家安全教育專責統籌人員報名參與是項培訓。學員完成訓練後，將獲委任為「教育界別國安導師」。透過他們舉辦的國安信息推廣活動，把國家安全教育做得更廣更深，傳遞「國安才能港安，國安才能家安」的重要信息。

en.objective: 本網上課程旨在裝備教師，協助他們更清晰地了解《憲法》及《基本法》的理念和基本知識，以便他們在學校落實《憲法》及《基本法》教育。
en.description:
本網上課程共有11個單元和1個在線評估，包括：
單元一：「一國兩制」的歷史背景和《基本法》的制定過程；
單元二：《基本法》的憲制基礎和結構簡介；
單元三：中央和香港特別行政區的關係；
單元四：香港特別行政區居民的基本權利和義務；
單元五：香港特別行政區的政治體制；
單元六：《基本法》與公共財政；
單元七：《基本法》如何保障香港的金融和貿易發展；
單元八：《基本法》與日常生活；
單元九：外交和有關的對外事務；
單元十：《基本法》的解釋和修改；以及
單元十一：國家發展與《憲法》。
教師可自由選擇單元的瀏覽次序，完成所有單元後，須完成在線評估，獲得70%或以上的成績便符合獲發證書的資格。
en.background:
教育局一直重視推廣《憲法》及《基本法》，以持續推動《憲法》及《基本法》教育與時並進。
《基本法》是香港特別行政區的憲制性文件，它以法律的形式，闡明「一國兩制」、「港人治港」及高度自治等重要概念，亦訂明了在香港特別行政區實行的各項制度，與我們的生活息息相關。

本研討會旨在：
1. 探討全球最新人工智能發展趨勢，並深入分析其對香港教育環境與教學模式的影響；

2. 由兩位同行教師分享「賽馬會人工智能計劃」加拿大多倫多學習之旅的見聞與教學啟發；

en.objective: The webinar aims to enhance secondary school teachers' capabilities in teaching AI literacy and cyber security. Through sharing by different speakers, the webinar will help teachers understand the applications of AI and the related risks related to technology crime, scams and cyber traps, as well as equip them with strategies for fostering students’ AI literacy, anti-scam awareness and cyber security awareness.
en.description: Please refer to the attached programme rundown for details.
en.background:
The Education Bureau (EDB) is actively promoting digital education in primary and secondary schools by strengthening students' ability to apply digital innovations, enhancing their media and information literacy, and nurturing them to become ethical users of technology in an era of rapid innovation and technological advancement.
To enhance teachers’ knowledge of emerging and advanced information technologies, technology-related crimes, cyberattacks, and data security, the Technology Education Section of the EDB and the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau (CSTCB) of the Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF) have jointly developed three editions of the “Cyber Security and Technology Crime Related Information” Learning and Teaching Resources, and launched the “CyberDefenders’ Alliance Card Game”. These initiatives aim to promote cyber security education and contribute to building a safer online environment.
The L&T resources have been uploaded to the EDB’s web page at https://www.edb.gov.hk/cybersecurity/en .

zh.objective: 本研討會旨在提升中學教師教授人工智能素養及網絡安全的能力。透過不同講者的分享，研討會將協助教師認識人工智能應用、科技罪案、詐騙及網絡陷阱等相關風險，並掌握培養學生人工智能素養、防騙意識及網絡安全意識的策略。
zh.description: 有關活動程序請參閱附件
zh.background:
教育局積極推動中小學數字教育，致力提升學生應用數字創新的能力、加強其媒體和資訊素養，並培育他們在創新科技迅速發展的時代成為具備道德操守的科技使用者。
為進一步提升教師對新興及先進資訊科技、科技罪案、網絡攻擊及數據安全的認識，並支援教師引導學生正確使用互聯網，增強學生對人工智能及網絡安全的意識和應對能力，教育局科技教育組與香港警務處網絡安全及科技罪案調查科攜手編製三冊《網絡安全及科技罪案相關資訊》學與教資源，並推出「守網聯盟遊戲卡」。透過這些措施，共同推動網絡安全教育，攜手構建更安全的網絡環境。
相關教學資源已上載至教育局網頁 https://www.edb.gov.hk/cybersecurity 。

en.objective: The programme aims to enhance teachers' professional knowledge, skills and attitudes in understanding the wide range of special needs and using the Whole School Approach and effective strategies to support students with special needs in ordinary school or special school setting. The thematic studies aim to enhance teachers’ professional capacity in catering to different types of special educational needs (SEN) and address teachers’ continuing professional development (CPD) needs based on the local trends of SEN in the education contexts. After the study, the participants should be competent in applying knowledge and skills to support students with specific learning difficulties in learning English.

en.objective:
1 To deepen teachers’ professional understanding of distinctive traditional sports within Hong Kong’s Intangible Cultural Heritage, with a focus on their educational and cultural significance.
2 To enhance teachers’ capacity to integrate reading resources with experiential learning by extending learning beyond the classroom, and to explore the cultural footprint of Ip Man’s Ving Tsun in Hong Kong as an authentic learning context.
3 To provide teachers with first-hand professional learning experiences through visits to the Ving Tsun Athletic Association and modern martial arts studio, enabling them to gain an in-depth understanding of the technical characteristics and cultural ethos of Ving Tsun, and to appreciate the unique value of this Intangible Cultural Heritage for curriculum enrichment and values education.
en.description: Please refer to the attachment
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) has developed the thematic reading series “A Voyage with Books Series: The Power of Sports” to enhance students’ interest and ability in reading through diversified educational multimedia reading resources, while deepening their understanding of cross‑curricular knowledge related to sports. To support schools in making effective use of these resources, the EDB will organise a series of professional development programmes for teachers. These programmes will introduce strategies for using the reading resources, help teachers master diversified reading‑instruction approaches, and guide them in systematically organising reading activities inside and outside the classroom, thereby enhancing learning and teaching.

zh.objective:
1加深教師對香港非物質文化遺產中具代表性的特色體育活動的專業認識，並理解其教育及文化價值。
2提升教師將閱讀資源與體驗式學習結合的專業能力，通過走出課室的學習活動，探索葉問詠春在香港的文化足跡，作為真實而具意義的學習情境。
3通過親身到訪詠春體育會及新式拳館，為教師提供第一手的專業學習體驗，讓教師深入了解詠春的技藝特色與文化精神，並認識這項非遺文化在課程豐富、價值觀教育及跨學科學習中的獨特價值。

zh.background: 教育局製作主題閱讀資源：《書伴遨遊》系列之「體育力量」，通過多元化的教育多媒體閱讀資源，提升學生的閱讀興趣與能力，並加深他們對體育相關跨學科知識的理解。為支援學校有效運用相關資源，教育局將舉辦一系列教師專業發展活動，介紹運用此系列閱讀資源的策略，協助教師掌握多元閱讀教學策略，有系統地組織課堂內外的閱讀活動，從而優化學與教。

en.description:
1. 價值教育：立德樹人作育英才；
2. 廿一世紀技能的發展與評估；
3. 創意與創新教學；
4. STEAM與香港本地教育實踐；及
5. 學習科學
en.background:
為加強內地與港澳教師交流，香港教育大學在教育部教師工作司、教育部港澳台辦公室，以及香港特區政府教育局的支持下，成立校長與教師協同創新培訓中心，舉辦研修交流項目。
是次研修交流班講者包括：
• 李子建教授 - 香港教育大學校長、課程與教學講座教授、應用政策研究及教育未來學院院長、教育發展與創新學院院長
• 晏子教授 - 香港教育大學課程與教學學系系主任兼教授
• 冼權鋒教授 - 香港教育大學特殊教育與輔導學系教授、特殊學習需要與融合教育中心總監
• 宋燕捷教授 - 香港教育大學卓越教學發展中心副總監、沉浸式學習及元宇宙教育研究中心副主任
• 鄭麗娟女士/博士 - 香港五邑鄒振猷學校前校長
• 容煒灝博士 - 香港教育大學課程與教學學系副系主任（國際事務）兼副教授
• 吳翠珊博士 - 香港教育大學課程與教學學系副系主任（學術質素保證與提升）兼助理教授
• 趙振洲博士 - 香港教育大學課程與教學學系副教授
• 黃顯涵博士 - 香港教育大學課程與教學學系副教授
• 萬志宏博士 - 香港教育大學課程與教學學系副教授
• 葉德平博士 - 香港教育大學課程與教學學系高級講師
• 裴蕾絲博士 - 香港教育大學課程與教學學系助理教授
• 巴深博士 - 香港教育大學課程與教學學系助理教授
• 黃淩雲博士 - 香港教育大學課程與教學學系助理教授

en.objective: The objectives of this online self-learning course are to facilitate schools’ understanding of the rationales for implementing the enhanced SDA framework, thereby enhancing the effectiveness of school self-evaluation (SSE), and incorporating digital education into School Development Plans and/or Annual School Plans.
en.description:
1. The online self-learning course comprises school sharing and four parts: Part 1 – Introduction of the rationales for and principles of the enhanced SDA framework; Part 2 – Updated SSE tools and interpretation of SSE data; Part 3 – Conducting a holistic review of school performance; and Part 4 – Revisions to the guidelines on the compilation and templates of SSE documents
2. Participants must complete all parts of this course and assessment requirements to obtain 100% attendance rate.
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) issued EDB Circular No.15/2022 on 11 November 2022 informing schools of the implementation details of the enhanced School Development and Accountability (SDA) framework. The implementation of the enhanced SDA framework is to bolster the accountability of staff in publicly funded schools in providing quality school education and enhancing the national education through the adoption of a whole school approach and ensure accountability in the spirit of school-based management.

zh.objective: 本網上自學課程的目的為：讓學校認識優化架構的理念，掌握如何落實優化架構，以提升學校自評效能；亦會闡述學校如何將數字教育納入學校發展計劃及／或學校周年計劃。
zh.description:
1. 本網上自學課程包括學校經驗分享及四個部分：第一部分：優化架構的理念與原則；第二部分：更新的學校自評工具及自評數據詮釋；第三部分：從整體角度進行校情檢視；以及第四部分：學校自評文件的編寫說明及範本修訂。
2. 參加者須完成本課程各個部分及評核要求，以獲取100%出席率。
zh.background: 教育局於2022年11月11日發出通告第15/2022號，通知學校有關推行優化學校發展與問責架構(優化架構)的細則。此優化架構的推行旨在提高公帑資助學校人員對教育質素的問責精神，包括落實以全校參與模式完善國民教育，以達至校本管理的精神。

en.objective: To share teaching experience, introduce the arrangements and details of the Competition.
en.background:
“We Learn．We Draw” Ocean Park Drawing Competition 2026/27 is organised by the Arts Education Section of the Curriculum Development Institute, Education Bureau, in collaboration with Ocean Park Hong Kong (Ocean Park). It aims to develop primary students’ aesthetics, observational skills, sketching techniques and conservation awareness through drawing animals and plants in Ocean Park. The competition will be held at Ocean Park on four event dates: 15 January, 22 January, 19 February and 26 February 2027.
Interested schools should submit their application forms online from 9:30 a.m ., 16 October to 11:59 p.m., 23 October 2026. Places are limited and applications will be processed on a first come, first served basis.
Details of the competition are available at the Arts Education Key Learning Area webpage: https://www.edb.gov.hk/en/arts/welearnwedraw

en.background: 教育局在2020年6月10日發出第6/2020號通告，公布建立教師專業階梯及相關措施。為協助新入職教師掌握其專業角色，展現專業操守和價值觀，並掌握最新的教育政策和措施的發展，以適切地應用於教學工作，教育局訂定了新入職教師培訓課程。由2020/21學年起，首次於公營學校或直接資助計劃學校任教的教師，必須於首三年內完成30小時的核心培訓，以及按個人專業發展需要參與不少於60小時的選修培訓。

en.objective: The Advanced course aims at enhancing teachers’ competency in building an inclusive school environment. Participants will examine the principle of whole school approach, learn how to develop inclusive culture, formulate policies and measures, and understand the learning needs of students with special educational needs and related support strategies. Participants are required to plan, implement and review school-based supports for students with SEN. On completion of the course, participants will be equipped to assist their schools in promoting integrated education to achieve the goal of catering for students with diverse learning needs.
en.description: The Course will last for 72 contact hours in total. Participants should submit the written assignment tasks required by the Course before the submission deadline.
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) is committed to implementing integrated education so as to cater for students with special educational needs (SEN) in ordinary schools. Teacher training is one of the key factors for catering for students with SEN effectively. To enhance teachers’ capacity in catering for students with SEN, EDB provides the Basic, Advanced and Thematic (BAT) Courses for in-service teachers.

zh.objective: 高級課程目的是提升教師建立共融校園的能力，學員將會探討全校參與的理念，學習如何發展共融文化、制訂政策及措施，並認識有特殊教育需要學生的學習需要及支援策略。學員需要計劃、實踐及檢討校內照顧有特殊教育需要學生的工作。修畢課程後，學員將能協助學校推展融合教育，以達致照顧不同學習需要學生的目標。

zh.background: 教育局致力推動融合教育，以照顧普通學校有特殊教育需要的學生。教師培訓是有效照顧有特殊教育需要學生的關鍵因素之一。為提升教師教導有特殊教育需要學生的專業能力，教育局為在職教師舉辦基礎、高級及專題課程 (三層課程) 。

en.objective: The seminar aims to help kindergarten teachers understand the transition arrangements for students with special needs entering Primary One, the support provided by ordinary primary schools and special schools, and the role of parents in the transition process, so that they can provide appropriate advice to parents, and ensure that kindergarten students with special needs better prepare for their transition to Primary One.
en.description: The seminar will last for 2.5 hours, covering: (1) Support for students with special educational needs in ordinary primary schools; (2) An introduction to special schools; (3) How to assist students with special needs in transition to Primary One; (4) How parents can support their children with special needs in transition to Primary One.
en.background: Smooth transition to Primary One for students with special needs requires early planning and close school-parent collaboration. To support kindergarten teachers in facilitating this process, the Education Bureau is organizing this seminar to share strategies for teachers to support students with special needs in their transition to Primary One, outline the support provided by ordinary primary schools and special schools, and assist teachers in offering appropriate advice to parents.

• To introduce “2026 HKAEE (Schools Sector)”, “2026 Best Green Education Initiative Award” and “Environmental Education @ Community Award (2026/27 School Year)”
• To equip teachers with effective strategies to implementing school-based environmental education and facilitating the sustainable development of school campus
• To share resources related to environmental education and encourage teachers to implement education for sustainable development
en.description: Please refer to the attachments
en.background: Funded by the Environment and Conservation Fund and supported by the Education Bureau, the “Hong Kong Awards for Environmental Excellence” has been led by the Environmental Campaign Committee (ECC), together with the Environment and Ecology Bureau (EEB) and in conjunction with nine organisations. Since its launch in 2008, the HKAEE is one of the prestigious and reputable award schemes in Hong Kong. The Award covers various sectors, including the Schools Sector, which aims to recognise participating schools’ efforts in environmental management and environmental education, and to commend schools with excellent environmental achievements. In addition, there are separate awards for the Schools Sector, i.e. the “Best Green Education Initiative Award” and the newly introduced “Environmental Education @ Community Award” starting from this school year. In addition to experience sharing activities and visits to past award winning schools, the HKAEE (Schools Sector) also offers “Facilitator Support Service”, which participating schools may apply for to receive guidance and advice, thereby supporting them in developing sustainable campuses. For more details about the award schemes, please visit the ECC’s Schools Go Green website (https://school.ecc.org.hk/en/programmes/hkaee.html).

zh.objective:
• 簡介「2026香港環境卓越大獎（學校界別）」、「2026最佳環境教育方案大獎」及「環境教育@社區大獎（2026/27學年）」
• 協助教師掌握推行校本環境教育的有效策略，促進校園可持續發展
• 分享環境教育相關資源及鼓勵教師推行可持續發展教育
zh.description: 請參閱附件
zh.background: 「香港環境卓越大獎」自2008年起由環境運動委員會（環運會）聯同環境及生態局及九個機構合辦，並由環境及自然保育基金資助及獲教育局支持，是香港具代表性及公信力的環保奬勵計劃。獎項涵蓋不同界別，當中學校界別旨在肯定參與學校在環境管理及環境教育方面的努力，表揚有卓越環保成就的學校。此外，學校界別另設「最佳環境教育方案大獎」及由本學年起增設的「環境教育@社區大獎」。除經驗分享、參觀過往得獎學校等活動，香港環境卓越大獎（學校界別）亦設有「協導員支援服務」，供參賽學校申請，以接受指導及建議，協助學校建立可持續發展校園。獎項計劃詳情請參閱環運會綠色學校天地網站（https://school.ecc.org.hk/tc/programmes/hkaee.html）。

en.objective: This training programme aims to enhance teachers’ understanding of the Constitution, the Basic Law and National Security Education.
en.description:
The content of the training programme includes the relationship between the Constitution and the Basic Law, historical background of the Basic Law, importance of enacting the National Security Law and clarification of some of the misinterpretations on enactment of the Basic Law.
After successful completion of the course, newly-joined teachers' (i.e. full-time teachers appointed to teach in publicly-funded schools from the 2020/21 school year) training hours will be recorded under the "core training" of newly-joined teachers. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDB Circular No. 6/2020 and EDB Circular No. 29/2024 .
Generally, participants are required to attend punctually and complete the three-hour training course, and to sign the “Attendance Slip” at the end of the course. Training hours will only be awarded to those who sign the slip. Participants being late for more than 30 minutes will not be allowed to attend the course (such participants will be considered absent, and no training hours will be awarded by the EDB).
This session is exclusively for newly-joined teachers. If the number of applicants exceeds the quota, the selection will be determined in the order of priority on (i) the teaching experience of the newly-joined teachers; and (ii) the order in which schools submit their applications to EDB. EDB reserves the right of final decision on the selection principles and arrangements.
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) Circular No. 6/2020 issued on 10 June 2020 announced the establishment of Professional Ladder for Teachers and relevant measures. A training programme has been developed to help newly-joined teachers understand their professional roles, demonstrate professional values and conduct, and keep abreast of the latest developments in education policies. Starting from the 2020/21 school year, teachers appointed to teach in publicly-funded schools (including government schools, aided schools, caput schools and Direct Subsidy Scheme schools) for the first time are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs.

zh.objective: 此課程旨在加深教師對《憲法》、《基本法》及國安教育的認識。
zh.description:
課程內容包括《憲法》與《基本法》的關係、《基本法》制定的歷史背景、訂立《香港國安法》及《維護國家安全條例》的重要性，以及釐清一些對《基本法》的誤解等。
新入職教師(即2020/21 學年起首次於公帑資助學校任教的全職教師的培訓時數將計算在新入職教師「核心培訓」部分內。有關培訓要求的詳情請參閱 教育局通告第6/2020號 及 教育局通告第29/2024號 。
一般情況下，參加者須準時出席及完成整個時長三小時的課程，並於課程結束後簽署「出席表格」，方可獲發相關培訓時數。參加者如遲到超逾三十分鐘，將不獲參加課程，並將視作缺席課程（即不會獲發放任何培訓時數）。
本場次只供新入職教師報讀。如報讀人數超逾上限，本局將按序根據 (i) 新入職教師教學年資的先後；及 (ii) 學校提交有關報讀申請至教育局的時間先後，決定錄取次序。教育局對錄取原則及安排有最終決定權。
zh.background:
教育局在2020年6月10日發出 第6/2020號通告 ，公布建立教師專業階梯及相關措施。
為協助新入職教師掌握其專業角色，展現專業操守和價值觀，並掌握最新的教育政策和措施的發展，教育局訂定了新入職教師培訓課程。由2020/21學年起，首次於公帑資助學校（包括官立學校、資助學校、按位津貼學校及直接資助計劃學校）任教的教師，必須於首三年內完成30小時的核心培訓，以及按個人專業發展需要參與不少於60小時的選修培訓。

en.objective: 本課程由資深專業團隊講授，透過系統化的專業培訓，協助學員深化國家安全知識，並能有效地將維護國家安全的信息在學校推廣。課程完成後，學員將能夠加深了解愛國的內涵、認識總體國家安全觀的意義及國家安全重點領域、如何貫徹落實總體國家安全觀等課題，以及透過其他學校在推動國家安全教育經驗以優化自身學校運作情況。
en.background: 為切實履行香港特別行政區維護國家安全的憲制責任，並落實總體國家安全觀，特區政府致力深化全港學校的國家安全教育工作，現舉辦「國安導師培訓課程（教育專業界別）」，邀請各校國家安全教育專責統籌人員報名參與是項培訓。學員完成訓練後，將獲委任為「教育界別國安導師」。透過他們舉辦的國安信息推廣活動，把國家安全教育做得更廣更深，傳遞「國安才能港安，國安才能家安」的重要信息。

This programme aims to:
- introduce to teachers the assessment and moderation mechanism of HKDSE Category B Applied Learning subjects;
- introduce to teachers the reporting of results in Applied Learning subjects; and

en.background: Applied Learning (Category B subjects in HKDSE) is a valued senior secondary elective subject, focusing on practical learning elements linked to broad vocational and professional fields with dual emphasis on theory and practice. There is no public examination for Applied Learning subjects. Assessments are designed and undertaken by the Course Providers while the HKEAA is responsible for monitoring the assessment results. Rigorous procedures and mechanism are in place to moderate the standard of all Applied Learning subjects. Reporting of results for Applied Learning subjects (except for Applied Learning Chinese (for non-Chinese speaking students)) is ‘Attained’, ‘Attained with Distinction (I)’ and ‘Attained with Distinction (II)’.

en.objective:
The Speaking Hub is for secondary English teachers who are interested in developing students' speaking skills through a range of student-centred activities both within and beyond the English classroom. In this meeting, we will explore how different elements of persuasion can be developed through classroom activities to develop your students’ confidence to give an effective presentation.
In this Speaking Hub Meeting, participants will:
become familiar with the Oracy Framework (designed by Voice 21 and Oracy Cambridge), an instructional framework for developing students’ speaking skills;
experience activities based on the three modes of persuasion, which can be adapted for your classroom to enhance students’ persuasive language and presentational skills; and
gain insights from a teacher who participated in the Speaking Hub in the previous school year to enhance her students’ public speaking skills within and beyond the classroom.
Learning Hubs are communities of practice that promote action learning and a culture of collaboration among secondary English teachers. Learning Hub Meetings provide a platform for:
exploring a range of innovative learning and teaching practices;
promoting effective instructional strategies in support of the latest English Language Education KLA curricular initiatives; and
encouraging relevant, adaptive and future-focused pedagogical practices.
There are three modes of participation in Learning Hubs: professional networking, sharing of learning and teaching practices and resources, and practising by implementing learning and teaching strategies in the school context.
Remarks
An email will be sent to successful applicants to invite them to join the online learning platform for Part A (the self-paced online learning component).
Participants will complete a pre-task in Part A and then apply what they learn in Part B (the face-to-face session).
Both components of the Speaking Hub meeting (Part A and Part B) must be completed in the given time to acquire the full CPD hours.
There will be an optional implementation and reflection post-task after Part B for which participants can earn up to 2 additional (self-input) CPD hours.
This course is open to teachers of private schools in Hong Kong who do not have e-Services accounts and teachers teaching Hong Kong curriculum in schools in the GBA Mainland cities*. Teachers of these schools wishing to apply for the course should contact Ms Alice LEUNG at 3549 8315/ rnctnet@edb.gov.hk.
*The schools should meet the following criteria:
A. The schools have joined the “Scheme of Classes for Hong Kong Students” in Shenzhen; or
B. The schools have submitted their curriculum documents to the Education Bureau of Hong Kong, and been recognised to be offering subject curricula which are generally in line with the curriculum requirements of the respective subjects in Hong Kong.

zh.objective:
The Speaking Hub is for secondary English teachers who are interested in developing students' speaking skills through a range of student-centred activities both within and beyond the English classroom. In this meeting, we will explore how different elements of persuasion can be developed through classroom activities to develop your students’ confidence to give an effective presentation.
In this Speaking Hub Meeting, participants will:
become familiar with the Oracy Framework (designed by Voice 21 and Oracy Cambridge), an instructional framework for developing students’ speaking skills;
experience activities based on the three modes of persuasion, which can be adapted for your classroom to enhance students’ persuasive language and presentational skills; and
gain insights from a teacher who participated in the Speaking Hub in the previous school year to enhance her students’ public speaking skills within and beyond the classroom.
Learning Hubs are communities of practice that promote action learning and a culture of collaboration among secondary English teachers. Learning Hub Meetings provide a platform for:
exploring a range of innovative learning and teaching practices;
promoting effective instructional strategies in support of the latest English Language Education KLA curricular initiatives; and
encouraging relevant, adaptive and future-focused pedagogical practices.
There are three modes of participation in Learning Hubs: professional networking, sharing of learning and teaching practices and resources, and practising by implementing learning and teaching strategies in the school context.
Remarks
An email will be sent to successful applicants to invite them to join the online learning platform for Part A (the self-paced online learning component).
Participants will complete a pre-task in Part A and then apply what they learn in Part B (the face-to-face session).
Both components of the Speaking Hub meeting (Part A and Part B) must be completed in the given time to acquire the full CPD hours.
There will be an optional implementation and reflection post-task after Part B for which participants can earn up to 2 additional (self-input) CPD hours.
This course is open to teachers of private schools in Hong Kong who do not have e-Services accounts and teachers teaching Hong Kong curriculum in schools in the GBA Mainland cities*. Teachers of these schools wishing to apply for the course should contact Ms Alice LEUNG at 3549 8315/ rnctnet@edb.gov.hk.
*The schools should meet the following criteria:
A. The schools have joined the “Scheme of Classes for Hong Kong Students” in Shenzhen; or
B. The schools have submitted their curriculum documents to the Education Bureau of Hong Kong, and been recognised to be offering subject curricula which are generally in line with the curriculum requirements of the respective subjects in Hong Kong.

• To introduce “2026 HKAEE (Schools Sector)” and “2026 Best Green Education Initiative Award”
• To equip teachers with effective approaches to implementing school-based environmental education and fostering sustainability within the school community

en.background: Funded by the Environment and Conservation Fund and supported by the Education Bureau, the Hong Kong Awards for Environmental Excellence (HKAEE) has been led by the Environmental Campaign Committee (ECC), together with the Environment and Ecology Bureau (EEB) and other nine organisations. Since its launch in 2008, the HKAEE is one of the most prestigious and reputable award schemes in Hong Kong. The Award covers various sectors, including the Schools Sector, which aims to recognise participating schools’ efforts in environmental management and environmental education. In addition, “Best Green Education Initiative Award” is also established to encourage schools to develop initiatives in promoting sustainability and/or carbon neutrality, as well as to recognise and gather good exemplars of environmental education practices in the school sector. Various support & training activities will be provided to assist participating schools in developing green schools. For more details about the award schemes, please visit the ECC’s Schools Go Green website (https://school.ecc.org.hk/en/programmes/hkaee.html).

zh.objective:
• 簡介「2026香港環境卓越大獎（學校界別）」及「2026最佳環境教育方案大獎」
• 協助教師掌握推動校本環境教育的有效方法，促進校園可持續發展

zh.background: 「香港環境卓越大獎」自2008年起由環境運動委員會（環運會）聯同環境及生態局及九個機構合辦，並由環境及自然保育基金資助及獲教育局支持，是香港極具代表性及公信力的環保奬勵計劃。獎項涵蓋不同界別，當中的學校界別旨在肯定參與學校在環境管理及環境教育方面的努力。此外，另設有「最佳環境教育方案大獎」，以鼓勵學校設計推動可持續發展及／或碳中和的教育方案，表揚及匯集學界出色的環境教育實踐方法。大獎提供不同的支援及培訓活動，協助參賽學校逐步成為綠色學校。獎項計劃詳情請參閱環運會綠色學校天地網站（https://school.ecc.org.hk/tc/programmes/hkaee.html）。

en.objective:
This workshop is for secondary English teachers who are interested in developing students' reading skills through student-centred reading lessons that combine explicit instruction with student practice.
In this course, participants will:
explore a few theoretical models of reading acquisition and consider the implications for effective reading instruction at the secondary level;
understand how to support students with developing comprehension strategies through explicit teacher modelling and supported student practice following the Gradual Release of Responsibility (GRR) instructional framework; and
engage in a Reciprocal Teaching lesson demonstration to practise key comprehension strategies.
Remarks:
An email will be sent to successful applicants with a link to the online platform where they can complete the self-paced online learning component (Part A) before attending the face-to-face workshop (Part B).
The two parts of this course must be completed in the given time to acquire the full 6 CPD hours.
Teachers who enroll in the workshop will be encouraged to participate in the Reading Hub 2026/27 .
The content of this workshop is similar to the workshop with the same title organised in October/November 2025 (Course: CDI020260205). Teachers who enrolled in the previous workshop need not enroll again.
This course is open to teachers of private schools in Hong Kong who do not have e-Services accounts and teachers teaching Hong Kong curriculum in schools in the GBA Mainland cities*. Teachers of these schools wishing to apply for the course should contact Ms Alice LEUNG at 3549 8315/ rnctedb@edb.gov.hk.
*The schools should meet the following criteria:
A. The schools have joined the “Scheme of Classes for Hong Kong Students” in Shenzhen; or
B. The schools have submitted their curriculum documents to the Education Bureau of Hong Kong, and been recognised to be offering subject curricula which are generally in line with the curriculum requirements of the respective subjects in Hong Kong.

en.objective: Through classic topics in ancient mathematics, this seminar aims to enhance secondary mathematics teachers' understanding of the rich heritage of ancient Chinese mathematics, and to raise their awareness of how to connect Chinese mathematics history topics with STEAM and mathematical modelling, thereby promoting the organic integration of mathematics teaching, generic skills development, and the inheritance of Chinese culture.
en.description:
The seminar will share with teachers:
(i) The mathematics principles, historical origins and cultural background of selected ancient mathematics topics, as well as the characteristics of ancient Chinese mathematical thought.
(ii) The relationship between ancient mathematics topics and the secondary mathematics curriculum, and entry points for integrating ancient mathematics into learning and teaching.
(iii) How to incorporate STEAM thinking and mathematical modelling elements into ancient mathematics topics.
(iv) The history of Sino-Korean mathematical exchange, and the dissemination and influence of ancient Chinese mathematics in East Asia, enriching the cultural foundations of mathematics teaching.
en.background:
Ancient Chinese mathematics has a long and rich history, accumulating a wealth of wisdom from the "Nine Chapters" of the pre-Qin period to the “Nine Chapters on the Mathematical Art” and the “Sea Island Mathematical Manual” of the Han and Tang dynasties, as well as the “Sea Mirror of Circle Measurements” of the Song and Jin periods. These classics not only recorded algorithmic achievements that were ahead of their time, but also embodied the thinking of the ancients in distilling general methods from specific problems - a mindset that remains deeply inspiring for modern mathematics education.
In secondary mathematics education, integrating the history of mathematics helps students understand the development of concepts and enhances their interest in learning. It also deepens students' appreciation of ancient Chinese mathematical achievements and helps cultivate a sense of national identity. This seminar chooses several distinct topics from ancient mathematics as a starting point, covering various algebraic and geometric topics, and will also introduce how to connect them with STEAM and mathematical modelling in teaching, enabling teachers to transform ancient wisdom into classroom activities that develop integrated problem-solving skills. In addition, a veteran teacher from the True Light School of Hong Kong will deliver a presentation on "A Documentary Account of Mathematical Knowledge Exchange between China and Korea in the 18th Century," tracing the historical context of Sino-Korean mathematical exchange and broadening participants' understanding of the East Asian mathematical culture sphere.

zh.objective: 本研討會旨在通過經典古算主題，加強中學數學教師認識中國古代數學的豐富內涵，同時認識如何把中國數學歷史課題聯繫 STEAM 與數學建模，促進數學教學、共通能力培養和中華文化傳承的有機結合。
zh.description:
與教師分享
(i) 特選古算主題的數學原理、歷史源流和文化背景，以及中國古代數學思想的特色。
(ii) 古算主題與中學數學課程的關係，以及把古算融入教學的切入點。
(iii) 如何在古算課題中融入STEAM思維及數學建模元素。
(iv) 中韓數學交流史，以及中國古代數學在東亞地區的傳播與影響，豐富數學教學的文化底蘊。
zh.background:
中國古代數學源遠流長，從先秦「九數」到漢唐《九章算術》、《海島算經》，以及宋金《測圓海鏡》，累積了豐富智慧。這些典籍記載了當時領先世界的算法成就，更體現古人從具體問題提煉通用方法的思維，對現代數學教育深具啓發。
在中學數學教育中，融入數學史有助學生理解概念發展脉絡，提升學習興趣，同時亦增進學生認識中國古代數學成就，協助培養國民身份認同。本次研討會以數個不同的古算主題爲引，涵蓋不同的代數和幾何課題，亦會介紹如何聯繫STEAM與數學建模教學，讓教師將古代智慧轉化爲培養綜合解難能力的課堂活動。此外，香港真光中學資深教師將主講「18世紀中國和韓國的數學知識交流紀實」，梳理中韓數學交流的歷史脉絡，拓寬參加者對東亞數學文化圈的認識。

en.background: Assessment is an integral component of the “curriculum, learning and teaching, and assessment” cycle. Simultaneously, schools and teachers can analyse assessment data to pinpoint students’ learning needs and difficulties, thereby optimizing curriculum design and instructional strategies to foster students’ balanced development across knowledge, skills, values, and attitudes.

講者將分享人工智能在教育界的應用範疇及示例，並從學校領導與管理層面，探討如何將政策方針轉化為切合校本情況與學生需要的行動策略，帶領教師團隊勇於創新、擁抱變革。他亦會闡述校長及中層管理人員在推動智慧校園過程中的策劃與督導角色，以及如何透過教師專業發展活動，全方位提升教師團隊的數字素養與教學能量。

zh.background: 為弘揚教育家精神，建設高質量教師校長隊伍，國家教育部舉辦新時代中小學名師名校長培養計劃 （2024-2027）（「雙名計劃」），旨在培養一批具有鮮明教育理念和成熟教學模式、能夠引領基礎教育改革發展的教育家型校長和教師。 五名香港校長已榮獲國家教育部錄取參與「雙名計劃」，接受國家層面的教師專業培訓，並在香港設立名校長工作室，以推動香港教師隊伍整體質素提升。

en.objective:
This workshop will explore a range of innovative practices to support and engage students with SEN in English language lessons.
Identify special educational needs in mainstream schools
Discuss the features of an inclusive classroom and see how the whole-school approach supports the implementation of inclusion
Highlight the importance of conducting pre-assessment with students and using that data to develop class profiles
Introduce the RTI model as an approach to differentiating English learning experiences for students with SEN

Provide opportunities for participants to reflect on and share experiences about their students with SEN in the English classroom

Participants are encouraged to share an example of a current challenge or issue related to students with SEN in their English lessons.

en.objective: The course aims to explore how digital education strategies can be applied to promote project learning in Primary Humanities to develop students’ self-directed learning abilities and enhance teachers’ professional capacity in teaching relevant topics.
en.description:
The course includes the following content:
(1)Applying digital education strategies to promote project learning, which include helping students formulate study plans, collect, organise and analyse information.
(2)Applying digital education strategies to showcase and evaluate learning outcomes.
en.background: Primary Humanities has been implemented in the 2025/26 school year (starting from P1 and P4) and will extend to all year levels in the 2027/28 school year. In order to strengthen professional exchange among Primary Humanities teachers and broaden their professional horizons, a series of professional development programmes comprising seminars and workshops are organised by the Education Bureau.

zh.objective: 課程旨在探討如何運用數字教育策略推展小學人文科的專題研習，以發展學生的自主學習能力，並提升教師教授相關課題的專業能力。
zh.description:
課程包括以下內容：
(1) 運用數字教育策略推展專題研習，包括協助學生訂定研習計劃、蒐集、整理和分析資料。
(2) 運用數字教育策略展示和評估研習成果。
zh.background: 小學人文科已於2025/26學年開始推行（從小一及小四開始），並於2027/28學年推展至所有級別。為加強小學人文科教師的專業交流，拓寬教師的專業視野，教育局舉辦一系列相關的專業發展課程，包括研討會和工作坊。

en.objective: 透過到內地考察交流，讓晉升教師了解國家不同領域的最新發展，並與內地學校領導交流，學習和反思不同的領導策略，以拓寬視野，更有效地推動學校持續發展，加強培養學生國民身份認同的能力。
en.description: 此活動內容包括專題講座、學校及企業參訪、文化考察和專業交流。
en.background:
《行政長官2022年施政報告》中提出，要求公帑資助學校新入職教師及公營學校擬晉升教師須參加內地學習團，並增加在職教師到內地考察的機會，親身體驗國家的發展。由2023/24學年開始，所有於2023年9月1日起獲實任晉升更高職級的公營學校教師，必須在其實任晉升的首兩年內，參加由教育局舉辦的「晉升教師內地學習團」，以符合晉升培訓要求。
教育局將於2026年11月、12月及2027年3月至6月舉辦其他「晉升教師內地學習團」，前往內地不同城市。下一輪報名日期預計為9月上旬，詳情請留意培訓行事曆系統。

sessions.venue: 南京市
sessions.speaker: 南京師範大學學者及專家
sessions.remark:
1. 參加「晉升教師內地學習團 (2026/27) – 南京」(一) (課程編號：PDT020260247AA)的教師必須於2026年9月29日(二)晚出席學習團的簡介會。詳情將適時發送至參加者於報名表格內所提供的電郵地址或於培訓行事曆系統 (TCS) 的登記電郵地址，請參加者確保電郵地址正確無誤，並檢查相關電郵信箱。
2. 費用：免費（詳情請參閱課程介紹備註(二)）。
3. 教師提交申請時，請確保現時持有的回鄉證或相關證件於學習團舉行期間有效。教師在獲得取錄後，須提交相關文件資料，以作處理參加學習團之用，如未能於指定日子交回相關資料，則會影響其申請結果。
4. 如教師需要申請中國簽證入境內地，教師的護照有效期需為6個月以上，詳情請向相關簽發機構查詢。
5. 有關公營學校晉升教師參加內地學習團事宜，請參閱教育局通告第10/2023號；有關教師培訓要求，請參閱教育局通告第29/2024號。

(1) To enhance teachers' knowledge, skills and confidence in school development, administration and management, and capacity in assuming a leadership role in schools; and
(2) To deepen teachers' understanding of national and international development and education trends
en.description: This 18-hour training programme is one of the core training programmes offered by the EDB for teachers aspiring for promotion to PGM/SPSM/SEO. The content of this training programme covers school administration and management as well as national and international development and education issues. After successful completion of the course, training hours will be recorded under the "Core Part" of the Training Requirements for Promotion. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDBC6/2020 and EDBC29/2024.
en.background:
According to EDBC6/2020, EDBC29/2024 and EDBIC1/2020, teachers in aided and government schools are required to meet the training requirements for promotion.
This programme is one of the core training programmes under the training requirements for promotion, the target participants are teachers aspiring for promotion to Principal Graduate Master/Mistress (PGM), Senior Primary School Master/Mistress (SPSM) and Senior Education Officer (SEO). For promotion to vice-principals, teachers must also complete the programme on "Professional Conduct, Values and Education Policies".

zh.description: 本18小時培訓課程是教育局為擬晉升至 PGM、SPSM和SEO的教師提供的核心培訓課程。課程內容涵蓋學校行政和管理、國家及國際發展和教育議題探討。參加者成功完成活動後，培訓時數將計算在晉升培訓要求的「核心部分」內。有關培訓要求的詳情請參閱教育局通告第6/2020號及第29/2024號。
