en.description: Based on the context of learning and teaching of the Business, Accounting and Financial Studies curriculum, this workshop examines AI support for everyday teaching workflows in lesson preparation, materials production, question writing and marking. Four demonstrations cover animation, an interactive webpage, question writing and marking. “Skills” for AI agent is introduced – bundles of instruction texts files that teach an AI agent how to perform specific and repeatable tasks. en.objective: This course aims to assist newly-joined teachers to understand their professional roles and demonstrate professional conduct and values.
en.description:
The content of this course includes "T-standard + " : Professional Standards for Teachers of Hong Kong, teachers’ professional conduct and relevant guidelines, etc.
After successful completion of the course, newly-joined teachers' (i.e. full-time teachers appointed to teach in public sector or DSS schools from the 2020/21 school year) training hours will be recorded under the "core training" of newly-joined teachers. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDB Circular No. 6/2020 and EDB Circular No. 29/2024 .
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) Circular No. 6/2020 issued on June 10, 2020 announced the establishment of Professional Ladder for Teachers and relevant measures. A training programme has been developed to help newly-joined teachers understand their professional roles, demonstrate professional values and conduct, and keep abreast of the latest developments in education policies. Starting from the 2020/21 school year, teachers appointed to teach in public sector or DSS schools for the first time are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs.

en.objective: To encourage non-Chinese speaking students to learn and practise Chinese in daily life, so as to enhance their learning interests and language competences, as well as to instill in them proper values and attitudes, Curriculum Development Institute of the EDB has developed the “Learning Chinese On Foot” resources. The seminar aims to introduce the resources and share the school experience of the tryouts, so as to equip teachers with effective strategies of designing diversified learning activities with a view to enhance NCS students' learning outcomes.
en.description:
The major contents of the online sharing session include:
1. Introduction of the “Learning Chinese On Foot” resources
2. Schools experience sharing on the “Learning Chinese On Foot” activity
3. Experience sharing on designing of routes and guiding the visit
en.background: Starting from the 2014/15 school year, the Education Bureau provides schools with the “Chinese Language Curriculum Second Language Learning Framework”. The Learning Framework has provided steps and methods for learning and teaching, and assessment according to the needs of NCS students of learning Chinese as a second language. With reference to the Learning Framework, teachers can set learning targets, learning progress and expected learning outcomes on reading, writing, listening and speaking, as well as adapt and develop teaching materials at the school-based level for NCS students with different starting points and abilities, so as to help them learn Chinese progressively.

zh.objective: 為鼓勵非華語學生在日常生活中學習及運用中文，並提升學生的語文能力和學習語文的興趣，以及培養他們正面的價值觀，教育局課程發展處發展「散步學中文」資源。本課程旨在介紹有關資源，分享學校的試行經驗，讓教師掌握設計多元化中文學習活動的策略，以提升非華語學生的學習成效。
zh.description:
本網上分享會的主要內容如下：
1. 非華語學生「散步學中文」資源簡介
2. 非華語學生「散步學中文」活動學校經驗分享
3. 路線設計及導賞經驗分享
zh.background: 由2014/15學年開始，教育局為學校提供「中國語文課程第二語言學習架構」。學習架構因應非華語學生學習中文作為第二語言的需要，提供學與教和評估的步驟及方法。學校教師在施教時可參考學習架構，為不同起步點和能力的非華語學生在校本層面訂定讀、寫、聽、說的學習目標、進程及預期學習成果，調適及發展教材，幫助他們循序漸進學習中文。

en.objective: This programme is co-organised with the School of Hotel and Tourism Management, the Chinese University of Hong Kong. It is the first Distinguished Speaker Sharing Session of the “THS Experiential Learning Journey 2026/27” Series. It aims to enrich THS teachers’ understanding on the latest development of the local tourism industry, with a particular focus on how to leverage the integration of culture and tourism to create innovative visitor experiences and promote local tourism, thereby helping teachers enhance their teaching and learning effectiveness in the subject.
en.description: Please refer to the attachment for details about this programme.
en.background:
To support the implementation of the Senior Secondary Tourism and Hospitality Studies curriculum, the Curriculum Development Institute (CDI) of the Education Bureau (EDB), and the School of Hotel and Tourism Management of the Chinese University of Hong Kong co-organise “THS Experiential Learning Journey 2026/27”, a series of professional development activities for THS teachers throughout the 2026/27 school year. The programme includes 2 Distinguished Speaker Sharing Sessions and 4 Thematic Seminars.
This year’s learning journey is centred around the themes of “+ Tourism” and “Experiences”. Through keynote speeches and field activities conducted by university academics and industry experts, THS teachers will gain an up-to-date understanding of the latest developments in the tourism industry and tourism and hospitality education. The programme offers a series of knowledge-enrichment sessions designed to enhance the effectiveness of teaching and learning in the subject. Details of the activities are tentatively as follows:
A. Distinguished Speaker Sharing Sessions
1. “Cultural and Tourism Integration – Pioneering New Visitor Experiences” by Dr Louis Ng Chi-wa, Museum Director of the Hong Kong Palace Museum (24 October 2026)
2. Professor Wan, Lisa Chun-ying, Associate Dean of the Chinese University of Hong Kong Business School (June 2027)
B: Thematic Seminars
1. “Industry + Tourism” (December 2026)
2. Exploring Island Tourism Development through the Kat O Field Trip (January 2027)
3. New Perspectives on the Cruise Economy (March 2027)
4. Culinary Innovation — from Service to Experience (May 2027)
Participating teachers can receive relevant certificates as an encouragement after fulfilling the following requirements:
 “Certificate of Completion”: Attending at least 3 professional training programmes (Including at least one from Distinguished Speaker Sharing Sessions and Thematic Seminars) ;
 “Certificate of Appreciation”: Attending at least 5 professional training programmes (Including at least one from Distinguished Speaker Sharing Sessions and Thematic Seminars).
Further details of each activity, including the content, date, time and venue, will be announced in due course. Participating teachers are advised to refer to the latest announcements by the EDB.

本年度的學習之旅以「+旅遊」及「體驗」為主軸，透過大學學者及業界專家的主題演講及考察活動，讓高中旅遊與款待科教師掌握旅遊業界及旅遊款待教育的最新發展，並藉多元化的知識增益課程，提升本科的學與教效能。活動詳情暫定如下：
A. 傑出學人講座
1. 香港故宮文化博物館館長吳志華博士 「文旅融合—開創旅客新體驗」
(2026年10月24日)
2. 中大商學院副院長尹振英教授 (2027年6月下旬)
B. 專題研討會
1. 「工業+旅遊」 (2026年12月)
2. 透過吉澳考察探索海島旅遊發展 (2027年1月)
3. 郵輪經濟新視野 (2027年3月)
4. 從服務到體驗的餐飲革新 (2027年5月)
參與教師出席達到以下要求，可獲發相關證書，以作鼓勵：
 「參與證書」：出席最少3場專業培訓活動（包括傑出學人講座及專題研討會各最少1場）；
 「嘉許證書」：出席最少5場專業培訓活動 （包括傑出學人講座及專題研討會各最少1場）。
各場活動的內容、日期、時間和地點等詳細資訊將適時公布，敬請參與教師留意本局的最新消息。

en.background:
The ECC, the EEB, the EPD and the EDB have jointly organised the Student Environmental Protection Ambassador (SEPA) Scheme for students of primary and secondary schools through the Environment and Conservation Fund since 1995. The Scheme aims to cultivate a sense of environmental responsibility and leadership among primary and secondary school students, and to encourage them to take proactive actions to improve the environment by providing a wide range of diverse environmental training activities, including seminars, workshops, and field trips. Teacher training is also provided to familiarise teachers with general knowledge of environmental protection, as well as to strengthen their ability in implementing environmental education.
For more details about the SEPAS, please visit ECC’s Schools Go Green website (https://school.ecc.org.hk/en/programmes/sepas.html).

en.background:
Assessment is the practice of collecting evidence of student learning. The most important role of assessment is to promote learning and monitor students’ progress. The learning outcomes that are assessed and examined through the HKDSE should be aligned with the aims, objectives and intended learning outcomes of the senior secondary curriculum.
The reporting system is “standards-referenced” for the HKDSE, in which student performance is matched against standards, which indicate what students have to know and be able to do to merit a certain level of performance.
Therefore, the HKEAA disseminates relevant assessment information, so as to provide feedback for teachers and schools on the quality of the teaching and enhance students' learning effectiveness.

zh.background:
評估是蒐集學生學習表現顯證的工作。評估最重要的角色是促進學習及監察學生的學習進度。香港中學文憑所評估及考核的成果，應與高中課程的宗旨、學習目標及預期學習成果相符。
香港中學文憑採用「水平參照模式」匯報，即把學生的表現跟預定的水平比對。該預定的水平說明了學生要達到某等級所需的知識與能力。
就此，香港考試及評核局發放相關的評核資訊，向教師及學校就教學質素提供回饋，並提升學生的學習效能。

en.objective:
For learners to thrive in the 21st century, they must learn how to think (as opposed to be taught what to think) as well as to share their thinking. Join the Thinking Routines (TR) Hub to find out how teachers use TR in their English Language classrooms to foster student agency in their practice and motivate students to move forward in their inquiries through interaction with others.
In this workshop, participants will:
learn how taking different perspectives can help students deepen their thinking to care more about complex social issues;
explore the use of visible thinking strategies to support and guide students’ thought processes in language learning; and
discover how thinking routines are implemented in the English Language classroom through teacher sharing.
Learning Hubs are communities of practice that promote action learning and a culture of collaboration among secondary English teachers. Learning Hub Meetings provide a platform for:
exploring a range of innovative learning and teaching practices;
promoting effective instructional strategies in support of the latest English Language Education KLA curricular initiatives; and
encouraging relevant, adaptive and future-focused pedagogical practices.
There are three modes of participation in Learning Hubs: professional networking, sharing of learning and teaching practices and resources, and practising by implementing learning and teaching strategies in the school context.
This course is open to teachers of private schools in Hong Kong who do not have e-Services accounts and teachers teaching Hong Kong curriculum in schools in the GBA Mainland cities*. Teachers of these schools wishing to apply for the course should contact Ms Alice LEUNG at 3549 8315/ rnctnet@edb.gov.hk.
*The schools should meet the following criteria:
A. The schools have joined the “Scheme of Classes for Hong Kong Students” in Shenzhen; or
B. The schools have submitted their curriculum documents to the Education Bureau of Hong Kong, and been recognised to be offering subject curricula which are generally in line with the curriculum requirements of the respective subjects in Hong Kong.

en.description:
The seminar will cover the following key areas:
1) Building supportive professional growth teams and applying positive behaviour management strategies at school level;
2) Practice-Based Coaching (PBC): Concept, Guiding framework, and Implementation Process;
3) An introduction to “A Positive Classroom” Certification Programme.
Course Remarks
Participants will receive the following printed resources on the day of the seminar:
a. Selected demonstration materials from "A Positive Classroom": Positive Behavior Management Strategies Resource Package (Pilot Version), to support further application and deepening of school-based practice
b. Reference materials on Practice-Based Coaching (PBC)
c. Details of the 2026/27 “A Positive Classroom” Certification Programme, including programme arrangements, school enrollment procedures, will be announced on the day of the seminar. Kindergartens may choose a suitable mode of participation according to their school context and needs.
en.background:
To support schools in enhancing teachers' capacity to cater for learning diversity, the Education Bureau has implemented “A Positive Classroom”: Positive Behaviour Management Strategies school-based teacher development programme since 2018/19 school year. The programme progressively assists schools in putting the related concepts into daily classroom practice, and a Positive Behaviour Management Strategies Resource Package covering seven practical strategies has been developed.
The programme will further focus on the Practice-Based Coaching (PBC) model. Taking into account schools’ different stages of development and practical contexts, it will support schools in putting the resources into daily classroom practice through peer support, classroom observation, feedback and reflective dialogue. The programme will also nurture middle leaders, grade level/panel coordinators and senior teachers as school-based Positive Coaches, with a view to gradually building positive teams and a school culture that promote both teachers’ professional growth and middle leadership development.
The seminar will also introduce the 2026/27 “A Positive Classroom” Certification Programme, helping schools select suitable modes of participation according to their contexts and students’ developmental needs, and further deepen the school-based implementation of positive behaviour management.

zh.objective:
講座旨在協助學校管理人員、中層人員、級/組長及具經驗教師：
1) 了解如何建立支持型專業成長團隊，規劃及推動正向校園文化發展
2) 認識「實踐為本教練模式」(Practice-Based Coaching, PBC)，並運用該模式帶領教師在日常課堂中有效實踐正向行為管理技巧，支援幼兒的學習多樣性
zh.description:
講座將涵蓋以下重點：
1) 建立支持型專業成長團隊及正向行為管理技巧的校本應用
2) 「實踐為本教練模式」(Practice-Based Coaching, PBC) : 理念、指導模式及實踐流程
3) 「課堂『正』策」認證計劃簡介
課程備註
參加者將於講座當日獲發以下印刷資源：
a. 《課堂『正』策—正向行為管理技巧》資源套(試行版)， 重點示範技巧內容，供學校進一步應用及深化實踐
b.「實踐為本教練模式」(Practice-Based Coaching, PBC) 參考資料
c. 2026/27學年「課堂『正』策」認證計劃的安排及學校報名方法將於講座當天公布。幼稚園可因應校情及發展需要，選擇合適的參與模式。
zh.background:
為支援學校提升教師照顧學生學習多樣性的能力，教育局自2018/19學年起推行「課堂『正』策 — 正向行為管理技巧」校本教師發展計劃，逐步協助學校把相關理念落實於日常課堂，並編製涵蓋七項實用策略「正向行為管理技巧」資源套。
本年度進一步聚焦「實踐為本教練模式」(Practice-Based Coaching, PBC)，並因應學校不同發展階段及實際情況，透過同儕支援、課堂觀察、回饋與反思對話，協助學校把資源套轉化為日常課堂實踐。同時，計劃亦會培育中層人員、級/組長及具經驗教師成為校本正向教練，逐步建立教師專業成長與中層領導培育並重的正向團隊與校園文化。
講座亦會簡介2026/27學年「課堂『正』策」認證計劃，協助學校按校情及幼兒發展需要，選擇合適的參與模式，持續深化正向行為管理的校本實踐。

en.objective:
This study tour aims to:
1. Enhance teachers' understanding of media and information literacy, so as to effectively guide students in mastering the learning focus of “Media and Information Literacy” under Module 1.1 “Self-understanding and Life Skills”;
2. Demonstrate how local study tour and experiential learning activities can be used to cultivate in students’ positive values and attitudes, including critical thinking, responsibility, commitment, respect for others and law-abidingness; and
3. Strengthen teachers' capacity to organise local study tours for students.
en.background:
This study tour is designed to align with the learning focus of “Media and Information Literacy” under Module 1.1 “Self-understanding and Life Skills” of the “Citizenship, Economics and Society Curriculum Guide (Secondary 1-3)”. This module requires students to learn how to verify the accuracy and judge the trustworthiness of information to select credible media and objective and impartial information, to understand that the media’s position will affect its reporting, perspective and stance, to be alert to the impact of disinformation on individuals and society. Teachers should remind students that the cyber world is not without regulation and students should learn how to use media and information technology properly, safely, ethically and legally. They should be aware of the impact of improper use of the Internet on individuals and society, and raise their awareness of national security (cyber security) and law-abidingness.
In the process of developing the aforementioned skills, the curriculum places particular emphasis on the establishment of students' values: students are required to critically evaluate the authenticity of information with critical thinking, to take responsibility for their statements and sharing behaviors online with a sense of accountability and commitment, to adopt a respectful attitude to prevent cyberbullying and invasion of privacy, and to use media and information technology lawfully, thereby collectively safeguarding cyber security and social order.

zh.objective:
本考察團旨在:
1. 加強教師對媒體和資訊素養的認識，以有效引導學生掌握單元1.1「自我理解與生活技能」的「媒體和資訊素養」學習重點；
2. 展示如何透過本地考察和體驗式學習活動，培養學生慎思明辨、責任感、承擔精神、尊重他人及守法等正確價值觀和態度；及
3. 增強教師為學生組織本地考察活動的能力。
zh.background:
本考察團旨在配合初中「公民、經濟與社會（中一至中三）」課程框架中單元1.1「自我理解與生活技能」的「媒體和資訊素養」學習重點。該單元要求學生學習查證資訊的準確性和判斷資訊的可信性，知道如何選擇具公信力的媒體和客觀持平的資訊，明白媒體的立場會影響其對事件的報道、觀點和取態，並警惕不實資訊對個人和社會的影響。教師須提醒學生網絡世界不是毫無監管的，學生需了解如何正確地、安全地、合乎道德地及合法地使用媒體和資訊科技，明白不當使用網絡對個人和社會大眾的影響，並提高對國家安全（網絡安全）和守法的意識。
在培養以上能力的過程中，課程特別重視學生價值觀的建立：學生須以慎思明辨的態度審視資訊真偽，以責任感和承擔精神對自身在網絡上的發言及分享行為負責，以尊重他人的態度避免網絡欺凌及侵犯私隱，並守法使用媒體和資訊科技，共同維護網絡安全和社會秩序。

en.objective: This Online Course aims to facilitate secondary school principals' and teachers' better understanding of the ideas of the Constitution and the Basic Law. In turn, they can help consolidate and deepen junior secondary students' basic knowledge of the Constitution and the Basic Law through curriculum and learning activities.
en.description:
This Online Course is composed of 10 modules and the Online Assessment:
Module 1: The historical background of "One Country, Two Systems" and the enactment process of the Basic Law
Module 2: The constitutional basis of the Basic Law and an introduction to its structure
Module 3: Relationship between the Central Authorities and the HKSAR
Module 4: Interpretation and amendment of the Basic Law
Module 5: Fundamental rights and duties of the residents of the HKSAR
Module 6: The basic characteristics of the HKSAR political structure
Module 7: The Basic Law and public finance
Module 8: How does the Basic Law protect the development of Hong Kong's monetary affairs and trade?
Module 9: The Basic Law and daily life
Module 10: Foreign affairs and relevant external affairs
After completing all modules, learners have to complete the Online Assessment before they are considered having formally completed the Course. Training & development data will be revealed in Teacher's Personal Profile in e-Services Portal upon successful completion within one month after the end of the Course.
en.background:
The Constitution of the People's Republic of China (Constitution) and the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China (Basic Law) jointly form the constitutional basis of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) and are related closely to our daily lives. The Basic Law enshrines within a legal document the important concepts of "One Country, Two Systems", "Hong Kong people administering Hong Kong" and a high degree of autonomy. It also prescribes the various systems to be practised in the HKSAR.
The Education Bureau (EDB) has always attached great importance to the promotion of the Constitution and the Basic Law as its regular, on-going task, to ensure that Constitution and Basic Law education would proceed along with the times.

zh.objective: 本網上課程旨在讓中學校長和教師更深入了解《憲法》和《基本法》的理念，從而使他們能透過課程和學習活動，鞏固和深化初中學生對《憲法》和《基本法》所具備的基礎知識。
zh.description:
本網上課程共有10個單元和1個在線評估：
單元一：「一國兩制」的歷史背景和《基本法》的制定過程
單元二：《基本法》的憲制基礎和結構簡介
單元三：中央和香港特別行政區的關係
單元四：《基本法》的解釋和修改
單元五：香港特別行政區居民的基本權利和義務
單元六：香港特別行政區政治體制的基本特點
單元七：《基本法》與公共財政
單元八：《基本法》如何保障香港的金融和貿易發展
單元九：《基本法》與日常生活
單元十：外交和有關的對外事務
學員完成所有單元後，學員須完成在線評估，便正式修讀完畢；在課程完結後一個月內，成功完成課程的學員的培訓資料將在教師電子化服務入門網站的個人資料概覽上顯示。

en.objective: This course aims to enhance participants’ understanding of the requirements of KPM items and the points-to-note when submitting related data.
en.description:
1. The online self-learning course aims to explain the purpose of collecting KPM data, and revisit the requirements of KPM items and the points-to- note when submitting related data.
2. Participants must complete all parts of this course and assessment requirements to obtain 100% attendance rate.
en.background: According to Education Bureau Circular No. 15/2022, starting from the 2023/24 school year, schools are required to collect the Key Performance Measures (KPM) data annually, including the relevant data of the Stakeholder Survey (SHS) and Assessment Program for Affective and Social Outcomes (APASO) as part of their annual school self-evaluation (SSE). This is intended to further strengthen schools’ capacity in the use of data, enable them to focus their “Planning–Implementation–Evaluation” self-evaluation cycle on the seven learning goals, and reinforce the spirit of school accountability under school-based management. In addition to reporting the data to the Incorporated Management Committee / School Management Committee, schools should submit the data to the EDB for compilation of reference data to facilitate SSE, and for better understanding of the current situation of school education.

2. 參加者須完成本課程各個部分及評核要求，以獲取100%出席率。
zh.background: 根據教育局通告第15/2022號，由 2023/24 學年起，學校須每年蒐集「學校表現評量」數據，當中包括相關的「持份者問卷」和「情意及社交表現評估套件」問卷數據，作為學校周年自評的一部分。此舉旨在進一步加強學校運用數據的能力，讓學校能聚焦七個學習宗旨進行「策劃─推行─評估」的自評循環，並強化校本管理下的學校問責精神。除向法團校董會／學校管理委員會／校董會報告有關數據，學校亦向教育局提交相關數據，以編製參考數據供學校進行自評之用，以及讓本局掌握學校教育的現況。

en.background:
To enhance school stakeholders’ awareness of school safety and emergency responsiveness, and to further promote the concept of “Safe Community”, representatives from the Inter-departmental Counter Terrorism Unit, Hong Kong Police Force and Fire Services Department will conduct a training session with professional sharing and demonstrations.

en.objective:
1. To introduce the knowledge and strategies essential for developing school-based gifted education; and
2. To make use of relevant knowledge and strategies setting out the blueprint to develop school-based gifted education and student talent pool.
en.description:
1. Exploring various school-based gifted education development strategies and formulating school-specific development blueprint; and
2. Exploring the planning and development of school-based gifted education and student talent pool under the “Three-tier Implementation Model”.
en.background:
1. In order to better support the planning and co-ordination of school-based gifted education, the Gifted Education Section has designed a series of school-specific and practice-oriented modular advanced courses.
2. To facilitate participants to get a better understanding of the course contents, we recommend completing the “EDB Online Foundation Course for Teachers -Gifted Education” or equivalent training prior to this course.
3. This advanced course series consists of 6 modules:
(A) Setting Out the Blueprint for School-based Gifted Education and Talent Pool
(B) SWOT Analysis for the Implementation of School-based Gifted Education and Talent Pool
(C) Practical Cases Analysis: Three-tier Implementation Model of Gifted Education- Level 1 Whole-class Instruction
(D) Practical Cases Analysis: Three-tier Implementation Model of Gifted Education - Level 2 Pull-out Programme
(E) Student Cases Analysis & School-based Experience Sharing: Realising the Potential of Students and Nurturing Giftedness
(F) Professional Development for Teachers and Resources Deployment for Gifted Education
4. Teachers can consider their own training needs to enrol in one or all of the modules (teachers may choose to complete the modules in several years accumulatively). An e-Certificate of “Gifted Education Advanced Course” would be awarded to participants who successfully complete all the 6 modules(a total of 18 hours). Teachers wishing to apply for this e-Certificate, please contact the Gifted Education Section, EID, EDB. (Tel: 36983914 or via email: cpge@edb.gov.hk)

zh.objective:
1. 介紹發展校本資優教育時需掌握的知識及策略；及
2. 運用相關知識及策略規劃校本資優教育及人才庫的發展藍圖。
zh.description:
1. 探討不同學校的校本資優教育發展策略，擬訂校情為本的發展藍圖；及
2. 探討「三層架構推行模式」下校本資優教育及學生人才庫的規劃和發展。
zh.background:
1. 為更靈活及有效支援校本資優教育的課程發展與統籌工作，本組特別設計一系列以校情為本、實作為主的模組式深造課程。
2. 為讓參加者更能掌握本課程的內容，我們建議先完成「教育局教師網上基礎課程 — 資優教育」或同等程度的培訓。
3. 本系列的課程共分六個模組，分別為：
(A)規劃校本資優教育及人才庫的藍圖
(B)推行校本資優教育及人才庫之強弱機危分析
(C)資優教育三層架構推行模式：第一層全班式教學實踐示例分析
(D)資優教育三層架構推行模式：第二層抽離式課程實踐示例分析
(E)學生個案分析與校本經驗分享：識別學生潛能與資優培育
(F)資優教育之教師專業發展與資源運用
4. 教師可因應自己的需要選修個別模組或全數六個模組(教師可選擇分數年累積完成)；完成全數六個模組課程者(共18小時)，將可獲頒發一張「資優教育深造課程」電子證書。 如教師有意申請此電子證書，請在完成六個模組後聯絡教育局教育基建分部資優教育組。（電話︰36983914 電郵︰cpge@edb.gov.hk）

en.objective: 在中國的廣袤大地上，從舊石器到新石器時代，再到有初始國家形成的時段，滿天星斗的文化載體層出不窮。在空間與時間上，都是連續不斷的。現代考古學把這些文化圈、文化類型清晰地展示給我們，讓我們可看到中華文明的早期國家的形成過程。身為中國人的我們，可以從這些考古發掘出來的歷史中學到甚麼？我們可以怎樣推廣應用這些歷史研究、學習、與教育的經驗？在人工智能的發展大潮流中，我們可以怎樣結合二者，讓世界更好認識中國的歷史經驗？有關講座可幫助教師思考以上問題，並設計結合相關知識及教學策略的課堂。
en.description: 請參閱附件。
en.background:
教育局於2025年10月公布「高中中國歷史科優化課程框架」，並於2027/28學年中四級開始實施。為支援教師準備有關課程，教育局舉辧「高中中國歷史科優化課程先導計劃」。教育局選取部分課題，透過專家學者的專業支援，讓參與教師按課程優化的方向調整和豐富教學策略，加深對現有及新增課題的掌握，提升學與教的效能，為未來實施優化課程做好準備。
知識增益講座系列是配合「高中中國歷史科優化課程先導計劃」的其中一項支援措施，參加教師透過專家學者的講解，深入認識試教課題的內容。
en.cpd:
CPD Mode:
Structured Learning
CPD Hours:
2.0 Hour(s)
CPD Domain:
I. Teaching & Learning

en.objective: The sharing session aims to (1) introduce aspects of the RDO that schools may encounter when formulating policies, practical examples of application in the education environment, and recommendations for promoting cultural inclusion; and (2) share experiences of deploying the additional funding by schools admitting a relatively small number of NCS students, and the principles on the use and other relevant details of the "Composite Support Grant for Non-Chinese Speaking Students" starting from the 2026/27 school year.
en.background:
The Government is committed to encouraging and supporting the integration of NCS students into the community, including facilitating their early adaptation to the local education system and mastery of the Chinese language. According to the Race
Discrimination Ordinance (RDO), all educational establishments have the responsibilities to make their best endeavours in supporting the learning and teaching of all their students
irrespective of races, in accommodating ethnic diversity in schools, in respecting cultural and religious differences and in communicating with parents. The Education Bureau (EDB) has implemented a series of enhanced support measures to step up the support for NCS students’ effective learning of the Chinese language and the creation of an inclusive learning environment in schools.

en.objective: This seminar will present the comprehensive findings of the PISA 2025 Hong Kong results, covering all cognitive and innovative domains, as well as the key factors associated with student performance. It will examine the implications of these results for Hong Kong’s education system at both the systemic and school levels, highlighting macro-level insights into educational equity, systemic performance trends, and international benchmarking. In alignment with the PISA 2025 assessment design, this seminar will feature a special report on Science—the major domain of this cycle—alongside findings from the related domain of Mathematics. Participants will explore data-driven strategies derived from these areas that can directly inform school policy, curriculum planning, learning design, and assessment practices. Ultimately, while covering all four assessment domains of PISA 2025, this seminar, with its special report on the major domain of Science, will be highly valuable for a broad audience. This includes government policymakers, academic researchers, school leaders, curriculum heads, and frontline educators, particularly those in the Science and Mathematics key learning areas.
en.background: The Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA), organised by the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), is one of the world’s leading international assessments of student achievement. It examines how well 15-year-old students can apply the knowledge and competencies essential for full participation in modern societies. With science as its major domain, PISA 2025 also assessed mathematics and reading as minor domains. Furthermore, it introduced an innovative domain, Learning in the Digital World (LDW), which examined students’ computational problem-solving abilities and their capacity to manage and direct their own learning in digital environments.

zh.objective: 本講座將全面介紹 PISA 2025 香港學生的整體表現，涵蓋所有認知與創新評估領域，以及影響學生表現的相關因素。講座將探討這些數據對香港教育制度在系統及學校層面的啟示，並闡釋教育 公平、教育系統表現趨勢及國際比較等宏觀層面的重要發現。 配合 PISA 2025 的評估設計，本講座將特別報導本屆的主要領域——科學，並連帶探討相關的數學領域。參加者將探討如何運用相關數據，為學校政策、課程規劃、學習設計及評估實踐提供具實證基礎的參考。 總括而言，本講座將涵蓋 PISA 2025 全部四個評估領域，並藉著對主要領域（科學）的特別報導，為不同教育持份者帶來豐富啟發，適合政府政策制定者、學術研究員、學校領導、課程主任，以及前線教育工作者（特別是科學及數學教育學習領域的教師）參與。
zh.background: 由經濟合作與發展組織（OECD）主辦的「學生能力國際評估計劃」（Programme for International Student Assessment, PISA），是全球最具影響力的學生學習成就國際評估之一。PISA旨在評估十五歲學生是否具備在現代社會中有效參與所需的知識與能力。PISA 2025以科學為主要評估領域，並以數學及閱讀為次要評估領域。此外，PISA 2025 新增了「在數碼世界中學習」（Learning in the Digital World, LDW）這創新評估領域，旨在評估學生的計算解難能力，以及他們在數碼環境中自我調節和主導學習的能力。

en.objective:
1. To introduce the knowledge and strategies essential for developing school-based gifted education; and
2. To make use of relevant knowledge and strategies setting out the blueprint to develop school-based gifted education and student talent pool.
en.description:
1. Exploring various school-based gifted education development strategies and formulating school-specific development blueprint; and
2. Exploring the planning and development of school-based gifted education and student talent pool under the “Three-tier Implementation Model”.
en.background:
1. In order to better support the planning and co-ordination of school-based gifted education, the Gifted Education Section has designed a series of school-specific and practice-oriented modular advanced courses.
2. To facilitate participants to get a better understanding of the course contents, we recommend completing the “EDB Online Foundation Course for Teachers -Gifted Education” or equivalent training prior to this course.
3. This advanced course series consists of 6 modules:
(A) Setting Out the Blueprint for School-based Gifted Education and Talent Pool
(B) SWOT Analysis for the Implementation of School-based Gifted Education and Talent Pool
(C) Practical Cases Analysis: Three-tier Implementation Model of Gifted Education- Level 1 Whole-class Instruction
(D) Practical Cases Analysis: Three-tier Implementation Model of Gifted Education - Level 2 Pull-out Programme
(E) Student Cases Analysis & School-based Experience Sharing: Realising the Potential of Students and Nurturing Giftedness
(F) Professional Development for Teachers and Resources Deployment for Gifted Education
4. Teachers can consider their own training needs to enrol in one or all of the modules (teachers may choose to complete the modules in several years accumulatively). An e-Certificate of “Gifted Education Advanced Course” would be awarded to participants who successfully complete all the 6 modules(a total of 18 hours). Teachers wishing to apply for this e-Certificate, please contact the Gifted Education Section, EID, EDB. (Tel: 36983914 or via email: cpge@edb.gov.hk)

(B) 推行校本資優教育及人才庫之強弱機危分析

en.objective: This online course aims to deepen newly-joined teachers' understanding of the "T-standard+" - Professional Standards for Teachers of Hong Kong and their professional roles, professional conduct and values.
en.description:
This online course explains the three professional roles stated in the "T-standard+" through scenario analysis, interactive games and videos. The course content is divided into the following five chapters:
1. Prologue
2. Caring Cultivators
3. Inspirational Co-constructors
4. Committed Role Models
5. Aspiration for self-advancement through self-reflection
To obtain CPD hours, participants are required to complete the entire course within the specified period. CPD hours will be recorded under the “Core Training” of newly-joined teachers.
en.background:
Starting from the 2020/21 school year, full-time teachers appointed to teach in publicly-funded schools, including government schools, aided schools, caput schools and Direct Subsidy Scheme (DSS) schools for the first time, are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs. This course is part of the Core Training (Category 1), accounting for 3 CPD hours.
For details of the training requirements, please refer to EDB Circular No.6/2020 and EDB Circular No.29/2024 .

zh.objective: 本網上課程旨在加深新入職教師對 「T-標準+」-「香港教師專業標準參照」 的理解，掌握其專業角色及專業操守和價值觀。
zh.description:
本網上課程通過情境分析、互動遊戲及短片等，讓教師掌握「T-標準+」所描述香港教師的三個專業角色。課程內容分以下五章：
1. 序章
2. 關愛學生的育才者
3. 啟發學生的共建者
4. 敬業樂群的典範
5. 反思求進以達自我完善的精神
參加者須於指定的日期內 完成整個課程 ，方可獲得培訓時數。有關時數將計算在新入職教師「核心培訓」部分內。
zh.background:
由2020/21學年起，首次於公帑資助學校，包括官立學校、資助學校、按位津貼學校及直接資助計劃（直資）學校任教的全職教師，必須於首三年內完成30小時的核心培訓，以及按個人專業發展需要參與不少於60小時的選修培訓。本課程屬核心培訓課程(範疇一)，佔3小時培訓時數。
培訓要求的詳情請參閱 教育局通告第6/2020號 及 教育局通告第29/2024號 。

en.objective:
完成本課程後，預期學員能夠：
1.掌握資優教育的基礎知識；
2.認識不同的資優教育課程模式；及
3.了解獲取不同種類的資優教育資源的方法。
en.description: 學員先透過觀看視頻片段掌握每個主題的基本概念，再閱讀短文以便進一步了解個別主題的細節。學員更可完成延伸閱讀文章，從而深入理解特定主題的內容。學員完成每章的內容後，便可參加該章的測驗。每章的測驗設有三次應考機會，如能取得70%或以上的成績，便可以繼續修讀下一章，直至完成整個課程。
en.background:
1. 為讓校長及教師在參加其他進階課程之前，得以掌握資優教育的基礎知識，教育局在 2015/16 學年設計此網上課程。
2. 本課程的內容建基於過往由香港資優教育學苑舉辦的「資優教育基礎課程（網上學習）」，同時加入新的課題及更多的延伸閱讀。
3. 本課程有助教師了解及推行校本資優教育，校長可鼓勵全體教師修讀。
4. 本課程分為四章，分別為（1）識優．惜優、（2）聽．說．資優心、（3）學與教透視和（4）全民參與。每一章完結後附有測驗以鞏固學員的學習。
5. 本課程在 2026/27 學年將開辦兩次，教師可因應個人的教學工作安排報讀任何一期課程。下期課程將於課程開始前八星期接受報名。

Structured Learning

I. Teaching & Learning

en.objective:
After completing the course, participants should be able to:
1. gain basic knowledge in gifted education;
2. understand different gifted education curriculum models; and
3. understand the ways to solicit various types of resources in gifted education.
en.description: Participants will view the video clips to get an overall idea of the theme in each chapter. Then, they will read the selected articles to acquire more understanding about the details of the theme and related issues. After that, participants can complete the extended readings to gain in-depth understanding of a particular theme. After completing the course contents in the chapter, they can attempt the End-of-Chapter Test. Three attempts are allowed for each test. By scoring 70% or above, participants can move on to the next chapter until they complete the whole course.
en.background:
1. In order to equip principals and teachers with the basic knowledge in gifted education before attending any further advanced studies, the Education Bureau (EDB) developed this online course in the 2015/16 school year.
2. This course is developed based on the contents of the “Foundation Course in Gifted Education (Online Learning)” organised by the Hong Kong Academy for Gifted Education (HKAGE) previously. New topics and more extended readings are added.
3. This course helps teachers understand and implement school-based gifted education. School heads can encourage all teachers in the school to take the course.
4. This course consists of four chapters: (a) Learning about Gifted Education, (b)Listening to the Hearts of Gifted Students, (c) A Deeper Look at Learning and Teaching of Gifted Students and (d) A Whole Community Approach to Gifted Education. There is an End-of-Chapter test in each chapter to consolidate participants’ learning.
5. There are two intakes in the 2026/27 school year. Teachers may enrol in any of the intakes with consideration over their own teaching schedule.

en.objective: This Thematic Course aims at enhancing teachers’ competency in teaching students with ‘Behavioural, Emotional and Social Development Needs’ (BESDN), focusing on the needs of students with Attention Deficit / Hyperactivity Disorders (AD/HD). Emphasis will be put on both theoretical and practical aspects. Participants will further review the characteristics, educational needs, support strategies, curriculum accommodation, teaching resources, behaviour management, team collaboration and community support for students with AD/HD. On completion of the course, participants will be able to apply the necessary professional knowledge and skills in catering for students with AD/HD.
en.description: The Course will last for 60 contact hours in total. Participants should submit the written assignment tasks required by the Course before the submission deadline.
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) is committed to implementing integrated education so as to cater for students with Special Educational Needs (SEN) in ordinary schools. Teacher training is one of the key factors for catering for students with SEN effectively. To enhance teachers’ capacity in catering for students with SEN, EDB provides the Basic, Advanced and Thematic (BAT) Courses for in-service teachers.

zh.objective: 本專題課程目的是提高教師教導「行為、情緒及社群發展需要」學生的能力 (針對注意力不足／過度活躍症學生的需要)。課程內容將會理論與實踐並重，學員會更深入地探討注意力不足／過度活躍症學生的特徵、教育需要、支援策略、課程調適、教學資源、行為處理、團隊協作及社區支援等課題。修畢課程後，學員將可以應用有關的專業知識及技巧，照顧有注意力不足／過度活躍症學生。
zh.description: 本課程共60小時。學員須於限定時間前按課程要求完成及呈交課業。
zh.background: 教育局致力推動融合教育，以照顧普通學校有特殊教育需要的學生。教師培訓是有效照顧有特殊教育需要學生的關鍵因素之一。為提升教師教導有特殊教育需要學生的專業能力，教育局為在職教師舉辦基礎、高級及專題課程 (三層課程) 。

en.objective: To prepare aspiring principals to take up principalship by providing training on practical skills and theories in the Six Core Areas of Leadership.
en.description:
The course lasts for at least 81 contact hours (75 hours on the six core areas of leadership and 6 hours on action research methodology) with built-in assessments. Participants are required to carry out an action research project to apply what they have acquired from the course in a school setting.
The six core areas of leadership of the course are as follows:
1. Strategic Direction and Policy Environment
2. Learning, Teaching and Curriculum
3. Teacher Professional Growth and Development
4. Staff and Resources Management
5. Quality Assurance and Accountability
6. External Communication and Connection to the Outside World
en.background:
As announced in EDB Circular No. 1/2024 dated 26 February 2024, with effect from the 2004/05 school year, aspiring principals have to attain the 'Certification for Principalship' (CFP) requirement in addition to complying with the appointment conditions in force at the time, before they can be considered for appointment to principalship in public sector or DSS schools^. This course is one of the components of the CFP process.
(^For details, please refer to the EDB Circular No. 1/2024.)

zh.objective: 為有志擔任校長的人士提供六個主要領導才能範疇的培訓，讓他們能為擔任校長一職作好準備。
zh.description:
課程時長最少81小時(75小時為六個主要領導才能範疇相關項目及6小時的行動研究方法)，當中包含評估。學員須進行一項行動研究計劃，把課程所學於校內實踐。
課程內容的六個主要領導才能範疇包括：
1. 策略方向及政策環境
2. 學與教及課程
3. 教師專業成長及發展
4. 員工及資源管理
5. 質素保證及問責
6. 對外溝通及聯繫
zh.background:
教育局在2024年2月26日發出的第1/2024號通告中闡明，校長資格認證的要求已由2004/05學年起實施。擬任校長必須獲得校長資格認證及符合有關的聘任條件，才會獲考慮聘任為公營或直接資助計劃學校的校長^。這個課程是校長資格認證其中的一部分。
(^詳情請參閱教育局通告第1/2024號)

en.objective: 透過到內地考察交流，讓晉升教師了解國家不同領域的最新發展，並與內地學校領導交流，學習和反思不同的領導策略，以拓寬視野，更有效地推動學校持續發展，加強培養學生國民身份認同的能力。
en.description: 此活動內容包括專題講座、學校及企業參訪、文化考察和專業交流。
en.background:
《行政長官2022年施政報告》中提出，要求公帑資助學校新入職教師及公營學校擬晉升教師須參加內地學習團，並增加在職教師到內地考察的機會，親身體驗國家的發展。由2023/24學年開始，所有於2023年9月1日起獲實任晉升更高職級的公營學校教師，必須在其實任晉升的首兩年內，參加由教育局舉辦的「晉升教師內地學習團」，以符合晉升培訓要求。
教育局將於2026年12月及2027年3月至6月舉辦其他「晉升教師內地學習團」，前往內地不同城市。下一輪報名日期預計為2026年9月下旬，詳情請留意培訓行事曆系統。

zh.objective: 旨在通過「開放課堂」計劃，讓全港教師觀摩獲獎教師優良的教學實踐，促進專業交流。
zh.description: 本節課堂旨在讓學生認識不同海洋生物的特徵，並運用STEAM相關科目的知識，了解牠們如何適應環境。課堂開始時，教師會先請學生分組觀察海星和海膽的身體特徵，並運用人工智能搜尋海星和海膽的資料，以研習牠們移動、進食和自我保護的方式。最後，學生會以小組形式匯報研習所得，並在教師帶領下總結學習內容。教師藉本節的課堂活動，讓學生認識和欣賞大自然生物的求存能力，並培養他們的觀察能力和提升人工智能素養。
zh.background: 教學理念：教師透過跨學科課程整合和設計與學生生活情境緊密扣連的學習活動，引導學生進行自主探究，激發學生創意與解難潛能，提升他們的邏輯思維、創新能力和STEAM素養，應對未來挑戰。

Co-organised by the Education Bureau, the Hong Kong Youth Cultural and Arts Competitions Association, and the Hong Kong China Network Industrial Association, the “52nd Hong Kong Youth Cultural and Arts Competitions — Hong Kong Youth Photography Competition 2026/27 in Celebration of the 30th Anniversary of Hong Kong’s Return to the Motherland” is themed “Hong Kong: Scenes and Feelings”. en.objective: The Research Forum is organised by the HKEAA regularly as a platform to encourage more interest from educators and researchers to make use of HKEAA assessment data to conduct studies for enhancing the quality of teaching, learning and educational assessment.
en.description:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping the educational landscape, bridging both new opportunities and challenges to assessment, learning, and the cultivation of future-ready competencies. The HKEAA Research Forum 2026 will bring together local and international experts, educators, and scholars to explore how AI is transforming educational assessment and learning practices, ranging from classroom-level innovations to large-scale public assessment systems.
The programme will feature three sharing sessions focusing on AI-enabled classroom assessment and learning systems, emerging applications of AI in large-scale testing, and evolving global trends in assessment and learning. Building on these presentations, the panel discussions will examine key issues related to the development of 21st-century skills and future AI initiatives for the electronic Territory-wide System Assessment (e-TSA). Through professional dialogue and knowledge exchange, participants will gain valuable insights into the opportunities, challenges, and wider implications of AI-enabled education in both local and global contexts.
AI is not only transforming teaching and learning, but also opening up new possibilities and shaping new paradigms for educational assessment. Under the theme “Transforming Assessment and Learning in the AI Era: From Local Innovation to Global Impact”, the Forum seeks to foster meaningful dialogue, inspire collaboration, and contribute to the future development of assessment and learning in an increasingly digital and interconnected world.

zh.objective: 考評局定期舉辦研究論壇，希望通過這個平台鼓勵更多的教育工作者和研究人員運用考評局的評估數據進行研究，共同探討如何更好地通過評核促進教與學及評估。
zh.description:
人工智能（AI）正迅速重塑教育生態，為評估、學習以及未來人才能力的培育帶來嶄新機遇與挑戰。考評局研究論壇2026將匯聚本地及國際專家、教育工作者及學者，共同探討AI如何革新教育評估與學習實踐，涵蓋從課堂層面的創新應用到大型公開評核系統的發展。
論壇將設有三場專題分享，聚焦於AI賦能的課堂評估與學習系統、AI在大型測驗中的新興應用，以及全球評估與學習發展的新趨勢。建基於上述分享，隨後的專題討論將深入探討培育21世紀技能的關鍵議題，人工智能在電子化全港性系統評估（e-TSA）中的未來發展方向。透過專業交流與知識分享，與會者將深入了解AI驅動教育在本地及全球背景下所帶來的機遇、挑戰及深遠影響。
AI不僅正在改變教與學的模式，更為教育評估開拓嶄新的可能性，塑造未來評估的新範式。以「人工智能時代下的評估與學習變革：從本地創新到全球影響力」為主題，本論壇旨在促進具啟發性的專業對話，加強跨界合作，共同推動評估與學習的持續創新與發展，迎接日益數碼化與互聯化的未來教育新格局。

en.objective: 為加強教師認識如何利用文物及考察活動設計教學，教育局邀請曾參與今年「陝豫隋唐文明教師考察之旅」的教師，分享考察所得、設計學習計劃，及在學校落實舉辦相關教學活動的經驗。是次分享會內容豐富，有助教師設計切合學生的參觀活動及課堂學習材料，加強學生認識中國歷史科及小學常識科/人文科的相關學習內容。
en.description: 請參閱附件。
en.background: 近年教育發展有多項的新趨勢，包括推廣文物歷史教育、數字教育、國安教育、跨學科學習、價值觀教育等等，博物館擁有豐富的資源可以配合，如能善加利用，可以優化及組織以上各項教育工作的推展，讓學生能在多元豐富的場景下，透過體驗式學習相關的範疇。教育局近年配合康樂及文化事務署「中國通史系列展覽」，與弘揚中華文化辦公室合作，先後舉辦了「河南夏商周三代文明教師考察之旅」、「陝西秦漢文明教師考察之旅」及「陝豫隋唐文明教師考察之旅」，參與教師均獲益良多，並利用參觀博物館及考察所得設計了不同的學習計劃，將有關的教育發展新範疇落實於日常教學活動之中。為加強教師認識如何利用文物及考察活動設計教學，特舉辦是次成果分享會，邀請參與的教師分享相關經驗。

en.objective: This webinar aims to strengthen teachers' capability in teaching AI and cyber security through providing information on cyber security, common cyber traps affecting youth, the security and risks of large language models (LLMs), and introducing related learning and teaching resources.
en.description: Please refer to the attached programme rundown for details.
en.background:
The Education Bureau (EDB) is actively promoting digital education in primary and secondary schools by strengthening students' ability to apply digital innovations, enhancing their media and information literacy, and nurturing them to become ethical users of technology in an era of rapid innovation and technological advancement.
To enhance teachers’ knowledge of emerging and advanced information technologies, technology-related crimes, cyberattacks, and data security, the Technology Education Section of the EDB and the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau (CSTCB) of the Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF) have jointly developed three editions of the “Cyber Security and Technology Crime Related Information” Learning and Teaching Resources, and launched the “CyberDefenders’ Alliance Card Game”. These initiatives aim to promote cyber security education and contribute to building a safer online environment.
The L&T resources have been uploaded to the EDB’s web page at https://www.edb.gov.hk/cybersecurity/en .

教育局積極推動中小學數字教育，致力提升學生應用數字創新的能力、加強其媒體和資訊素養，並培育他們在創新科技迅速發展的時代成為具備道德操守的科技使用者。
為進一步提升教師對新興及先進資訊科技、科技罪案、網絡攻擊及數據安全的認識，並支援教師引導學生正確使用互聯網，增強學生對人工智能及網絡安全的意識和應對能力，教育局科技教育組與香港警務處網絡安全及科技罪案調查科攜手編製三冊《網絡安全及科技罪案相關資訊》學與教資源，並推出「守網聯盟遊戲卡」。透過這些措施，共同推動網絡安全教育，攜手構建更安全的網絡環境。

en.objective:
(Chinese version only)
本課程旨在提升教師及校長推動國家安全教育的專業素養，加強他們對國家安全的整體認知，協助他們準確掌握《香港國安法》及《維護國家安全條例》的核心原則，在校園中以身作則、發揮楷模作用，做好國家安全教育，培育更多具備國家觀念與法治意識的未來棟樑，為國家和香港的繁榮發展作出貢獻。
en.description:
(Chinese version only)
本課程設有兩個專題，本節屬專題一「國家安全的法治框架」的三小時培訓，課堂內容如下：
內容包括闡述《憲法》與《基本法》如何奠定香港維護國安的憲制基礎與責任；解釋《香港國安法》及《維護國家安全條例》的立法／修訂原則、目標與特點；透過其他普通法國家的類似法律進行比較；詳細分析及說明與《香港國安法》及《維護國家安全條例》相關的案例；以及論述國家安全法律如何促進香港長遠發展，並平衡法治、人權等核心價值等。
一般情況下，參加者須準時出席及完成整個時長三小時的課程，並於課程結束後簽署「出席表格」，方可獲發相關培訓時數。參加者如遲到超逾三十分鐘，將視作缺席課程（即不會獲發放任何培訓時數）。
en.background:
(Chinese version only)
國家安全是安邦定國的重要基石。《香港國安法》和《維護國家安全條例》的制定與實施，既體現了中央政府對香港有關的國家安全事務負有根本責任，也彰顯了香港特別行政區切實履行維護國家安全的憲制責任。
為進一步強化教師及校長在維護國家安全方面的意識，教育局特別舉辦「維護國安」教師專題課程（下稱「課程」），並邀請不同專家擔任講者，就「國家安全的法治框架」及「國家安全的實踐與推行」兩大專題與參加教師及校長進行深入探討和互動交流，以協助他們準確掌握國家安全的核心原則，並提升其推動國家安全教育專業素養。

en.objective:
To help teachers:
1) acquire the knowledge of education innovations and pedagogies so as to be able to apply more appropriate teaching strategies and effective teaching methods in a small class context.
2) have a better understanding of the six principles* of small class teaching, and their competence in lesson design, lesson implementation and assessment literacy will be further enhanced so as to optimize the learning and teaching in a small class context.
3) foster their capacity in applying self-regulated learning and blended learning in a small class environment.
4) strengthen their pedagogical content knowledge and reflective capacity through lesson design and application of teaching strategies.
*Note：
The six principles are：(1) setting clear learning objectives; (2) making good use of effective questioning techniques; (3) encouraging active pupil participation; (4) increasing cooperation between/among pupils by pair/group work; (5) using more informing feedback; (6) adopting the assessment for learning approach to enhance learning and teaching

第三節：善用小班六大原則優化中文科聽、說、讀、寫的學與教
第四節：混合式教學在小班中國語文科的應用
第五節：匯報與反思課堂實踐

en.objective:
Upon completion of this programme, participants will be able to:
1. Identify key personal, policy, and organizational factors that influence educational innovation by applying established theoretical frameworks and key models of educational innovation to assess their impact on school-based change initiatives.
2. Examine and analyze structural, cultural, and psychological barriers to innovation in schools, evaluating their systemic roots through empirical research and theoretical perspectives.
3. Apply leadership skills to drive interdisciplinary curricular and pedagogical innovation, fostering collaboration among teachers.
4. Develop sustainable frameworks for cooperating, curating, and sharing disciplinary and cross-disciplinary instructional resources, ensuring alignment with institutional objectives and professional learning communities.
5. Adapt and reflect on innovation theories and practices to diverse school contexts, employing diagnostic tools to design equitable and context-sensitive solutions.

en.objective: The Analysis will provide aspiring principals with an initial gauge of their strengths and developmental needs so that they can assess their own suitability for principalship. It also helps them design a meaningful personal professional development plan to realise their leadership potential. The Analysis Process involves three stages: (1) Pre-Analysis, (2) Analysis and (3) Ongoing Development.
en.description:
The Needs Analysis Process involves a number of stages:
(1)Pre-Analysis - Once enrolled, the aspiring principals will be introduced to the purpose and details of the course and asked to complete a questionnaire in preparation for the Analysis in the next stage.
(2)Analysis - It is divided into three sections:
(a) Getting Started
(b) Observing & Interacting
(c) Discussing & Planning
(3)Ongoing Development - At the end of the Analysis, the participants will be given a Leadership Development Journal. This journal provides a platform for the participants to record their self reflection and progress, and engage them in ongoing leadership development.
en.background:
As announced in EDB Circular No. 1/2024 dated 26 February 2024, with effect from the 2004/05 school year, aspiring principals have to attain the 'Certification for Principalship' (CFP) requirement in addition to complying with the appointment conditions in force at the time, before they can be considered for appointment to principalship in public sector or DSS schools^. This course is one of the components of the CFP process.
(^For details, please refer to the EDB Circular No. 1/2024.)

zh.objective:
「擬任校長專業發展需要分析」的主要目的是讓擬任校長對自己的長處及發展需要初步了解，從而評估自己是否適合擔任校長。此外，擬任校長亦可藉此為自己設計一個有意義的個人專業發展計劃，發展自己的領導潛能。
「擬任校長專業發展需要分析」共分三個階段：(1)分析前準備、(2)分析及(3)持續發展。
zh.description:
「擬任校長專業發展需要分析」共分為幾個階段:
(1)分析前準備 : 當獲得錄取後，擬任校長會收到課程目標大綱及內容，亦會收到問卷。透過對問題的回應，為第二階段的「分析」作準備。
(2)分析：分三個階段:
(a)開始
(b)視察與互動
(c)討論與計劃
(3)持續的活動：在分析當日活動完成後，參與者會獲得領才發展日誌。這日誌可用作發展個人的平台，作為持續領才發展的紀錄。
zh.background:
教育局在2024年2月26日發出的第1/2024號通告中闡明，校長資格認證的要求已由2004/05學年起實施。擬任校長必須獲得校長資格認證及符合有關的聘任條件，才會獲考慮聘任為公營或直接資助計劃學校的校長^。這個課程是校長資格認證其中的一部分。
(^詳情請參閱教育局通告第1/2024號)

en.objective:
• To introduce “2026 HKAEE (Schools Sector)” and “2026 Best Green Education Initiative Award”
• To learn from the experience of the award-winning schools in implementing environmental management measures and environmental education
• To encourage teachers to promote environmental education / education for sustainable development through a “whole-school participation” approach
en.background: Funded by the Environment and Conservation Fund and supported by the Education Bureau, the “Hong Kong Awards for Environmental Excellence” has been led by the Environmental Campaign Committee (ECC), together with the Environment and Ecology Bureau (EEB) and in conjunction with nine organisations. Since its launch in 2008, the HKAEE is one of the prestigious and reputable award schemes in Hong Kong. The Award covers various sectors, including the Schools Sector, which aims to recognise participating schools’ efforts in environmental management and environmental education, and to commend schools with excellent environmental achievements. In addition, there are separate awards for the Schools Sector, i.e. the “Best Green Education Initiative Award” and the newly introduced “Environmental Education @ Community Award” (Applicable to secondary schools) starting from this school year. In addition to experience sharing activities and visits to past award-winning schools, the HKAEE (Schools Sector) also offers “Facilitator Support Service”, which participating schools may apply for the service to receive guidance and advice, thereby supporting them in developing sustainable campuses. For more details about the award schemes, please visit the ECC’s Schools Go Green website (https://school.ecc.org.hk/en/programmes/hkaee.html).

zh.objective:
• 簡介「2026香港環境卓越大奬（學校界別）」及「2026最佳環境教育方案大獎」
• 分享得獎學校在推行校園環境管理措施及環境教育的經驗和心得
• 鼓勵教師以「全校參與」模式實踐環境教育／可持續發展教育
zh.background: 「香港環境卓越大獎」自2008年起由環境運動委員會（環運會）聯同環境及生態局及九個機構合辦，並由環境及自然保育基金資助及獲教育局支持，是香港具代表性及公信力的環保奬勵計劃。獎項涵蓋不同界別，當中學校界別旨在肯定參與學校在環境管理及環境教育方面的努力，表揚有卓越環保成就的學校。此外，學校界別另設「最佳環境教育方案大獎」及由本學年起增設的「環境教育@社區大獎」（中學適用）。除經驗分享、參觀過往得獎學校等活動，香港環境卓越大獎（學校界別）亦設有「協導員支援服務」，供參賽學校申請，以接受指導及建議，協助學校建立可持續發展校園。獎項計劃詳情請參閱環運會綠色學校天地網站（https://school.ecc.org.hk/tc/programmes/hkaee.html）。

en.objective: 「領航計劃」學員研習方向廣泛，涵蓋各個重要的學校發展範疇，例如在學校領導與管理方面，着重領導效能、團隊建設及學校持續發展；在課程發展方面，關注校本課程、跨學科學習及課程銜接；在學與教創新方面，探討人工智能、數位學習、探究學習及評估策略的應用；在教師專業發展方面，重視專業協作、學習社群及教研文化；在學生培育方面，則涵蓋價值觀教育、家國情懷、文化素養及全人發展。整體而言，各項研究從學校治理、課程教學、教師成長及學生發展等不同層面，回應學校發展的實際需要。
en.description: 第二期「領航計劃」領航校長將擔任講者，並分別主持兩節各70分鐘的分享環節，詳情請參閱附件。
en.background: 教育局於2024/25學年，以先導形式推行「領航教師及校長培訓計劃」(下稱「領航計劃」)，旨在發掘和培養具堅定的專業信念和使命、願意不斷學習教學新知、積極探究創新策略且具優秀潛質的教師和校長，透過擔任領航導師的內地專家教師專業指導，配合香港教師研修及交流基地的專業資源，使他們從勝任走向優秀、從優秀走向卓越，以壯大香港教師和校長專業團隊，提升專業力量，為香港和國家作出貢獻。本次活動旨在總結及展示第二期參與者學習成果，並為教育工作者提供專業交流平台。
en.cpd:
持續專業發展模式:
有系統的學習
持續專業發展時數:
2.5 小時
持續專業發展範疇:
I. 教與學
III. 學校發展
en.contentArea: - 領導策略(一般管理技巧)

en.objective:
擔任學校的中層領導並不容易，不單要處理日常的教學工作，同時必須肩負一定的行政職務，以及領導不同的功能小組。這個課程將協助學員：
• 明瞭學校中層領導人員的角色及職責；
• 獲取及增進中層領導的實用策略和技能，以處理日常事務；
• 了解香港學校分散式資源管理及財務方面的趨勢；
• 探討人力及財務資源管理在學校改進方面的全球趨勢與方向；
• 了解學校人力資源管理的正確程序； 及
• 了解人力資源管理的挑戰及相關對策。

「投訴來信不用愁，回信得體解煩憂。」課程助你學習以精準的文字化解危機，讓你的公文變身溝通藝術：

en.objective:
This introductory workshop is designed for teachers interested in using public speaking as a vehicle to develop students’ English abilities. It will give participants the opportunity to deepen their knowledge and share ideas related to public speaking in the school’s curriculum by engaging in activities which highlight skills paramount to the development of good public speakers. It will also provide opportunities to spark ideas which could then be used for the upcoming competition.
In this workshop, participants will:
be exposed to creative strategies which encourage motivation and enthusiasm in a range of speaking activities;
engage in a variety of structures which support the development of written scripts;
explore ways in which the teaching of public speaking addresses the English language curriculum; and
share practical ideas and activities which consolidate student learning and cater for a diverse range of students.
Note: Please dress comfortably for some drama-based speaking activities.
This course is open to teachers of private schools in Hong Kong who do not have e-Services accounts and teachers teaching Hong Kong curriculum in schools in the GBA Mainland cities*. Teachers of these schools wishing to apply for the course should contact Ms Alice LEUNG at 3549 8315/ rnctnet@edb.gov.hk.
*The schools should meet the following criteria:
A. The schools have joined the “Scheme of Classes for Hong Kong Students” in Shenzhen; or
B. The schools have submitted their curriculum documents to the Education Bureau of Hong Kong, and been recognised to be offering subject curricula which are generally in line with the curriculum requirements of the respective subjects in Hong Kong.

Through the “CyberDefenders’ Alliance Card Game” launched together with CSTCB of HKPF, EDB and Digital Policy Office, this workshop helps teachers experience and use card game to enhance students' digital literacy, fraud prevention and cyber security awareness.
en.description: Please refer to the attached programme rundown for details.
en.background:
The Education Bureau (EDB) is actively promoting digital education in primary and secondary schools by strengthening students' ability to apply digital innovations, enhancing their media and information literacy, and nurturing them to become ethical users of technology in an era of rapid innovation and technological advancement.
To enhance teachers’ knowledge of emerging and advanced information technologies, technology-related crimes, cyberattacks, and data security, the Technology Education Section of the EDB and the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau (CSTCB) of the Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF) have jointly developed three editions of the “Cyber Security and Technology Crime Related Information” Learning and Teaching Resources, and launched the “CyberDefenders’ Alliance Card Game”. These initiatives aim to promote cyber security education and contribute to building a safer online environment.
The L&T resources have been uploaded to the EDB’s web page at https://www.edb.gov.hk/cybersecurity/en .

zh.background:
教育局積極推動中小學數字教育，致力提升學生應用數字創新的能力、加強其媒體和資訊素養，並培育他們在創新科技迅速發展的時代成為具備道德操守的科技使用者。
為進一步提升教師對新興及先進資訊科技、科技罪案、網絡攻擊及數據安全的認識，並支援教師引導學生正確使用互聯網，增強學生對人工智能及網絡安全的意識和應對能力，教育局科技教育組與香港警務處網絡安全及科技罪案調查科攜手編製三冊《網絡安全及科技罪案相關資訊》學與教資源，並推出「守網聯盟遊戲卡」。透過這些措施，共同推動網絡安全教育，攜手構建更安全的網絡環境。
相關教學資源已上載至教育局網頁 https://www.edb.gov.hk/cybersecurity 。

en.background:
From the 2004/05 school year, aspiring principals (APs) have to attain the Certification for Principalship (CFP) in addition to complying with the appointment conditions in force at the time, before they could be considered for appointment to principalship in public sector or DSS schools. The CFP is valid for five years counting from the expiry of the two-year CFP process or the issue date of the CFP, whichever is the later.
APs whose CFP has expired are still eligible for appointment to principalship. Upon appointment as principals, they will serve on an acting basis for two years. During this period, the acting principals so appointed must renew their CFP before the principalship can be confirmed.
To renew the CFP, the newly appointed principals are required to demonstrate leadership in the school situation through the submission of a school development portfolio.

zh.objective:
1. 簡介校長資格認證續期安排；
2. 簡介學校發展資料冊的要求；及
3. 討論撰寫學校發展資料冊的常見問題。
zh.description:
活動的內容包括：
1. 校長資格認證續期安排；
2. 學校發展資料冊的要求；
3. 分組討論及分析學校發展資料冊撮要；及
4. 問與答。
zh.background:
由二零零四／零五學年起，擬任校長必須獲得「校長資格認證」(「認證」)及符合有關的聘任條件，才會獲考慮聘任為公營或直接資助計劃學校的校長。「認證」的有效期為五年，由為期兩年的「認證」程序結束，或發出「認證」當日起計算(以較後者為準)。
「認證」有效期已經屆滿的擬任校長，仍有資格獲聘為校長。不過，他們獲聘為校長時，須以兩年署任期的條件受聘，在署任期間辦妥「認證」續期。
辦理「認證」續期時，新任校長須提交學校發展資料冊，以展示他們領導學校的專業能力。

en.objective: 是次培訓活動為 「史智承傳」系列本地必修課程(A1) ，旨在透過教育局代表的分享及說明，豐富中國歷史科教師對初中中國歷史科課程的宗旨、目標、課程大綱及學習內容重點的理解及掌握，並了解中國歷史教育新近發展方向，從而提升教師在中國歷史教育的專業能力，並提高學與教效能。
en.description: 請參閱附件。
en.background:
《行政長官2024年施政報告》提出「由2024/25學年起三年內為約1 000位非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師提供培訓名額」。就此，教育局現舉辦「史智承傳：非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師專業發展」計劃（簡稱「史智承傳」），支援非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師接受相關專業發展培訓，以提升教師在中國歷史教育的專業能力，強化學與教效能，以加強培養學生的國民身份認同。
「史智承傳」系列的專業發展課程涵蓋本地課程及內地考察兩個範疇，各範疇內容如下：
A. 本地課程（共12小時）：
1. 初中中國歷史科課程詮釋（必修，3小時）
2. 博物館參觀或歷史考察（必修，3小時）
3. 知識增益 / 教學策略（選修：任選兩個課程，6小時）
B. 內地考察：廣州考察（兩天一晚） * 包括簡介會及講座（必修，18小時）
凡完成30小時「史智承傳」系列專業發展計劃的教師，將獲頒發完成證書。
詳情可參看教育局通函第124/2026號：
https://applications.edb.gov.hk/circular/upload/EDBCM/EDBCM26124C.pdf

en.objective:
• To introduce “2026 HKAEE (Schools Sector)”, “2026 Best Green Education Initiative Award” and “Environmental Education @ Community Award (2026/27 School Year)”
• To learn from the experience of the award-winning schools in implementing environmental management measures and environmental education
• To encourage teachers to promote environmental education / education for sustainable development through a “whole-school participation” approach
en.background: Funded by the Environment and Conservation Fund and supported by the Education Bureau, the “Hong Kong Awards for Environmental Excellence” has been led by the Environmental Campaign Committee (ECC), together with the Environment and Ecology Bureau (EEB) and in conjunction with nine organisations. Since its launch in 2008, the HKAEE is one of the prestigious and reputable award schemes in Hong Kong. The Award covers various sectors, including the Schools Sector, which aims to recognise participating schools’ efforts in environmental management and environmental education, and to commend schools with excellent environmental achievements. In addition, there are separate awards for the Schools Sector, i.e. the “Best Green Education Initiative Award” and the newly introduced “Environmental Education @ Community Award” (Applicable to Secondary Schools) starting from this school year. In addition to experience sharing activities and visits to past award-winning schools, the HKAEE (Schools Sector) also offers “Facilitator Support Service”, which participating schools may apply for the service to receive guidance and advice, thereby supporting them in developing sustainable campuses. For more details about the award schemes, please visit the ECC’s Schools Go Green website (https://school.ecc.org.hk/en/programmes/hkaee.html).

zh.objective:
• 簡介「2026香港環境卓越大奬（學校界別）」、「2026最佳環境教育方案大獎」及「環境教育@社區大獎（2026/27學年）」
• 分享得獎學校在推行校園環境管理措施及環境教育的經驗和心得
• 鼓勵教師以「全校參與」模式實踐環境教育／可持續發展教育
zh.background: 「香港環境卓越大獎」自2008年起由環境運動委員會（環運會）聯同環境及生態局及九個機構合辦，並由環境及自然保育基金資助及獲教育局支持，是香港具代表性及公信力的環保奬勵計劃。獎項涵蓋不同界別，當中學校界別旨在肯定參與學校在環境管理及環境教育方面的努力，表揚有卓越環保成就的學校。此外，學校界別另設「最佳環境教育方案大獎」及由本學年起增設的「環境教育@社區大獎」（中學適用）。除經驗分享、參觀過往得獎學校等活動，香港環境卓越大獎（學校界別）亦設有「協導員支援服務」，供參賽學校申請，以接受指導及建議，協助學校建立可持續發展校園。獎項計劃詳情請參閱環運會綠色學校天地網站（https://school.ecc.org.hk/tc/programmes/hkaee.html）。

en.objective: This course aims to assist newly-joined teachers to understand their professional roles and demonstrate professional conduct and values.
en.description:
The content of this course includes "T-standard + " : Professional Standards for Teachers of Hong Kong, teachers’ professional conduct and relevant guidelines, etc.
After successful completion of the course, newly-joined teachers' (i.e. full-time teachers appointed to teach in public sector or DSS schools from the 2020/21 school year) training hours will be recorded under the "core training" of newly-joined teachers. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDB Circular No. 6/2020 and EDB Circular No. 29/2024 .
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) Circular No. 6/2020 issued on June 10, 2020 announced the establishment of Professional Ladder for Teachers and relevant measures. A training programme has been developed to help newly-joined teachers understand their professional roles, demonstrate professional values and conduct, and keep abreast of the latest developments in education policies. Starting from the 2020/21 school year, teachers appointed to teach in public sector or DSS schools for the first time are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs.

en.objective: The seminar aims to enhance kindergarten teachers’ and school administrators’ understanding of the relationship between children’s executive function and social-emotional health. It also equips participants with practical strategies to promote children’s executive skills through games, thereby fostering their social and emotional well-being.
en.description:
The seminar will cover the following key areas:
1) The relationship between executive function and children’s social and emotional well-being
2) Ways to enhance children’s executive skills, particularly response inhibition, through games and by incorporating game elements into daily classroom routines
Course Remarks
Participants will receive the following printed resources on the day of the seminar:
1) “SEES” game kits
2) “SEES” teaching materials
The link to the “SEES” online resource hub will be shared during the seminar. The hub currently includes the picture book “SEES: Response Inhibition”, game kits, and a variety of teaching materials, and will be updated continuously. Participants who use the game kits and complete the feedback questionnaire will receive complimentary teaching materials. Details will be announced on the day of the seminar.
en.background:
Preschool is an important period for the development of children’s executive function. Strong executive skills help foster social and emotional well-being and lay the foundation for children’ affective and social development.
To support teachers in nurturing children’s social and emotional well-being, the Education Bureau will launch the “SEES - Nurturing Children’s Social and Emotional Well-Being through Enhancing Executive Skills” programme starting from the 2026/27 school year. Through a series of seminars and an online resource hub, the programme aims to equip teachers with strategies to enhance children’s executive skills and promote their social and emotional well-being.

zh.objective: 講座旨在提升幼稚園教師及學校管理人員對執行功能與幼兒社交情緒健康關係的理解，並讓參加者掌握如何透過遊戲促進幼兒的執行技巧，從而培育幼兒的社交情緒健康。
zh.description:
講座將涵蓋以下重點內容：
1) 執行功能與幼兒社交情緒健康的關係
2) 如何通過遊戲及將遊戲元素融入課室日常，強化幼兒的執行技巧，特別是反應抑制
課程備註
參加者將於講座當日獲發以下印製資源：
a. 「心靈小跑車」遊戲包
b. 「心靈小跑車」教學資源
「心靈小跑車」網上資源庫連結將於講座發布。資源庫現已收錄《心靈小跑車：反應抑制篇》繪本、遊戲包及多元教學資源，並將持續更新。凡使用遊戲包並填寫回饋問卷者，即可獲贈精美教材，詳情將於講座當日公布。
zh.background:
學前階段是幼兒執行功能發展的重要期。良好的執行技巧有助促進社交情緒健康，為幼兒的情意和群性發展奠定基礎。
為支援學校教職員培育幼兒的社交情緒健康，教育局於2026/27學年起推行「心靈小跑車：提升執行技巧以培育幼兒社交情緒健康」計劃。本計劃會透過舉辦系列講座及網上資源庫，協助學校教職員掌握提升執行技巧的策略，共同促進幼兒的社交情緒健康。

en.description: Please refer to the attached programme rundown for details.
en.background:
The Education Bureau (EDB) is actively promoting digital education in primary and secondary schools by strengthening students' ability to apply digital innovations, enhancing their media and information literacy, and nurturing them to become ethical users of technology in an era of rapid innovation and technological advancement.
To enhance teachers’ knowledge of emerging and advanced information technologies, technology-related crimes, cyberattacks, and data security, the Technology Education Section of the EDB and the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau (CSTCB) of the Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF) have jointly developed three editions of the “Cyber Security and Technology Crime Related Information” Learning and Teaching Resources, and launched the “CyberDefenders’ Alliance Card Game”. These initiatives aim to promote cyber security education and contribute to building a safer online environment.
The L&T resources have been uploaded to the EDB’s web page at https://www.edb.gov.hk/cybersecurity/en .

en.objective: This course aims to introduce the fundamental theories and practical applications of artificial intelligence in inquiry-based learning for Primary Science. It supports teachers in implementing relevant teaching strategies, making effective use of AI to facilitate students’ science inquiry process, enhance classroom interaction, and promote assessment for learning.
en.description:
This course is a three-hour seminar-cum-workshop that integrates the fundamental theories and practical experiences of incorporating artificial intelligence into inquiry-based science learning. The content includes:
- AI-assisted learning processes in Primary Science
- AI-facilitated interactive dialogues in Primary Science
- AI-supported assessment applications in Primary Science
en.background:
To support the implementation of Primary Science, the EDB continues to provide a series of support measures for primary teachers. “Science Inquiry”, one of the emphases of the Science (Primary 1 - 6) Curriculum, emphasises allowing students to seek answers and discover knowledge through exploration using scientific methods, thereby cultivating their curiosity and spirit of inquiry.
Launched in 2024, JC CoolScience is initiated and funded by The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust, in partnership with the Education University of Hong Kong. In alignment with the implementation of the Primary Science curriculum and the promotion of inquiry-based learning (IBL), JC CoolScience supports Primary Science teachers in facilitating high-quality inquiry-based learning and enhances students’ experiential science learning in and beyond the classroom through professional development programmes, the “Advanced Teacher Fellowship” training, and Community of Practice activities.

zh.objective: 本課程旨在分享人工智能在小學科學探究式學習中的的基礎理論與實際應用，協助教師實踐相關的教學策略，善用AI輔助學生科學探究歷程，提升課堂互動，並促進學習評估。
zh.description:
本課程為三小時的講座暨工作坊，結合人工智能融入科學探究式學習的基礎理論與實踐經驗。內容包括：
- AI輔助小學科學學習歷程
- AI促進小學科學互動對話
- AI支持小學科學評估應用
zh.background:
為配合小學科學科的推展，教育局持續為小學教師提供一系列支援措施。「科學探究」作為《科學（小一至小六）課程指引》的課程重點之一，強調讓學生運用科學的方法進行探究，尋找答案和發現知識，從而培養他們的好奇心和探究精神。
為配合小學科學科的推展，並推廣探究式學習 (Inquiry-Based Learning)，「賽馬會探索科學計劃」於2024年啟動。計劃由香港賽馬會慈善信託基金策劃及捐助，香港教育大學為策略夥伴，透過教師專業培訓、「先鋒教師培訓」及教學社群活動，支援小學科學教師實踐高質的探究式學習。同時，計劃透過貫通課堂內外的體驗式學習，提升小學科學教師的學與教效能。

en.objective:
The programme aims to improve teachers’ knowledge and skills in the teaching of English in primary and secondary schools in Hong Kong, with a particular focus on teaching grammar in context through text-based, meaning-focused pedagogy and the principled and responsible use of generative AI to support learning and teaching. It will focus on areas of English language knowledge and skills relevant to the current needs of teachers in the local school sector, with particular emphasis on the implementation of recent updates in the English Language curriculum, and on emerging developments in educational technology and assessment practices.
Upon completion of the programme, participants should be able to:
1. Review and reflect on the current practices of grammar teaching in context in English classrooms in Hong Kong and make informed pedagogical improvements;
2. Develop an understanding of updated strategies of English language teaching and learning, including how to evaluate, adapt and integrate AI-supported resources to enhance learning while ensuring accuracy, learner appropriateness and alignment with learning purposes; and
3. Design and trial practical ideas, activities and resources (including AI-supported materials where appropriate) to help students develop English, and to support responsible AI use (e.g., transparency, privacy and academic honesty) in classroom learning.

en.objective: The online self-learning course aims to familiarise teachers with the use of Chinese Language Curriculum Second Language Learning Framework, Chinese Language Assessment Tools for NCS students and diversified learning and teaching resources to help NCS speaking students learn Chinese progressively.
en.description:
This is a refreshed course, the main contents include:
Topic (1): Curriculum planning / Learning and teaching strategy
Topic (2): Learning and teaching resources
Topic (3): Chinese Language Assessment Tools for Non-Chinese Speaking Students
en.background: Starting from the 2014/15 school year, the Education Bureau provides schools with the “Chinese Language Curriculum Second Language Learning Framework”. The Learning Framework has provided steps and methods for learning and teaching, and assessment according to the needs of NCS students of learning Chinese as a second language. With reference to the Learning Framework, teachers can set learning targets, learning progress and expected learning outcomes on reading, writing, listening and speaking, as well as adapt and develop teaching materials at the school-based level for NCS students with different starting points and abilities, so as to help them learn Chinese progressively.

en.objective: This Thematic Course aims at enhancing teachers’ competency in teaching students with ‘Behavioural, Emotional and Social Development Needs’ (BESDN), focusing on the needs of students with Autistic Spectrum Disorder (ASD). Emphasis will be put on both theoretical and practical aspects. Participants will further review the characteristics, educational needs, support strategies, curriculum accommodation, teaching resources, behaviour management, team collaboration and community support for students with ASD. On completion of the course, participants will be able to apply the necessary professional knowledge and skills in catering for students with ASD.
en.description: The Course will last for 60 contact hours in total. Participants should submit the written assignment tasks required by the Course before the submission deadline.
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) is committed to implementing integrated education so as to cater for students with Special Educational Needs (SEN) in ordinary schools. Teacher training is one of the key factors for catering for students with SEN effectively. To enhance teachers’ capacity in catering for students with SEN, EDB provides the Basic, Advanced and Thematic (BAT) Courses for in-service teachers.

zh.objective: 本專題課程目的是提高教師教導「行為、情緒及社群發展需要」學生的能力 (針對自閉症學生的需要)。課程內容將會理論與實踐並重，學員會更深入地探討有自閉症的學生的特徵、教育需要、支援策略、課程調適、教學資源、行為處理、團隊協作及社區支援等課題。修畢課程後，學員將可以應用有關的專業知識及技巧，照顧有自閉症的學生。
zh.description: 本課程共60小時。學員須於限定時間前按課程要求完成及呈交課業。
zh.background: 教育局致力推動融合教育，以照顧普通學校有特殊教育需要的學生。教師培訓是有效照顧有特殊教育需要學生的關鍵因素之一。為提升教師教導有特殊教育需要學生的專業能力，教育局為在職教師舉辦基礎、高級及專題課程 (三層課程) 。

en.objective: This Thematic Course aims at enhancing teachers’ competency in teaching students with ‘Cognition and Learning Needs’(CLN), focusing on academically low achievers (ALAs) including those with Intellectual Developmental Disorder (IDD). Emphasis will be put on both theoretical and practical aspects such as designing and conducting intervention plans and developing corresponding learning materials. Participants will further review the methods of identifying the learning characteristics of ALAs, including students with IDD and how the acquired educational strategies and skills will benefit these students and other students. On completion of the course, participants will be able to apply the necessary professional knowledge and skills in catering for ALAs including students with IDD.
en.description: The Course will last for 60 contact hours in total. Participants should submit the written assignment tasks required by the Course before the submission deadline.
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) is committed to implementing integrated education so as to cater for students with special educational needs (SEN) in ordinary schools. Teacher training is one of the key factors for catering for students with SEN effectively. To enhance teachers’ capacity in catering for students with SEN, EDB provides the Basic, Advanced and Thematic (BAT) Courses for in-service teachers.

en.objective:
(1) To apply and practise the knowledge and skills on early identification and handling of suspected child abuse cases through case studies; and
(2) To strengthen participants’ ability in formulating and implementing practical strategies for following up on suspected child abuse cases.
en.description: Drawing on the scenarios in secondary schools, the workshops enable participants to analyse suspected child abuse cases by using decision trees. Through case discussions, role-plays and other relevant activities, participants gain an understanding of the principles and strategies of child protection work, the mandatory reporting of child abuse regime, multi-disciplinary procedures for handling suspected child abuse cases, as well as community resources on child protection and respective family support services.
en.background: The Mandatory Reporting of Child Abuse Ordinance came into effect on 20 January 2026. To facilitate specified professionals in schools in fulfilling their statutory obligations, the Education Bureau organises workshops for school personnel to help participants, through case studies, identify cases that are subject to mandatory reporting and enhance their understanding of how such cases can be supported and followed up through a multi‑disciplinary collaborative approach.

en.objective:
•To introduce “2026 HKAEE (Schools Sector)” and “2026 Best Green Education Initiative Award”
•To learn from the experience of the award-winning schools in implementing environmental management measures and environmental education
•To encourage teachers to promote environmental education / education for sustainable development through a “whole-school participation” approach
en.background: Funded by the Environment and Conservation Fund and supported by the Education Bureau, the “Hong Kong Awards for Environmental Excellence” (HKAEE) has been led by the Environmental Campaign Committee (ECC), together with the Environment and Ecology Bureau (EEB) and in conjunction with nine organisations. Since its launch in 2008, the HKAEE is one of the prestigious and reputable award schemes in Hong Kong. The Award covers various sectors, including the Schools Sector, which aims to recognise participating schools’ efforts in environmental management and environmental education, and to commend schools with excellent environmental achievements. In addition, there are separate awards for the Schools Sector, i.e. the “Best Green Education Initiative Award” and the newly introduced “Environmental Education @ Community Award” (Applicable to secondary schools) starting from this school year. In addition to experience sharing activities and visits to past award-winning schools, the HKAEE (Schools Sector) also offers “Facilitator Support Service”, which participating schools may apply for to receive guidance and advice, thereby supporting them in developing sustainable campuses. For more details about the award schemes, please visit the ECC’s Schools Go Green website (https://school.ecc.org.hk/en/programmes/hkaee.html).

zh.objective:
•簡介「2026香港環境卓越大奬（學校界別）」及「2026最佳環境教育方案大獎」
•分享得獎學校在推行校園環境管理措施及環境教育的經驗和心得

zh.background: 「香港環境卓越大獎」自2008年起由環境運動委員會（環運會）聯同環境及生態局及九個機構合辦，並由環境及自然保育基金資助及獲教育局支持，是香港具代表性及公信力的環保奬勵計劃。獎項涵蓋不同界別，當中學校界別旨在肯定參與學校在環境管理及環境教育方面的努力，表揚有卓越環保成就的學校。此外，學校界別另設「最佳環境教育方案大獎」及由本學年起增設的「環境教育@社區大獎」（中學適用）。除經驗分享、參觀過往得獎學校等活動，香港環境卓越大獎（學校界別）亦設有「協導員支援服務」，供參賽學校申請，以接受指導及建議，協助學校建立可持續發展校園。獎項計劃詳情請參閱環運會綠色學校天地網站（https://school.ecc.org.hk/tc/programmes/hkaee.html）。

To help schools understand NCS students’ overall progress on Chinese reading and writing with reference to the Assessment Tools and equip teachers with the skills to assess their NCS students' Chinese language learning progress and set appropriate learning targets, as well as the effective learning and teaching strategies to enhance NCS students’ learning effectiveness of the Chinese language. 2. To share with participants the school-based experiences in supporting NCS students and NCS-SEN students in learning Chinese and creating an inclusive learning environment in schools with the effective use of the CSG.
en.description: Education Support for NCS Students and NCS students with special educational needs
en.background: The Government is committed to encouraging and supporting the integration of NCS students into the community, including facilitating their early adaptation to the local education system and mastery of the Chinese language. The Government ensures NCS students, like their Chinese-speaking peers, enjoy equal opportunities for admission to public sector schools and for learning Chinese. Education Bureau (EDB) has, since the 2014/15 school year, implemented the “Chinese Language Curriculum Second Language Learning Framework” ("Learning Framework”) in primary and secondary schools. EDB has also increased the additional funding to schools admitting NCS students to enhance the support for NCS students in learning Chinese and create an inclusive learning environment in schools. Coupled with the provision of the “Learning Framework”, EDB has provided schools with the Chinese Language Assessment Tools for NCS students (Assessment Tools) in conjunction with the “Learning Framework” to help schools assess the learning performance of NCS students and set appropriate learning targets for them. In this connection, EDB has commissioned HKU to conduct analysis on NCS students’ overall learning progress in Chinese by making reference to the results based on the Assessment Tools. Starting from the 2026/27 school year, the Additional Funding for Enhancing Support for Learning and Teaching Chinese for Non-Chinese Speaking Students and the Grant for Supporting Non-Chinese Speaking Students with Special Educational Needs are integrated as CSG . CSG aims to support NCS students in learning Chinese and create an inclusive learning environment in schools, as well as strengthen communication with parents of NCS students and home-school cooperation, including the emotional, communication and social support for NCS students with SEN, to enhance their effectiveness in Chinese learning. Details of the arrangement are stipulated in EDB Circular No. 4/2026.
