zh.objective: 1. 讓學校了解採用《評估工具》所得的非華語學生中文讀寫能力整體進展，協助教師評估非華語學生的中文學習進展，從而因應學生的學習需要，訂定適切的學習目標及有效的學與教策略，以提升非華語學生學習中文的效能。 2. 與參加者分享有效運用綜合支援津貼，支援非華語學生及有特殊教育需要的非華語學生學習中文和建構共融校園的校本經驗。
zh.description: 非華語學生及有特殊教育需要的非華語學生的教育支援
zh.background: 政府致力鼓勵及支援非華語學生融入社會，包括幫助他們盡早適應本地教育體系及學好中文，並確保非華語學生與華語同儕享有同等機會入讀公營學校和學習中文。教育局由2014/15學年開始，在中小學實施「中國語文課程第二語言學習架構」（「學習架構」），並增加錄取非華語學生學校的額外撥款，以加強支援非華語學生學習中文和建構共融校園。提供「學習架構」的同時，教育局已為學校提供緊扣「學習架構」的《中國語文校內評估工具 ─ 非華語學生適用》（《評估工具》），以助學校評估非華語學生的中文學習表現和訂定適切的學習目標。就此，教育局委託香港大學分析非華語學生按《評估工具》在中文學習的整體進展。由2026/27學年起，「加強支援非華語學生的中文學與教額外撥款」及「有特殊教育需要非華語學生支援津貼」合併為「非華語學生綜合支援津貼」（綜合支援津貼） ，以支援非華語學生學習中文及建構共融校園，包括加強與非華語學生家長的溝通和家校合作，以及協助學校加強為有特殊教育需要的非華語學生提供情緒、溝通及社交方面的支援，提升中文學習效能。有關詳情載於教育局通告第4/2026號。

en.objective:
1.To establish a platform for communication between Chinese scientists and Hong Kong schools, and to facilitate the promotion of popular science education.
2.To broaden teachers' horizons in space science and I&T and their educational applications.
3. To continuously promote exchanges between Chinese scientists and Hong Kong schools.
en.description:
The Alliance has organised the “Science and Technology Innovation Lecture” in cooperation with the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) since 2019. Each year, the Lecture invites distinguished academicians and scholars from the CAS to visit primary and secondary schools in Hong Kong and deliver popular science talks on their research fields, enhancing students’ interest in scientific research and understanding of related technological developments.
To promote teachers’ understanding of the latest research developments, the Alliance has organised the “Future Hong Kong” International STEM Education Forum since 2023. This year marks the fourth Forum, themed “Chasing Space Dreams, Nurturing Science Talent” and focusing on space science and technology. Academicians of the CAS and scholars from overseas and Hong Kong will share frontier developments and their relevance to education and I&T learning.
This course covers the 2026 “Science and Technology Innovation Lecture” Launching Ceremony and the keynote speeches of the fourth “Future Hong Kong” International STEM Education Forum.
en.background:
To align with the strategy of invigorating the country through science and education and developing Hong Kong into an international innovation and technology (I&T) hub for nurturing talent, the Education Bureau (EDB) has been stepping up the promotion of STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, the Arts and Mathematics) education and digital education in primary and secondary schools. The EDB continues to incorporate I&T learning elements into both the primary and secondary school curricula to strengthen students’ interest and abilities in information technology and I&T, broadening the horizons of both teachers and students.
The Hong Kong STEM Education Alliance (the “Alliance”) is our valuable collaboration partner in promoting STEAM education. Established in 2018, the Alliance aims to promote and lead the development of science and technology innovation education in Hong Kong. With a vision of Hong Kong becoming an international I&T hub, the Alliance nurtures scientific and technological talent.

zh.objective:
1.建立中國科學家與香港學校的聯繫平台，推廣科普教育
2.拓寬教師對航天科學與創新科技及其教育應用的視野
3.持續推動中國科學家與香港學校的交流
zh.description:
聯盟自2019年起與中國科學院合作舉辦「科創大講堂」，每年邀請中國科學院院士專家，走進香港中小學校園進行科普講座，普及其研究領域的科學知識，增加學生對科研的興趣和相關技術發展的了解。
此外，為促進教師了解學界研究的前沿發展，聯盟自2023年起舉辦「未來香江」國際科創教育論壇。今年為第四屆，以「築夢航天 科教育才」為主題，聚焦航天科學與科技，邀請中國科學院院士及海外、香港學者分享相關前沿發展，以及其與教育和創新科技學習的關聯。
本課程涵蓋2026「科學與中國」走進「科創大講堂」啟動儀式及第四屆「未來香江」國際科創教育論壇的主題演講。
zh.background:
配合科教興國大方向，以及本港發展為國際創科中心，培育人才，教育局於中小學大力推動STEAM（科學、科技、工程、藝術和數學）教育及數字教育，普及創新科技學習，培養創新精神。我們持續在中小學課程加入創科學習元素，加強學生學習資訊科技和創新科技的興趣和能力，並拓寬師生的視野。
香港科技創新教育聯盟（下稱「聯盟」）是我們推動STEAM教育的良好協作伙伴。聯盟成立於2018年，旨在推動和引領香港科技創新教育發展，亦為香港未來發展成國際創科中心，培養科技人才。

en.objective: To enrich teachers’ knowledge about biodiversity and evolution, as well as effective learning strategies in the field and museum settings.
en.description:
Part 1: The Foundations of Flora: A Seminar on Plant Evolution & Diversity
A 1-hour engaging seminar providing a comprehensive overview of plant evolution and diversity, their distinct paths from fungi and mosses, the process of fossilization, fascinating botanical facts, and how ancient plant life and their structures offer vital clues for interpreting Earth's past environments.
Part 2: Nina Park Exploration
A 1.5-hour immersive field visit to Nina Park for an in-depth curated experience through the structural and chemical transformations of petrification, the unique fossils and geology of Hong Kong, and invaluable hands-on opportunities to explore biodiversity and evolutionary concepts in a real-world setting.
Part 3: Wrap-up Dialogue
A wrap up dialogue session to share and discuss effective strategies and innovative good practices for both field and lab-based learning.

zh.description:
第一部分：植物演化與多樣性講座
1小時的講座將概述植物的演化與多樣性，釐清其與真菌和苔蘚的演化路徑。內容將涵蓋化石形成過程、有趣的植物學知識，以及如何利用植物演化解析地球過去的環境。
第二部分：如心園實地考察
1.5小時的如心園實地考察，探究植物化石與演化，深入體驗了解植物石化過程的結構與化學轉變。此外，亦會探討香港的化石與地質概況以及實踐活動。
第三部分：經驗分享
通過互動對話環節，分享和討論在野外考察和實驗室學習環境中有效的學與教策略。

en.objective: In response to the latest requirements of the 2027 HKDSE Assessment Framework of Mathematics, this workshop will explain to teachers the descriptors for the elementary short questions in Section A of the Extended Part papers and the illustrative examples of the elementaryshort questions recommended by the Ad Hoc Committee on the Extended Part of Senior Secondary Mathematics (Enhanced Measures for Catering Learner Diversity). In addition, we will discuss with teachers how to design elementary short questions for the internal assessment papers to better cater for the increasing learner diversity in M1/M2.
en.background: Since the implementation of the optimising measures for the four senior secondary core subjects, the recognition of the Extended Part of Mathematics (M1/M2) has been enhanced. Moreover, the arrangement of M1/M2 lessons in the regular timetable has also been improved. These changes have not only resulted in an increase of the number of students interested in taking M1/M2, but also make the issue of learning diversity in M1/M2 more worthy of attention. In order to further promote the development of M1/M2 curriculum, the Curriculum Development Council Committee on Mathematics Education (CDCC(ME)) established an Ad Hoc Committee in February 2023 to explore specific enhanced measures to cater for learner diversity in M1/M2 at the curriculum level. In June 2023, by taking into account the recommendations of the Ad Hoc Committee, CDCC(ME) proposed short-term and medium-term enhanced measures to cater for the learner diversity in M1/M at the curriculum level. It is recommended in the short term enhanced measures to refine the question design and requirements for Section A of the HKDSE Examination Papers of the Extended Part, taking into account the learning needs of students with slightly weaker abilities in Mathematics. The HKDSE Mathematics Subject Committee of HKEAA decided in its meeting in September 2023 that the questions of Section A of the HKDSE Examination Papers of the Extended Part will be changed from the current "short questions" to "elementary short questions" starting from the 2027 examination. The relevant assessment framework has been uploaded to HKEAA's website in July 2024.

zh.objective: 因應2027年香港中學文憑考試數學科評核大綱的最新要求，本工作坊將向教師闡述延伸部分試卷甲部簡易短題目的指標，以及高中數學延伸部分專責委員會 (照顧學習多樣性的強化措施) 所建議的簡易短題目示例。另外，我們還將與教師討論如何設計校內評估試卷的簡易短題目，以更好地照顧M1/M2中日益增加的學習多樣性。
zh.background: 自2021年起對四個高中核心科目實施優化措施以來，數學科延伸部分 （M1/M2）的認受性提高了。而 M1/M2 在常規時間表內課節的安排亦得到了改善。這些變化不僅使有興趣修讀 M1/M2 的學生數目增加，同時也促使 M1/M2 的學習多樣性問題變得更值得關注。為了進一步促進 M1/M2 課程的發展，課程發展議會數學教育委員會於2023年2月成立了一個專責委員會，探討在課程層面照顧 M1/M2 的學習多樣性的具體加強措施。在2023年6月，課程發展議會數學教育委員會參考了專責委員會的建議，提出短、中期之照顧 M1/M2 的學習多樣性的加強措施。其中短期措施建議在香港中學文憑考試數學科延伸部分試卷中的甲部，考慮數學能力稍遜的學生之學習需要，調整試題的設計和要求。考評局香港中學文憑數學科科目委員會於2023年9 月的會議中決定，香港中學文憑考試數學科延伸部分試卷中的甲部，將由2027年的考試開始，由目前的「短題目」，改為「簡易短題目」。有關的評核大綱已於2024年7月上載至考評局的網頁。

en.objective:
In this practical workshop, participants will:
take part in drama exercises that can be used with students to foster creativity and collaboration;
practise a range of improvisation techniques using physical expression, vocal expression and group interaction with an awareness of levels and space on the stage;
collaborate to devise a short, improvised scene for performance based on a given stimulus; and
gain an enhanced understanding of the rules and judging criteria for the Speak Up - Act Out Drama Competition.
Note: Participants should wear comfortable clothing and shoes suitable for drama activities.
This course is open to teachers of private schools in Hong Kong who do not have e-Services accounts and teachers teaching Hong Kong curriculum in schools in the GBA Mainland cities*. Teachers of these schools wishing to apply for the course should contact Ms Alice LEUNG at 3549 8315/ rnctnet@edb.gov.hk.
*The schools should meet the following criteria:
A. The schools have joined the “Scheme of Classes for Hong Kong Students” in Shenzhen; or
B. The schools have submitted their curriculum documents to the Education Bureau of Hong Kong, and been recognised to be offering subject curricula which are generally in line with the curriculum requirements of the respective subjects in Hong Kong.

en.objective:
(1) To apply and practise the knowledge and skills on early identification and handling of suspected child abuse cases through case studies; and
(2) To strengthen participants’ ability in formulating and implementing practical strategies for following up on suspected child abuse cases.
en.description: Drawing on the scenarios in primary schools, the workshops enable participants to analyse suspected child abuse cases by using decision trees. Through case discussions, role-plays and other relevant activities, participants gain an understanding of the principles and strategies of child protection work, the mandatory reporting of child abuse regime, multi-disciplinary procedures for handling suspected child abuse cases, as well as community resources on child protection and respective family support services.
en.background: The Mandatory Reporting of Child Abuse Ordinance came into effect on 20 January 2026. To facilitate specified professionals in schools in fulfilling their statutory obligations, the Education Bureau organises workshops for school personnel to help participants, through case studies, identify cases that are subject to mandatory reporting and enhance their understanding of how such cases can be supported and followed up through a multi‑disciplinary collaborative approach.

zh.objective:
(1) 透過個案分析，應用及實踐有關及早識別和介入懷疑虐待兒童個案的知識與技巧；及
(2) 提升參加者制定並落實跟進懷疑虐待兒童個案的實務策略。
zh.description: 工作坊運用小學的情境例子，協助參加者以「決策流程圖」分析懷疑虐兒個案，並透過個案討論、角色扮演等活動，讓參加者了解保護兒童工作的原則及策略、強制舉報虐待兒童機制、跨專業協作處理懷疑虐兒個案的程序，以及保護兒童的社區資源及相關家庭支援服務等。
zh.background: 《強制舉報虐待兒童條例》已於2026年1月20日實施。為協助學校的指明專業人員履行其法定責任，教育局為學校人員舉辦工作坊，讓參加者透過個案分析，識別必須舉報的個案，及認識如何以多專業協作的方式支援及跟進有關個案。

zh.background:
優化高中歷史科課程將於2027-28學年的中四級實施。
教育局課程發展處及香港浸會大學歷史系於2026-27學年起為歷史科教師合辦以「支援優化高中歷史科課程系列」為題的專業培訓活動（包括講座及實地考察），以支援優化高中歷史科課程。
是次系列活動包括「近現代世界史專題」知識增益講座。首6場講座暫定如下：
講座1：「單元 1 現代世界的形成」(22/10/2026 下午)；
講座2：「單元 2 戰爭與和平：第一次世界大戰(1)」(29/10/2026 下午)；
講座3：「單元 2 戰爭與和平：第一次世界大戰(2)」(19/11/2026 下午)；
講座4：「單元 2 戰爭與和平：第二次世界大戰與戰後的國際秩序(1)」(22/1/2027 下午)；
講座5：「單元 2 戰爭與和平：第二次世界大戰與戰後的國際秩序(2)」(3/2/2027 下午)；
講座6：「單元 2 戰爭與和平：亞洲、非洲及拉丁美洲的發展」(18/3/2027 下午)
以上各講座及相關實地考察活動的詳情將適時公布。

en.background: Applied Learning (ApL) is a valued senior secondary elective subject under Category B of the Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education Examination. It complements subjects under Category A (subjects under the Key Learning Areas) and Category C (Other Languages) to form a flexible subject combination that helps enrich students' subject choices and cater for learner diversity, providing broad and balanced learning experiences for students. ApL focuses on practical learning elements linked to broad vocational and professional fields with dual emphasis on theory and practice. It develops students’ knowledge, generic skills, proper values and attitudes through simulated or authentic contexts, as well as enhances students’ understanding of vocational and professional education and training (VPET), preparing them for further studies and work in future.

2. 探討生成式人工智能等新興技術的發展，並評估其在校本人文學科教育中深化學與教、文本解構與慎思明辨的應用潛力與教育價值；

en.objective:
• This workshop aims to equip primary and secondary school teachers with techniques for teaching environmental conservation / education for sustainable development through experiential learning during a field visit to Sha Tau Kok Organic Farm.
• Through hands-on activities such as organic farming, vermicomposting, and aquaponics, participants will learn greening strategies that can be implemented on campus, as well as acquire teaching resources and pedagogical methods that can be applied in the classroom to enhance students' understanding and practice of ecological conservation and sustainable living.

en.background:
The ECC, the EEB, the EPD and the EDB have jointly organised the Student Environmental Protection Ambassador (SEPA) Scheme for students of primary and secondary schools through the Environment and Conservation Fund since 1995. The Scheme aims to cultivate a sense of environmental responsibility and leadership among primary and secondary school students, and to encourage them to take proactive actions to improve the environment by providing a wide range of diverse environmental training activities, including seminars, workshops, and field trips. Teacher training is also provided to familiarise teachers with general knowledge of environmental protection, as well as to strengthen their ability in implementing environmental education.
For more details about the SEPAS, please visit ECC’s Schools Go Green website (https://school.ecc.org.hk/en/programmes/sepas.html).

en.objective: To equip teachers with the knowledge and skills for conducting national flag-raising ceremonies in kindergartens to foster young children’s sense of belonging to our country and national sentiment, and thus enhance their sense of national identity.
en.description:
This course comprises two parts. Part 1 of the course is a self-study session. Prior to attending the workshop, participants are required to review the relevant materials under "Learning & Teaching Resources/Reference Materials on National Flag Raising Ceremony" on the EDB website. Part 2 is a face-to-face workshop covering the following topics:
- Basic Chinese-style foot drill and verbal commands
- Procedures and etiquette of the National Flag-raising Ceremony
- Contents of the “Speech on the National Flag” and suggestions on national education suitable for kindergarten students
- Teaching strategies for guiding kindergarten students to conduct the National Flag-raising Ceremony in school
en.background: During the kindergarten stage, singing the national anthem and raising the national flag and regional flag are among the learning activities that help young children understand our country. Schools can assist children in understanding that Hong Kong is part of our country, helping them acquire an initial understanding of our country and Chinese culture, thereby fostering a sense of national identity.

- 基本中式步操和口令

zh.background: 在幼稚園階段，唱國歌、升國旗和區旗是讓幼兒認識國家的其中一種學習活動，學校可協助幼兒認識香港是國家的一部分，幫助他們初步認識國家及中華文化，從而培養對國民身份的認同。

en.objective:
In this online workshop, participants will:
experience an overview of the steps of Imitation, Innovation and Independent Application/Invention – which are the basis of the Talk for Writing approach
focus on developing students’ functional application of grammar in context
be guided through and/or provided with:
  - an entire Talk for Writing unit;
  - the implementation of a vocabulary routine in the classroom;
  - an instructional model for teaching language features (‘the writers’ tools’);
  - toolkits featuring character, setting and suspense tools; and
  - a year-by-year progression guide to assist with the teaching of grammar within a Talk for Writing unit.
Remarks
This online workshop will be conducted by teacher trainers from DSF Australia Literacy and Clinical Services.
A link to the online workshop will be sent to participant's email prior to the workshop date.
Participants should attend all four parts of the workshop (Part 1, Part 2, Part 3 & Part 4) to get a full understanding of the Speaking to Writing (S2W) approach.

en.objective:
After attending the seminar, participants should be able to:
1. gain insights into how to ultilise the School-based Student Talent Pool to formulate a holistic plan for school-based gifted education based on the capabilities and attributes of students and their school contexts; and
2. realise how artificial intelligence (AI) can be used to enhance and facilitate the utilisation of School-based Student Talent Pool for systematic and strategic grooming of talents under the "Three-tier Implementation Model for Gifted Education.
en.description: To learn about ways that schools can make use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the utilisation of School-based Student Talent Pool for systematic and strategic grooming of talents through sharing of good practices.
en.background: The setting up of the School-based Student Talent Pool can effectively facilitate the development of school-based gifted education, identification and grooming of gifted talents. Schools should establish and utilise the School-based Student Talent Pool, devise whole-school curriculum planning for school-based gifted education in order to unleash students' potential to the fullest. In this connection, the Education Bureau organises related professional development programmes for teachers to help them understand the importance of having the School-based Student Talent Pool in regard to grooming of talents, and the effective use of the School-based Student Talent Pool to facilitate the planning of school-based gifted education so as to nurture gifted talents strategically.

完成研討會後，教師應可：
1. 了解如何善用校本學生人才庫整體規劃切合學生特質及校情的校本資優教育；及

en.objective: The workshop aims to familiarise school personnel with the structure and features of 'e-COPES', while equipping them with essential coaching skills to effectively deliver the programme.
en.description:
The workshop will be conducted primarily in an interactive approach, covering a brief overview of 'e-COPES', practical skill training with demonstration, role play, and small group discussion. Through the workshop, participants not only understand the structure and features of 'e-COPES' but also gain hands-on experience in applying essential coaching skills.
School personnel taking up the role of supervisors and coaches, including SENCOs, SENSTs, and teachers, are welcome to join.
en.background: 'e-COPES' is the second edition of the Coaching Programme on Executive Skills. It is a goal-oriented, one-on-one coaching programme which is executive-skills-based and conducted through a collaborative partnership between coaches and students. It is built on the theoretical foundation and coaching framework established in the first edition of the coaching programme, and facilitated by the computer software to assist school personnel and students to assess needs, log coaching sessions and track progress. 'e-COPES' features a more comprehensive Tool Bank containing strategies and tools categorised into 11 executive skills tailored to each of the five areas of concern. The Tool Bank provides practical resources to enhance the executive skills of students to achieve their personal goals.

zh.objective: 本工作坊旨在讓學校人員熟悉「執行易」的架構與特色，同時裝備他們相關的指導技巧，以有效推行該計劃。
zh.description: 工作坊主要以互動形式進行，內容涵蓋「執行易」簡介、實用技巧訓練、示範、角色扮演及小組討論，旨在讓參加者掌握「執行易」的架構與內容，同時熟習相關指導技巧。是次工作坊歡迎擔任督導員及指導員角色的學校人員參加，包括特殊教育需要統籌主任（SENCO）、特殊教育需要支援老師（SENST）及科任教師等。
zh.background: 「執行易」是「執行技巧訓練：指導計劃」的第二版。「執行易」是透過指導員與學生的協作夥伴關係而進行的一個目標導向、以執行技巧為基礎的一對一指導計劃。它建基於「執行技巧訓練：指導計劃」第一版的理論基礎與指導框架，並引入電子化介面輔助指導員及學生評估需要、記錄指導過程並追蹤進展。「執行易」配備一個更全面的「工具庫」，載有針對五個關注範疇、按十一種執行技巧分類的策略與工具。「工具庫」提供的實用資源，能有效提升學生的執行技巧，引導他們達成個人目標。

en.objective: 自1927年中國國民黨發動「清黨」以來，中國共產黨的實力遭到極大的打擊。隨著國民黨的步步進逼，中共第五次反圍剿戰爭後，紅軍主力軍實施戰略轉移，最終於1936年10月先後在甘肅會寧與將台堡會師，宣告長征的結束。本次講座旨在結合史學研究，剖析紅軍長征的歷史意義及其重要影響。
en.description: 請參閱附件。
en.background:
教育局於2025年10月公布「高中中國歷史科優化課程框架」，並於2027/28學年中四級開始實施。為支援教師準備有關課程，教育局舉辧「高中中國歷史科優化課程先導計劃」。教育局選取部分課題，透過專家學者的專業支援，讓參與教師按課程優化的方向調整和豐富教學策略，加深對現有及新增課題的掌握，提升學與教的效能，為未來實施優化課程做好準備。
知識增益講座系列是配合「高中中國歷史科優化課程先導計劃」的其中一項支援措施，參加教師透過專家學者的講解，深入認識試教課題的內容。

en.objective: The Course aims at strengthening teachers’ understanding of mathematical modelling, and related learning, teaching, and assessment, as well as enhancing their abilities in formulating mathematical modelling learning activities. The Course also includes elements on related applications of digital tools (including Artificial Intelligence).
en.description:
Course Arrangement
Successful applicants will receive an acceptance email for the selection of workshop session and details of the location of the programme. Participants who finish 3 seminars and 1 workshop are eligible to receive a Certificate of Completion.
(Seminars@2 – 5 p.m.)
24/11 (Tue), 27/11 (Fri), 1/12 (Tue); and
(Workshop@9:30 a.m. – 5 p.m.)
i) 10/12 (Thu) or
ii) 15/12 (Tue) or
iii) 16/12 (Wed) or
iv) 17/12 (Thu)
Key Foci
Seminars (3 sessions, 3 hours per session)
- Understand the concepts of mathematical modelling, the related pedagogical content knowledge, and the connection between mathematical modelling and various topics in Mathematics
- Understand the learning and teaching strategies for conducting mathematical modelling learning activities through examples (including the use of digital tools, such as Artificial Intelligence)
- Understand how to design mathematical modelling learning activities and related assessments
Workshop (1 session, 6 hours)
- Further understanding of how to design mathematical modelling learning activities
- Design a mathematical modelling teaching activity and conduct a sharing
en.background: In response to the promotion of digital education and STEAM education, as well as the fine-tuning of the primary Mathematics curriculum on mathematical modelling, the EDB launches this Course to facilitate teachers in infusing mathematical modelling learning activities into primary Mathematics lessons, with an aim to foster students' ability in applying mathematics in real-world context, as well as to develop their creativity and problem-solving skills, for nuturing future innovation and technology talents for Hong Kong.

zh.objective: 本證書課程旨在加強教師認識數學建模，以及相關的學與教和評估，並提升他們設計數學建模學習活動的能力。本課程亦包含運用相關數字工具（包括人工智能）的元素。
zh.description:
課程安排
成功申請的學員將接獲取錄電郵，屆時會要求揀選工作坊的場次，以及接收課程地點的詳細資料。學員完成3場研討會及1場工作坊，可獲得完成證書。
(研討會@下午2 – 5時)

iii) 16/12（三） 或

研討會（共3節，每節3小時）
- 認識數學建模的概念、相關的教學知識及數學建模與數學科不同課題之間的聯繫
- 透過示例認識進行數學建模學習活動的學與教策略 (包括運用數字工具，如人工智能)
- 認識如何設計數學建模學習活動和相關評估
工作坊（1節，6小時）
- 進一步認識如何設計數學建模學習活動
- 設計一個數學建模教學活動及進行分享
zh.background: 配合數字教育和STEAM教育的推展，以及小學數學科數學建模課程微調，教育局舉辦本證書課程以協助教師於小學數學課堂引入數學建模學習活動，以提升學生於現實情境應用數學的能力，培養學生創意思維和解難的能力，為香港培育明日創科人才。

zh.objective: 本課程旨在提升幼稚園教師實施與統籌實證為本支援策略的能力，並促進跨專業協作，在分層支援架構下有效推行「反應性介入」(Response to Intervention, RTI)。課程亦涵蓋如何按學生需要制定及推行個別學習計劃，透過及早識別與適時介入支援，更有效照顧學生的學習多樣性。
zh.description:
本課程共36小時，內容包括︰
(1) 個別學習差異及特殊需要
(2) 反應性介入與進階評估技巧
(3) 分層介入模式與實證為本的支援策略
(4) 個別化支援：個別學習計劃
(5) 促進多方協作以支援有多元需要的幼稚園學生。
zh.background: 隨著幼稚園教育政策於2017/18學年推行，教育局致力提升幼稚園教師的專業質素，並舉辦專業發展課程，加強幼稚園教師的能力，以照顧學生的學習多樣性。修畢課程後，教師將能運用所需的專業知識及技能，支援幼稚園學生的不同學習需要。

The Construction Industry Council (CIC) will organise the Construction Innovation Expo 2026 (CIExpo 2026). CIExpo 2026 will feature an exhibition and a series of themed international forums showcasing cutting-edge construction technologies, innovative solutions, and industry insights from around the world.
On the third day of the Expo (25 November 2026), the Hong Kong Institute of Construction (HKIC) will host the International Forum on Smart Construction and Vocational & Professional Education in the Construction Industry. The Forum will bring together local and overseas industry and education experts to share their insights and perspectives on vocational and professional training, as well as smart construction development. It will also serve as an international platform for knowledge exchange, collaboration, and learning for the education sector.

zh.objective: 本論壇定位為一項國際性盛會，匯聚來自中國內地、香港及世界各地的智慧建造與職業專才教育培訓領域的專家、從業員及持份者。論壇將作為一個跨界別、跨地域的知識交流與協作平台，促進深度對話、經驗分享及合作交流，並支持香港職業專才教育的長遠發展。
zh.background:
建造業議會（CIC）將舉辦「建造創新博覽會2026」（CIExpo 2026）。 創博會2026將包括展覽及一系列主題國際論壇，展示來自世界各地的尖端建造技術、創新解決方案及行業發展洞見，促進業界交流與合作。
創博會第三日（2026年11月25日） 將由香港建造學院（HKIC）主辦 「智慧建造及建造業職業專才教育國際論壇」。論壇匯聚本地及海外建造業和教育界專家，分享智慧建造發展趨勢，以及建造業職業專才教育和培訓的最新經驗與見解。
論壇提供一個國際化的知識交流、協作與學習平台，促進業界與教育界跨地域、跨界別的交流合作，共同推動智慧建造人才培育及建造業的可持續發展。

en.objective: This training programme aims to enhance teachers’ understanding of the Constitution, the Basic Law and National Security Education.
en.description:
The content of the training programme includes the relationship between the Constitution and the Basic Law, historical background of the Basic Law, importance of enacting the National Security Law and clarification of some of the misinterpretations on enactment of the Basic Law.
After successful completion of the course, newly-joined teachers' (i.e. full-time teachers appointed to teach in publicly-funded schools from the 2020/21 school year) training hours will be recorded under the "core training" of newly-joined teachers. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDB Circular No. 6/2020 and EDB Circular No. 29/2024 .
Generally, participants are required to attend punctually and complete the three-hour training course, and to sign the “Attendance Slip” at the end of the course. Training hours will only be awarded to those who sign the slip. Participants being late for more than 30 minutes will not be allowed to attend the course (such participants will be considered absent, and no training hours will be awarded by the EDB).
This session is exclusively for newly-joined teachers. If the number of applicants exceeds the quota, the selection will be determined in the order of priority on (i) the teaching experience of the newly-joined teachers; and (ii) the order in which schools submit their applications to EDB. EDB reserves the right of final decision on the selection principles and arrangements.
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) Circular No. 6/2020 issued on 10 June 2020 announced the establishment of Professional Ladder for Teachers and relevant measures. A training programme has been developed to help newly-joined teachers understand their professional roles, demonstrate professional values and conduct, and keep abreast of the latest developments in education policies. Starting from the 2020/21 school year, teachers appointed to teach in publicly-funded schools (including government schools, aided schools, caput schools and Direct Subsidy Scheme schools) for the first time are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs.

zh.objective: 此課程旨在加深教師對《憲法》、《基本法》及國安教育的認識。
zh.description:
課程內容包括《憲法》與《基本法》的關係、《基本法》制定的歷史背景、訂立《香港國安法》及《維護國家安全條例》的重要性，以及釐清一些對《基本法》的誤解等。
新入職教師(即2020/21 學年起首次於公帑資助學校任教的全職教師的培訓時數將計算在新入職教師「核心培訓」部分內。有關培訓要求的詳情請參閱 教育局通告第6/2020號 及 教育局通告第29/2024號 。
一般情況下，參加者須準時出席及完成整個時長三小時的課程，並於課程結束後簽署「出席表格」，方可獲發相關培訓時數。參加者如遲到超逾三十分鐘，將不獲參加課程，並將視作缺席課程（即不會獲發放任何培訓時數）。
本場次只供新入職教師報讀。如報讀人數超逾上限，本局將按序根據 (i) 新入職教師教學年資的先後；及 (ii) 學校提交有關報讀申請至教育局的時間先後，決定錄取次序。教育局對錄取原則及安排有最終決定權。
zh.background:
教育局在2020年6月10日發出 第6/2020號通告 ，公布建立教師專業階梯及相關措施。
為協助新入職教師掌握其專業角色，展現專業操守和價值觀，並掌握最新的教育政策和措施的發展，教育局訂定了新入職教師培訓課程。由2020/21學年起，首次於公帑資助學校（包括官立學校、資助學校、按位津貼學校及直接資助計劃學校）任教的教師，必須於首三年內完成30小時的核心培訓，以及按個人專業發展需要參與不少於60小時的選修培訓。

en.objective: 是次培訓活動為「史智承傳」系列的本地選修課程（A3教學策略），旨在透過香港浸會大學歷史系講師團隊的分享及闡釋，以不同時期的圖像（如上古器物及其紋飾、《韓熙載夜宴圖》、《良友畫報》等）掌握如何解讀圖像史料，並從而建構歷史知識的技能。是次培訓活動選取的圖像涵蓋上古至當代中國的不同歷史時期（詳見附件），以期增進中史教師對初中中史課程的專業歷史知識，加強教學的效能。
en.description: 請參閱附件。
en.background:
《行政長官2024年施政報告》提出「由2024/25學年起三年內為約1 000位非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師提供培訓名額」。就此，教育局現舉辦「史智承傳：非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師專業發展」計劃（簡稱「史智承傳」），支援非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師接受相關專業發展培訓，以提升教師在中國歷史教育的專業能力，強化學與教效能，以加強培養學生的國民身份認同。
「史智承傳」系列的專業發展課程涵蓋本地課程及內地考察兩個範疇，各範疇內容如下：
A. 本地課程（共12小時）：
1. 初中中國歷史科課程詮釋（必修，3小時）
2. 博物館參觀或歷史考察（必修，3小時）

zh.objective: 是次培訓活動為「史智承傳」系列的本地選修課程（A3教學策略），旨在透過香港浸會大學歷史系講師團隊的分享及闡釋，以不同時期的圖像（如上古器物及其紋飾、《韓熙載夜宴圖》、《良友畫報》等）掌握如何解讀圖像史料，並從而建構歷史知識的技能。是次培訓活動選取的圖像涵蓋上古至當代中國的不同歷史時期（詳見附件），以期增進中史教師對初中中史課程的專業歷史知識，加強教學的效能。
zh.description: 請參閱附件。
zh.background:
《行政長官2024年施政報告》提出「由2024/25學年起三年內為約1 000位非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師提供培訓名額」。就此，教育局現舉辦「史智承傳：非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師專業發展」計劃（簡稱「史智承傳」），支援非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師接受相關專業發展培訓，以提升教師在中國歷史教育的專業能力，強化學與教效能，以加強培養學生的國民身份認同。
「史智承傳」系列的專業發展課程涵蓋本地課程及內地考察兩個範疇，各範疇內容如下：
A. 本地課程（共12小時）：
1. 初中中國歷史科課程詮釋（必修，3小時）
2. 博物館參觀或歷史考察（必修，3小時）
3. 知識增益 / 教學策略（選修：任選兩個課程，6小時）
B. 內地考察：廣州考察（兩天一晚） * 包括簡介會及講座（必修，18小時）
凡完成30小時「史智承傳」系列專業發展計劃的教師，將獲頒發完成證書。
詳情可參看教育局通函第124/2026號：
https://applications.edb.gov.hk/circular/upload/EDBCM/EDBCM26124C.pdf

en.objective: This Thematic Course aims at enhancing teachers’ competency in teaching students with ‘Cognition and Learning Needs’ (CLN), focusing on the needs of students with Specific Learning Difficulties (SpLD). Emphasis will be put on both theoretical and practical aspects such as designing and conducting intervention plans and developing corresponding learning materials. Participants will further review the methods of identifying the learning characteristics of students with SpLD and how the acquired educational strategies and skills will benefit these students and other students. On completion of the course, participants will be able to apply the necessary professional knowledge and skills in catering for the students with SpLD.
en.description: The Course will last for 72 contact hours in total. Participants should submit the written assignment tasks required by the Course before the submission deadline.
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) is committed to implementing integrated education so as to cater for students with special educational needs (SEN) in ordinary schools. Teacher training is one of the key factors for catering for students with SEN effectively. To enhance teachers’ capacity in catering for students with SEN, EDB provides the Basic, Advanced and Thematic (BAT) Courses for in-service teachers.

en.objective:
1. To enhance teachers' ability in conducting SWOT analysis to review school-based gifted education and talent pool; and
2. To equip teachers with knowledge and skills of planning and implementing school-based gifted education and talent pool.
en.description:
1. Exploring starting points for the implementation of school-based gifted education and talent pool; and
2. Using SWOT analysis to foster the development of school-based gifted education and talent pool.
en.background:
1. In order to better support the planning and co-ordination of school-based gifted education, the Education Bureau (EDB) has designed a series of school-specific and practice-oriented modular advanced courses.
2. To facilitate participants to get a better understanding of the course contents, we recommend completing the “EDB Online Foundation Course for Teachers - Gifted Education” or equivalent training prior to this course.
3. This advanced course series consists of 6 modules:
(A) Setting Out the Blueprint for School-based Gifted Education and Talent Pool
(B) SWOT Analysis for the Implementation of School-based Gifted Education and Talent Pool
(C) Practical Cases Analysis: Three-tier Implementation Model of Gifted Education - Level 1 Whole-class Instruction
(D) Practical Cases Analysis: Three-tier Implementation Model of Gifted Education - Level 2 Pull-out Programme
(E) Student Cases Analysis & School-based Experience Sharing: Realising the Potential of Students and Nurturing Giftedness
(F) Professional Development for Teachers and Resources Deployment for Gifted Education
4. Teachers can consider their own training needs to enrol in one or all of the modules. An e-Certificate of “Gifted Education Advanced Course” would be awarded to participants who successfully complete all the 6 modules(a total of 18 hours). Teachers wishing to apply for this e-Certificate may contact the Gifted Education Section, EID, EDB. (Tel: 3698 3914 or via email: cpge@edb.gov.hk)

zh.objective:
1. 提升教師透過強弱機危分析檢視校本資優教育及人才庫的能力；及
2. 讓教師掌握規劃及推行校本資優教育及人才庫的知識及技能。
zh.description:
1. 探討推行校本資優教育及人才庫的切入點；及
2. 運用「強弱機危分析」促進校本資優教育及人才庫的發展。
zh.background:
1. 為更靈活及有效支援校本資優教育的課程發展與統籌工作，本組特別設計一系列以校情為本、實作為主的模組式深造課程。
2. 為讓參加者更能掌握本課程的內容，我們建議先完成「教育局教師網上基礎課程 — 資優教育」或同等程度的培訓。
3. 本系列的課程共分六個模組，分別為：
(A) 規劃校本資優教育及人才庫的藍圖
(B) 推行校本資優教育及人才庫之強弱機危分析
(C) 資優教育三層架構推行模式：第一層全班式教學實踐示例分析
(D) 資優教育三層架構推行模式：第二層抽離式課程實踐示例分析
(E) 學生個案分析與校本經驗分享：識別學生潛能與資優培育
(F) 資優教育之教師專業發展與資源運用
4. 教師可因應自己的需要選修個別模組或全數六個模組；完成全數六個模組課程者（共18小時），將可獲頒發一張「資優教育深造課程」電子證書。 如教師有意申請此電子證書，請在完成六個模組後聯絡教育局教育基建分部資優教育組。（電話︰3698 3914 電郵︰cpge@edb.gov.hk）

en.background:
1. In order to better support the planning and co-ordination of school-based gifted education, the Education Bureau (EDB) has designed a series of school-specific and practice-oriented modular advanced courses.

(C) Practical Cases Analysis: Three-tier Implementation Model of Gifted Education - Level 1 Whole-class Instruction
(D) Practical Cases Analysis: Three-tier Implementation Model of Gifted Education - Level 2 Pull-out Programme
(E) Student Cases Analysis & School-based Experience Sharing: Realising the Potential of Students and Nurturing Giftedness
(F) Professional Development for Teachers and Resources Deployment for Gifted Education
4. Teachers can consider their own training needs to enrol in one or all of the modules. An e-Certificate of “Gifted Education Advanced Course” would be awarded to participants who successfully complete all the 6 modules(a total of 18 hours). Teachers wishing to apply for this e-Certificate may contact the Gifted Education Section, EID, EDB. (Tel: 3698 3914 or via email: cpge@edb.gov.hk)

zh.objective:
1. 提升教師透過強弱機危分析檢視校本資優教育及人才庫的能力；及
2. 讓教師掌握規劃及推行校本資優教育及人才庫的知識及技能。
zh.description:
1. 探討推行校本資優教育及人才庫的切入點；及
2. 運用「強弱機危分析」促進校本資優教育及人才庫的發展。
zh.background:
1. 為更靈活及有效支援校本資優教育的課程發展與統籌工作，本組特別設計一系列以校情為本、實作為主的模組式深造課程。
2. 為讓參加者更能掌握本課程的內容，我們建議先完成「教育局教師網上基礎課程 — 資優教育」或同等程度的培訓。
3. 本系列的課程共分六個模組，分別為：
(A) 規劃校本資優教育及人才庫的藍圖
(B) 推行校本資優教育及人才庫之強弱機危分析
(C) 資優教育三層架構推行模式：第一層全班式教學實踐示例分析
(D) 資優教育三層架構推行模式：第二層抽離式課程實踐示例分析
(E) 學生個案分析與校本經驗分享：識別學生潛能與資優培育
(F) 資優教育之教師專業發展與資源運用
4. 教師可因應自己的需要選修個別模組或全數六個模組；完成全數六個模組課程者（共18小時），將可獲頒發一張「資優教育深造課程」電子證書。 如教師有意申請此電子證書，請在完成六個模組後聯絡教育局教育基建分部資優教育組。（電話︰3698 3914 電郵︰cpge@edb.gov.hk）

en.objective:
完成本課程後，預期學員能夠：
1. 認識對資優學生推行情意教育的基礎知識，以提升識别及照顧資優學生情意需要的能力；及
2. 建立基礎以參加由教育局舉辦與照顧資優學生相關的進階課程。
en.description: 學員首先透過閱讀短文以便掌握每個主題的基本概念，然後可觀看相關視頻片段及完成延伸閱讀文章，從而深入理解特定主題的內容。學員完成每章的內容後，便可參加該章的測驗。每章的測驗設有三次應考機會，如能取得 60% 或以上的成績，便可以繼續修讀下一章，直至完成整個課程。
en.background:
1. 教育局設計此網上課程，讓校長及教師在參加其他進階課程之前，掌握對資優學生推行情意教育的基礎知識。
2. 本課程有助教師了解及推行校本資優教育，校長可鼓勵全體教師修讀。
3. 本課程分為四章，分別為 (1) 引言：資優學生的情意特質、(2) 資優學生的情意教育、(3) 有不同學習和情意需要的資優學生，以及(4) 在學校內外推行情意教育。每一章完結後附有測驗以鞏固學員的學習。
4. 本課程在 2026/27 學年將開辦兩期，教師可因應個人的教學工作安排報讀任何一期課程。下期課程將於課程開始前八星期接受報名。

en.objective:
After completing the course, participants should be able to:
1. gain basic knowledge of implementation of affective education for gifted students, thereby enhancing their capacity to identify and address the affective needs of gifted students; and
2. develop a sound foundation for pursuing advanced modular programmes offered by the Education Bureau that are related to services for gifted students.
en.description: Participants will first read the selected articles to get an overall idea of the theme in each chapter. Then, participants can view the related video clips and complete the extended readings to gain in-depth understanding of a particular theme. After completing the course contents in the chapter, they can attempt the End-of-Chapter Test. Three attempts are allowed for each test. By scoring 60% or above, participants can move on to the next chapter until they complete the whole course.
en.background:
1. In order to equip principals and teachers with the basic knowledge of implementation of affective education for gifted students before attending any further advanced studies, the Education Bureau (EDB) developed this online course.
2. This course helps teachers understand and implement school-based gifted education. School heads can encourage all teachers in the school to take the course.
3. This course consists of four chapters: (1) Introduction: Affective Characteristics of Gifted Students, (2) Affective Education for Gifted Students, (3) Gifted Students at Risk and with Different Learning and Affective Needs, and (4) Implementing Affective Education at School and Beyond. There is an End-of-Chapter test in each chapter to consolidate participants’ learning.
4. There are two intakes in the 2026/27 school year. Teachers can enrol in any of the intakes with reference to their own teaching schedule. Application for the next intake starts eight weeks before the course commences.

en.objective: This online course aims to deepen newly-joined teachers' understanding of the "T-standard+" - Professional Standards for Teachers of Hong Kong and their professional roles, professional conduct and values.
en.description:
This online course explains the three professional roles stated in the "T-standard+" through scenario analysis, interactive games and videos. The course content is divided into the following five chapters:
1. Prologue
2. Caring Cultivators
3. Inspirational Co-constructors
4. Committed Role Models
5. Aspiration for self-advancement through self-reflection
To obtain CPD hours, participants are required to complete the entire course within the specified period. CPD hours will be recorded under the “Core Training” of newly-joined teachers.
en.background:
Starting from the 2020/21 school year, full-time teachers appointed to teach in publicly-funded schools, including government schools, aided schools, caput schools and Direct Subsidy Scheme (DSS) schools for the first time, are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs. This course is part of the Core Training (Category 1), accounting for 3 CPD hours.
For details of the training requirements, please refer to EDB Circular No.6/2020 and EDB Circular No.29/2024 .

zh.objective: 本網上課程旨在加深新入職教師對 「T-標準+」-「香港教師專業標準參照」 的理解，掌握其專業角色及專業操守和價值觀。
zh.description:
本網上課程通過情境分析、互動遊戲及短片等，讓教師掌握「T-標準+」所描述香港教師的三個專業角色。課程內容分以下五章：
1. 序章
2. 關愛學生的育才者
3. 啟發學生的共建者
4. 敬業樂群的典範
5. 反思求進以達自我完善的精神
參加者須於指定的日期內 完成整個課程 ，方可獲得培訓時數。有關時數將計算在新入職教師「核心培訓」部分內。
zh.background:
由2020/21學年起，首次於公帑資助學校，包括官立學校、資助學校、按位津貼學校及直接資助計劃（直資）學校任教的全職教師，必須於首三年內完成30小時的核心培訓，以及按個人專業發展需要參與不少於60小時的選修培訓。本課程屬核心培訓課程(範疇一)，佔3小時培訓時數。
培訓要求的詳情請參閱 教育局通告第6/2020號 及 教育局通告第29/2024號 。

en.objective:
1. To encourage schools to cultivate a positive school culture, connect teachers and students to promote emotional engagement and stimulate students’ positive emotions and commitment to school life; and
2. To present awards to recipients of “Hi-Five Student Engagement Award Scheme”.
en.background: In recent years, the non-attendance cases in primary and secondary schools due to emotional, learning, family relationships and social interaction difficulties have aroused public concern. In view of this, Baptist Oi Kwan Social Service – Mental Wellness Service for Children and Youth, with the Education Bureau and The Education University of Hong Kong, conducts the “Hi-Five Student Engagement Award Scheme” which aims at promoting a positive school culture to engage students, enhance their learning motivation and boost the sense of connection between the students and the school.

en.objective:
The half-day workshop shall help participants, preferably those with experience using English to teach the Technology Education, Arts Education and Physical Education (TAPE) Key Learning Areas (KLAs) subjects concerned, achieve the following objectives:
(a) Refreshing strategies and pedagogy for enhancing classroom communication by using subject-specific language in English;
(b) Disseminating good practices in teaching the TAPE KLAs using English as the medium of instruction (EMI) and exchanging ideas through group discussions during the Workshop; and
(c) Designing and developing classroom learning and teaching tasks / instructional and assessment materials / e-learning tasks to support students’ learning of both the subject content / skills and the subject language through hands-on practices in the Workshop.
en.background: The half-day workshop will introduce participants the genres of TAPE subjects, share examples of good practice, etc. The half-day workshop will be based on sound educational theories and principles, highly practical teaching strategies and skills.

zh.objective:
1.透過實務操作深化教師於科學、工程及機械之跨學科知識，全面提升學與教效能
2.引導教師運用「科學探究法」（變因控制、數據收集），系統化優化機械人表現，建立嚴謹之理科教學邏輯
3. 運用自行研發之「Human-AI Co-Creation – Robot in STEAM」平台，直接以內置 AI 工具進行即時數據診斷與工程調優，實踐人機共創模式
4. 強化教師於 AI STEAM 範疇之專業能力，協助學校規劃並落實高質素之校本機械人課程
5.透過專室參觀與實務工作坊，建構跨校專業學習社群，促進教學資源共享，推動學界數字教育發展
zh.description:

zh.objective:
本課程旨在：
1. 協助教師認識人工智能的基本運作概念，理解其背後的邏輯與思考限制；
2. 掌握實用的提示語技巧，提升日常備課、教學設計及行政工作的效率；
3. 培養運用不同人工智能平台的能力，學會檢查及修正人工智能生成的內容，促進更有效的人機協作。
zh.description:
1. 簡介人工智能的基本運作原理，了解其文字處理、對話內容記憶及能力限制；
2. 分享實用且通用的提示語技巧與公式，協助教師處理日常備課、教學設計及學校行政工作；及
3. 認識各種人工智能工具的特點，並掌握修改提示語的策略以避免人工智能產生錯誤資訊。

en.objective: This Study Tour aims to enable non-Chinese speaking NJTs to gain an understanding of the development of education in Chinese Mainland, as well as other key areas such as innovation and technology, history, culture, and the economy, through visits and exchanges in Chinese Mainland.
en.description: This Study Tour includes thematic talks, school visit, and visit to enterprise as well as cultural and historical site. For the tentative itinerary of the Study Tour, please refer to the attached document.
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) issued EDB Circular No.6/2020 on 10 June 2020 to announce the establishment of Professional Ladder for Teachers and the relevant measures. To assist newly-joined teachers (NJTs) to understand their professional roles, demonstrate professional conduct and values, and keep abreast of the latest developments in education policies and practices for application in teaching as appropriate, EDB has developed the Training Programme for NJTs. Starting from the 2020/21 school year, teachers appointed to teach in public sector or DSS schools for the first time are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs.

zh.objective: 本學習團透過到中國內地考察交流，讓新入職非華語教師認識中國內地教育發展，以及其他主要領域，如：創科、歷史、文化和經濟的發展情況。
zh.description: 本學習團內容包括專題講座、學校參訪、企業參觀，以及文化設施和歷史遺跡參觀。有關學習團的暫擬行程，請參閱附件。
zh.background: 教育局在2020年6月10日發出第6/2020號通告，公布建立教師專業階梯及相關措施。為協助新入職教師掌握其專業角色，展現專業操守和價值觀，並掌握最新的教育政策和措施的發展，以適切地應用於教學工作，教育局訂定了新入職教師培訓課程，包括核心培訓和選修培訓。由2020/21學年起，首次於公營學校或直接資助計劃學校任教的教師，必須於首三年內完成30小時的核心培訓，以及按個人專業發展需要參與不少於60小時的選修培訓。

en.objective: 透過到內地考察交流，讓晉升教師了解國家不同領域的最新發展，並與內地學校領導交流，學習和反思不同的領導策略，以拓寬視野，更有效地推動學校持續發展，加強培養學生國民身份認同的能力。
en.description: 此活動內容包括專題講座、學校及企業參訪、文化考察和專業交流。
en.background:
《行政長官2022年施政報告》中提出，要求公帑資助學校新入職教師及公營學校擬晉升教師須參加內地學習團，並增加在職教師到內地考察的機會，親身體驗國家的發展。由2023/24學年開始，所有於2023年9月1日起獲實任晉升更高職級的公營學校教師，必須在其實任晉升的首兩年內，參加由教育局舉辦的「晉升教師內地學習團」，以符合晉升培訓要求。
教育局將於2027年3月至6月舉辦其他「晉升教師內地學習團」，前往內地不同城市。下一輪報名日期預計為2026年12月中旬，詳情請留意培訓行事曆系統。

en.objective:
This study tour aims at:
1. enhancing teachers’ understanding of the anti-drug education and raising their awareness on mental health;
2. demonstrating how to nurture students' proper values through their participation in local study tours and experiential learning activities; and
3. strengthening teachers’ ability to organise local study tours for students.
en.background: This study tour is designed to align with the key learning points of Module 1.1 “Self-understanding and Life Skills” , Module 1.2 “Interpersonal Relationships and Social Inclusiveness” , and Module 2.1 “Overcoming Growth Challenges” under the Citizenship, Economics and Society (Secondary 1-3) curriculum framework. In cultivating the above capabilities, the curriculum places particular emphasis on the nurturing of students’ proper values and attitudes: students are expected to face difficulties and setbacks with perseverance; to eliminate bias and discrimination against persons with mental illness with respect for others; to understand and support those in need of mental health care with empathy; to take responsibility for their own mental health and their lives; and to resist the lure of drugs, stay away from undesirable behaviours, and build a proactive and healthy lifestyle with self-discipline and a law-abiding attitude.

zh.objective:
本考察團旨在
1. 加強教師對禁毒教育的認識，提升他們對精神健康的關注；
2. 展示如何透過本地考察和體驗式學習活動培養學生的正確價值觀；及
3. 增強教師為學生組織本地考察活動的能力。
zh.background: 本考察團旨在配合初中「公民、經濟與社會（中一至中三）」課程框架中單元1.1「自我理解與生活技能」 、單元1.2「人際關係與社會共融」 及單元2.1「跨越成長挑戰」 的學習重點。在培養以上能力的過程中，課程特別重視學生價值觀的建立：學生須以堅毅的態度面對困難和挫折，以尊重他人的態度消除對精神病患者的偏見與歧視，以同理心理解和支持有精神健康需要的人，以責任感對自己的精神健康和人生負責，以自律和守法的態度拒絕毒品誘惑，遠離不良行為，建立積極及健康的生活方式。

en.objective: This training course aims at enhancing special school teachers’ competency in teaching students with severe or multiple disabilities in special schools. Emphasis will be put on both theoretical and practical aspects such as designing and conducting intervention plans and developing corresponding learning materials. Participants will further review the methods of identifying the learning characteristics of students with severe or multiple disabilities and how the acquired educational strategies and skills will benefit these students. On completion of the course, participants will be able to apply the necessary professional knowledge and skills in catering for the students with severe or multiple disabilities, and coordinate expertise, manpower and resources within the school to support these students.
en.description: The Course is Part II and Part III of Training Course for Special School Teachers (TCSST) and is restricted to serving teachers of aided special schools who have completed the 18-hour FCSST offered by EDB starting from 2023/24 school year or enrolled in TCSST Part I (Training Calendar System Course ID: SE0020270014). Part II of TCSST consists of 37 days (222 hours) theory-based lectures to be conducted 6 hours a day in a full-time block-release mode. The lectures comprises four modules: (i)theories, principles and practices in special education; (ii)academic and learning support; (iii)behavioural, emotional, and social development support; and (iv)sensory, communication and physical support. Part III is a 6-month practicum to be conducted after the completion of the theory-based lectures. The course instructors will organise teaching practice, lesson observation cum post-lesson discussion and experience sharing sessions, etc., to help teachers apply what they have learnt in class.
en.background:
To enhance the professional capacity of special school teachers in supporting students with special educational needs, starting from the 2012/13 school year, the EDB has organised the “Training Course for Special School Teachers” (TCSST) on supporting students with more severe or multiple disabilities for special school teachers, which comprises 240-hour theory-based lectures and a six-month practicum.
Starting from the 2026/27 school year, TCSST will consist of three parts: Part I Foundation Course for Special School Teacher (FCSST) (18 hours), Part II In-depth Course (222 hours) and Part III Practicum (6 months). Teachers who have completed the FCSST and enrolled in Part II and Part III of TCSST within 5 years will be considered to have completed Part I of the TCSST and will not be required to re-take Part I.

zh.objective: 本課程目的是提升特殊學校教師的專業知識及教學技巧，以照顧在特殊學校就讀的有嚴重或多重殘疾學生的教育需要。課程內容將會理論與實踐並重，包括訂立及早介入計劃及發展相關的教材。學員會更深入地探討，識別有嚴重或多重殘疾的學生學習特性的方案以及支援策略，致使這些學生受益。修畢課程後，學員將可以應用有關的專業知識及技巧，照顧有嚴重或多重殘疾的學生，並在校內統籌專業人員、人力及資源，以支援該類學生。
zh.description: 本課程為「特殊學校教師培訓課程」的第二及第三部分。申請者必須是在職的資助特殊學校教師，並且已完成教育局於2023/24學年起提供的18小時「特殊學校教師基礎課程」或已申請報讀「特殊學校教師培訓課程第一部分︰特殊學校教師基礎課程」(培訓行事曆系統課程編號︰SE0020270014)。「特殊學校教師培訓課程」的第二部分是為期37天（222小時）的理論課，每天6個小時，並採用全日整段時間給假培訓模式。理論課分為四個單元：（i） 特殊教育的理論、原則和實踐方法；（ii）學業及學習方面的支援；（iii）行為、情緒及社群發展方面的支援；以及（iv）感知、溝通及肢體方面的支援。課程的第三部分是為期6個月的教學實習活動，將在學員完成理論課後進行。課程導師會安排教學實習、觀課及課後討論及經驗分享會等，協助學員把所學知識應用於課堂上。
zh.background:
為提高特殊學校教師支援有特殊教育需要學生的專業能力，教育局由2012/13學年起，為在職特殊學校教師舉辦以支援有較嚴重或多重殘疾的學生為主題的「特殊學校教師培訓課程」，當中包括240小時的理論課及六個月的實習課。
由2026/27學年起，「特殊學校教師培訓課程」將由三部分組成，分別是第一部分的「特殊學校教師培訓課程」（18小時）、第二部分的進階課程（222小時）和第三部分的實習課（6個月）。完成18小時「特殊學校教師基礎課程」的教師，可在5年內報讀第二部分和第三部分的「特殊學校教師培訓課程」，而無需重複修讀第一部分。

en.description: This 12-hour seminar is one of the core training programmes offered by the EDB for teachers aspiring for promotion. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDBC6/2020 and EDBC29/2024.
en.background:

For promotion to SGM, PSM and EO, teachers must also complete the training programme on "Professional Vision and Growth of School Leaders" and "Reflection and Practice of Professional Leadership".
For promotion to PGM, SPSM and SEO, teachers must also complete the training programme on "School Administration and Management".

en.objective:
The programme aims at promoting participants’ ability to support non-Chinese speaking children learning Chinese by equipping
participants with theories, knowledge, skills on learning and teaching Chinese as additional language in early childhood context and by applying what participants learn in classrooms.
en.description:
Two identical classes will be offered under the programme. Applicants can select any class to fit their schedule.
Each class is made up of 6 lecture sessions and 1 sharing session.
Highlights of the programme:
Session 1:
‧Difficulties of learning Chinese for NCS children in kindergartens
‧Context of Chinese learning for NCS children in kindergartens
‧Culturally Responsive Teaching Strategies and Techniques
Session 2:
‧Chinese language focus for NCS children, including Cantonese sound system, component, morphemes, etc.
‧From the concept of “Frame” to learning and teaching of vocabulary and sentence patterns in Chinese language
Session 3:
‧Developing Young Children's Chinese Listening and Speaking Abilities in a Whole-School Approach: Concepts and Instructional Strategies
Session 4:
‧Concepts of Chinese Character Acquisition and Literacy Development in Non-Chinese Speaking Young Children
‧Strategies for Enhancing Young Children's Reading and Writing Skills Within a Whole-School Approach
Session 5:
‧Using "Chinese Language Learning Progression Framework" to assess NCS children’s Chinese language ability
‧Assessment for learning: to improve instruction and teaching based on the understanding of NCS children’s Chinese language ability
Session 6:
‧Applying various instruction strategies to design holistic learning experience, which integrating Chinese language learning experience with other learning areas, of NCS children
‧Smooth transition for NCS children from kindergartens to primary schools
Sharing session:
‧Applying the acquired knowledge and strategies in classrooms and sharing integration of theories and practice with fellow participants
‧Feedback from instructor to further promote teaching effectiveness
en.background:
Education for non-Chinese speaking (NCS) children is one of the important components of Kindergarten Education in Hong Kong.
The earlier the NCS children learn Chinese, the better effect of learning and social inclusion there will be for them.
With the launch of the Kindergarten Education Scheme in 2017/2018,
this Professional Development Programme is designed and launched for raising kindergarten teachers’ competence and efficacy in teaching NCS children.

zh.objective: 本課程旨在提升學員支援非華語幼兒學習中文的能力，加強學員對相關理論、知識和技巧的認識和應用。
zh.description:
本課程共有兩班，各班內容相同，教師可申請報讀任何一班。
每班包括六個授課課節及一個分享環節。
課程要點如下：
課節一：
‧非華語幼兒在學習中文上所面對的困難
‧非華語學生的背景與需要
‧文化回應教學策略與技巧
課節二：
‧非華語學生中文學習的語言焦點，包括廣東話語音、部件、語素等概念
‧「語義框架」的概念，以及詞彙和句型教學的基本觀念
課節三：
‧在全校參與模式中發展幼兒中文聽說能力的理念以及相關教學方法
課節四：
‧非華語幼兒中文識字能力發展的概念
‧在全校參與模式中提升幼兒閱讀與書寫能力的策略
課節五：
‧評估非華語幼兒中文能力的方法
‧如何透過了解非華語學生水平調適教學，促進學習
課節六：
‧在綜合學習活動中運用所學的策略，為非華語幼兒規劃學習經驗
‧幼小銜接的觀念
分享環節：
‧教師按其校情，將已學知識和策略加以運用，累積實際教學經驗與同儕分享
‧講者進行總結、給予回饋，共同提升教學效能。
zh.background:
非華語幼兒教育是香港幼兒教育其中一個重要環節。非華語幼兒愈早學習中文，對他們日後的學習與融入社會愈有幫助。
為配合2017/18學年推行的幼稚園教育計劃，本課程的設計旨在提升幼稚園教師教導非華語幼兒的專業能力及成效。

en.objective: This course aims to share effective inquiry-based teaching and learning practices of the JC CoolScience Advanced Teachers through Open Classroom, and to facilitate professional exchange and development among Primary Science teachers.
en.description:
A 2.5-hour programme comprising sharing of science teaching theories and pedagogical approaches, classroom observation, and post-lesson professional sharing and reflection. The content includes:
- Sharing of science teaching theories, pedagogical approaches, and Lesson Briefing
- On-site Lesson Observation
- Post-Lesson Analysis & Evaluation
- Participants’ Sharing & Professional Exchange
en.background:
To support the implementation of Primary Science, the EDB continues to provide a series of support measures for primary teachers. “Science Inquiry”, one of the key emphases of the Science (Primary 1 - 6) Curriculum, encourages students to apply scientific methods in investigation to collect evidence and to construct knowledge. Through this process, students develop curiosity, critical thinking skills, and a spirit of inquiry.
Launched in 2024, JC CoolScience is initiated and funded by The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust, in partnership with the Education University of Hong Kong. Aligned with the implementation of Primary Science curriculum and the promotion of inquiry-based learning (IBL), JC CoolScience empowers primary science teachers to facilitate inquiry-based learning and enhances students’ experiential science learning in and beyond the classroom through professional development programmes, the "Advanced Teacher Fellowship" training, and Community of Practice activities.

zh.objective: 本課程旨在通過開放課堂，讓小學科學教師觀摩「賽馬會探索科學」計劃先鋒教師具效能的的探究式學與教實踐，促進教師之間的專業交流與發展。
zh.description:
本課程為時兩小時三十分鐘，結合科學科教學理論探討、課堂觀摩與課後專業交流反思。內容包括：
- 科學科教學理論探討及課堂簡介
- 實地觀課
- 講課及評課
- 與會者交流及分享
zh.background:
為配合小學科學科的推展，教育局持續為小學教師提供一系列支援措施。「科學探究」作為《科學（小一至小六）課程指引》的課程重點之一，強調讓學生運用科學的方法進行探究，尋找答案和發現知識，從而培養他們的好奇心和探究精神。
為配合小學科學科的推展，並推廣探究式學習(Inquiry-Based Learning)，「賽馬會探索科學」計劃於2024年啟動。計劃由香港賽馬會慈善信託基金策劃及捐助，香港教育大學為策略夥伴，透過教師專業培訓、先鋒教師培訓及教學社群活動，支援小學科學教師實踐高質素探究式學習，同時通過貫通課堂內外的體驗式學習，以提升小學科學的學與教效能。

en.objective: The course aims to enhance the capabilities of prospective Primary Science panel heads or level coordinators in science curriculum leadership and management, including curriculum leadership, curriculum interpretation, curriculum planning, safety guidelines etc.
en.description:
The course composes of 3 seminars (3 hours each) and 2 workshops (3 hours each), a total of 4 events, i.e. Event AA to AD, are provided for choosing:
Seminar (1) Curriculum Interpretation of Primary Science
- Interpret the curriculum rationale, learning objectives, curriculum framework, and diverse science learning experiences of Primary Science
- Explain the learning content within the curriculum framework through examples
Seminar (2) Curriculum Leadership and Development of Primary Science
- Introduce key aspects of curriculum leadership, including curriculum coordination, establishment of subject team, and manpower planning
- Explain the principles of curriculum design and the design of learning and teaching activities for Primary Science through examples
Seminar (3) Curriculum Planning and Management of Primary Science
- Introduce the curriculum planning of Primary Science
- Illustrate curriculum management, teacher professional development, curriculum implementation and evaluation of Primary Science through examples
Workshop (1) Curriculum Planning and Management of Primary Science
- Design learning plans for different levels based on a specific theme
- Explain the practical operation of curriculum planning and management of Primary Science through examples
Workshop (2) Design of Learning and Teaching Activities and Assessment for Primary Science
- Design learning and teaching activities or diversified assessment strategies for a specific topic
- Explain the design of learning and teaching activities and diversified assessment for Primary Science through examples
- Explore the effective use of AI tools in Science learning and teaching
en.background: To tie in with the implementation of Primary Science (PS), the captioned professional development programme will be provided to aspiring subject panel heads or level coordinators of PS.

zh.objective: 課程旨在提升擬任小學科學科主任或級統籌的科學課程領導和管理的能力，內容包括課程領導、課程詮釋、課程規劃、安全指引等。
zh.description:
課程由三個研討會（每個 3 小時）及兩個工作坊（每個 3小時）組成，提供 AA 至 AD 共 4 場次讓申請者選擇：
研討會（一）小學科學課程詮釋
- 詮釋小學科學科的課程理念、學習目標、課程架構及多元的科學學習經歷
- 透過例子講解課程框架內的學習內容
研討會（二）小學科學課程領導和發展
- 介紹小學科學科的課程領導要點，包括統籌本科課程、建立學科團隊、人手規劃
- 透過例子講解小學科學科課程設計原則及學與教活動的設計
研討會（三）小學科學課程規劃和管理
- 介紹小學科學課程規劃
- 透過例子說明小學科學科的課程管理、教師專業發展、課程實施與評鑑
工作坊（一）小學科學課程規劃和管理
- 就某一主題設計各級的學習計劃
- 透過例子講解小學科學課程規劃和管理的實務操作
工作坊（二）小學科學學與教活動和評估設計
- 就某一課題設計學與教活動／多元評估方法
- 透過例子解釋設計小學科學學與教活動和多元評估
- 探討人工智能工具於科學科學與教的有效運用
zh.background: 為配合小學科學科的開展，本局為擬任小學科學科科主任或級統籌設計了本專業發展課程。

en.background:
With the rapid development of information technology, the use of the Internet and social media has become an integral part of students' daily lives and an important means of communication. It is of utmost importance, and a matter of shared concern for schools, families and society, to equip students with digital safety awareness, nurture in them positive values and attitudes such as self-discipline, law-abidingness and respect for others, enhance their awareness of cybercrime, and prevent cyberbullying and online scams.
To encourage schools to promote healthy Internet use and cyber security, the Education Bureau has launched the Wise NET School Recognition Scheme to commend schools for their dedicated efforts in this area. This Recognition Scheme echoes the “Forging Relationships, Nurturing Well-being” School Campaign launched in the 2026/27 school year, aiming to further promote a harmonious and caring school culture and enhance the understanding and awareness among teachers and students on preventing and handling school bullying (including cyberbullying).

zh.objective:
1. 讓學校人員了解與校園相關的網絡欺凌現況；
2. 透過個案分享，讓學校人員掌握處理網絡欺凌的技巧；
3. 探討學校人員在預防校園欺凌（包括網絡欺凌）所擔當的角色；及
4. 表揚參與本計劃的學校。
zh.description: 請參閱附件
zh.background:
隨著資訊科技的急速發展，使用互聯網及社交媒體已成為學生的日常生活習慣及重要溝通方式。教導學生安全使用資訊科技，培養他們自律、守法、尊重他人等的正確價值觀和態度，提升他們對網絡罪行的認識，以及預防網絡欺凌及網上陷阱等尤為重要，也是學校、家庭和社會共同關注的課題。
為鼓勵學校推動健康使用互聯網和網絡安全方面，教育局舉辦「理智NET」校園嘉許計劃，表揚學校在有關工作的不懈努力。本嘉許計劃亦與2026/27學年推出的「友『晴』凝聚校園大行動」的目的互相呼應，旨在進一步推廣和諧關愛的校園文化，提升師生對預防和處理校園欺凌(包括網絡欺凌)的認識與關注。

en.objective: 是次培訓活動為「史智承傳」系列的 內地考察必修課程 ，旨在透過廣州歷史文化考察、文化體驗活動及講座，讓教師認識配合初中中國歷史課程的歷史文化項目，欣賞、關懷及傳承中國歷史文化遺產，並啟發教師思考如何以中國歷史文化深厚的底蘊加強愛國主義教育。
en.description: 請參閱附件。
en.background:
《行政長官2024年施政報告》提出「由2024/25學年起三年內為約1 000位非主修歷史的初中中國歷科教師提供培訓名額」。就此，教育局現舉辦「史智承傳：非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師專業發展」計劃（簡稱「史智承傳」），支援非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師接受相關專業發展培訓，以提升教師在中國歷史教育的專業能力，強化學與教效能，以加強培養學生的國民身份認同。
「史智承傳」系列的專業發展課程涵蓋本地課程及內地考察兩個範疇，各範疇內容如下：
A. 本地課程（共12小時）：
1. 初中中國歷史科課程詮釋（必修，3小時）
2. 博物館參觀或歷史考察（必修，3小時）
3. 知識增益 / 教學策略（選修：任選兩個課程，6小時）
B. 內地考察：廣州考察（兩天一晚） * 包括簡介會及講座（必修，18小時）
凡完成30小時「史智承傳」系列專業發展計劃的教師，將獲頒發完成證書。
詳情可參看教育局通函第124/2026號
https://applications.edb.gov.hk/circular/upload/EDBCM/EDBCM26124C.pdf
en.cpd:
CPD Mode:
Structured Learning
CPD Hours:
18.0 Hour(s)
CPD Domain:
I. Teaching & Learning

4. 現任及擬任非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師 * 優先，同時歡迎其他中國歷史科教師參加。

en.objective:
(Chinese version only)
本課程旨在提升教師及校長推動國家安全教育的專業素養，加強他們對國家安全的整體認知，協助他們準確掌握《香港國安法》及《維護國家安全條例》的核心原則，在校園中以身作則、發揮楷模作用，做好國家安全教育，培育更多具備國家觀念與法治意識的未來棟樑，為國家和香港的繁榮發展作出貢獻。
en.description:
(Chinese version only)
本課程設有兩個專題，本節屬專題二「國家安全的實踐與推行」的三小時培訓，課堂內容如下：
內容包括解釋「總體國家安全觀」，說明關鍵領域（如政治、經濟、網絡安全等）、重要性及其時代背景；闡述《「一國兩制」下香港維護國家安全的實踐》白皮書及其他相關文件內容；分析國際形勢下的國家安全挑戰及應對；闡述香港國安機構的架構、職能，以及與國家的關係；以及闡述學校在國安教育中的角色和責任等。
一般情況下，參加者須準時出席及完成整個時長三小時的課程，並於課程結束後簽署「出席表格」，方可獲發相關培訓時數。參加者如遲到超逾三十分鐘，將視作缺席課程（即不會獲發放任何培訓時數）。
en.background:
(Chinese version only)
國家安全是安邦定國的重要基石。《香港國安法》和《維護國家安全條例》的制定與實施，既體現了中央政府對香港有關的國家安全事務負有根本責任，也彰顯了香港特別行政區切實履行維護國家安全的憲制責任。
為進一步強化教師及校長在維護國家安全方面的意識，教育局特別舉辦「維護國安」教師專題課程（下稱「課程」），並邀請不同專家擔任講者，就「國家安全的法治框架」及「國家安全的實踐與推行」兩大專題與參加敎師及校長進行深入探討和互動交流，以協助他們準確掌握國家安全的核心原則，並提升其推動國家安全教育專業素養。

en.description: 此活動內容包括專題講座、學校參訪、企業參觀，以及文化設施和歷史遺跡參觀。
en.background: 教育局在2020年6月10日發出第6/2020號通告，公布建立教師專業階梯及相關措施。為協助新入職教師掌握其專業角色，展現專業操守和價值觀，並掌握最新的教育政策和措施的發展，以適切地應用於教學工作，教育局訂定了新入職教師培訓課程。由2020/21學年起，首次於公營學校或直接資助計劃學校任教的教師，必須於首三年內完成30小時的核心培訓，以及按個人專業發展需要參與不少於60小時的選修培訓。

en.objective:
本課程旨在為中學語文教師提供中國文學經典的文本分析訓練，從宏觀的視野如風格、意象、時代特徵等角度來分析，使學員對經典範文有多面的理解和闡釋，並將課程所學融入日常教學之中。學員修畢本課程後，應能：
1. 掌握文本分析的理念及步驟；
2. 了解文本分析方法；
3. 認識經典文學文本的宏觀研究視野；
4. 透過不同文本的意象，了解個別文本的特點；
5. 提升對相關課題的賞析與評鑑能力；
6. 經典文學作品在現代社會的意義和應用；及
7. 運用恰當的教學策略和技巧，引導學生學習，並解決課堂教學的問題。

en.objective: To enhance the capabilities of Primary Science teachers in conducting science field trips and educational visits for primary students, as well as to introduce some outdoor learning / visiting spots that complement the Primary Science curriculum to teachers.
en.description:
The programme will include the following:
1. Visit the Ho Koon Nature Education cum Astronomical Centre.
2. Recognise the educational resources of the Ho Koon Nature Education cum Astronomical Centre, understanding how the resources can be used to facilitate and enrich the learning and teaching of Primary Science.
3. Hands-on activities:
- Experience daytime and nighttime astronomical observations, using different astronomical observation tools and apps to observe the sun, stars, moon, constellations, etc.
- Simulation of the night sky in a digital planetarium.
en.background: To tie in with the introduction of Primary Science starting in the 2025/26 school year, the EDB continues to provide a series of professional development programmes for primary teachers. As learning science inside and beyond classroom is encouraged in the new Primary Science curriculum, a set of programmes “Learning Beyond Classroom Series for Primary Science” will be conducted in the 2026/27 school year to equip teachers with the necessary knowledge and skills in conducting science field trips and educational visits for primary students.

zh.description:
本課程包括以下内容：
1. 參觀可觀自然教育中心暨天文館。
2. 認識可觀自然教育中心暨天文館的教育資源，了解如何有效運用這些教育資源促進和增潤小學科學科的學與教。

en.objective:
此課程旨在培養在職幼稚園教師需要的知識與技能，透過中國視覺藝術向幼兒推廣中華文化，著重提升學員對中華傳統文化價值觀的了解。這些價值觀源自於古代中國哲學，並融入在中國不同類型的視覺藝術中（例如：國畫、建築等）。
本課程焦點在於幫助學員建立設計與實踐校本課程的能力，從而推廣中華文化。課程具有實用取向，重視專業知識交流，安排學員討論及分享不同幼稚園的教學實踐。學員將審視、認識和欣賞中國視覺藝術在培養幼兒愛國情懷的價值。課程亦會探討品德教育理論和傳統美德的概念，以指導中華文化推廣的教學實踐。

en.objective:
(i) To enrich primary science teachers’ knowledge about local fauna & flora, understanding of the impact of human activity on urban biodiversity, and importance of wildlife conservation.
(ii) To equip primary science teachers with knowledge and practical skills to conduct inquiry-based and experiential learning activities.
en.description:

- KFBG as a key ecological restoration site and an outdoor science classroom
- Effective inquiry-based and experiential learning pedagogies

- Local biodiversity and ecosystem interconnectedness
- Ecological roles and traditional practices of local plants
- Sensory exploration and structural observation
- Urban threats to wildlife and conservation initiatives
Part 3: Debriefing
- KFBG programmes and practical applications in school settings

en.objective: The course allows teachers to learn about the natural resources and eco-farming in Lai Chi Wo through a guided tour, explore the historical architecture of Sha Tau Kok, and examine how to build sustainable villages and communities in Hong Kong, putting the concepts of carbon neutrality and sustainable development into practice.
en.description: Lai Chi Wo is a Hakka walled village near Sha Tau Kok. It is a place full of natural beauty, ancient buildings, and old stories. In 2020, the Lai Chi Wo rural revitalisation project received the inaugural Special Recognition for Sustainable Development in the UNESCO Asia-Pacific Awards for Cultural Heritage Conservation. In this field trip, teachers will learn about the history and culture of Lai Chi Wo as well as the ecology of mangrove and feng shui woodlands. They will have the opportunity to interact with local villagers, learn about eco-farming and experience a short hands-on farmwork session.

zh.description: 荔枝窩是鄰近沙頭角的客家圍村，充滿自然之美、古色古香的建築與悠久的歷史故事。2020年，荔枝窩鄉郊復育項目榮獲聯合國教科文組織亞太區文化遺產保護獎頒發首屆「可持續發展特別認可」。在是次實地考察中，教師將認識荔枝窩的歷史文化，以及紅樹林和風水林的生態。他們亦將有機會與當地村民交流，了解生態耕種，並體驗簡短的農務體驗活動。

en.objective: 「領航計劃」學員研習方向廣泛，涵蓋各個重要的學校發展範疇，例如在學校領導與管理方面，着重領導效能、團隊建設及學校持續發展；在課程發展方面，關注校本課程、跨學科學習及課程銜接；在學與教創新方面，探討人工智能、數位學習、探究學習及評估策略的應用；在教師專業發展方面，重視專業協作、學習社群及教研文化；在學生培育方面，則涵蓋價值觀教育、家國情懷、文化素養及全人發展。整體而言，各項研究從學校治理、課程教學、教師成長及學生發展等不同層面，回應學校發展的實際需要。
en.description: 第二期「領航計劃」領航教師將擔任講者，並分別於兩個時段主持共八節平行分享環節，內容涵蓋多個主題，詳情請參閱附件。平行分享環節以75分鐘為一節，每位參加者將獲安排參與兩節平行分享環節。
en.background: 教育局於2024/25學年，以先導形式推行「領航教師及校長培訓計劃」(下稱「領航計劃」)，旨在發掘和培養具堅定的專業信念和使命、願意不斷學習教學新知、積極探究創新策略且具優秀潛質的教師和校長，透過擔任領航導師的內地專家教師專業指導，配合香港教師研修及交流基地的專業資源，使他們從勝任走向優秀、從優秀走向卓越，以壯大香港教師和校長專業團隊，提升專業力量，為香港和國家作出貢獻。本次活動旨在總結及展示第二期參與者學習成果，並為教育工作者提供專業交流平台。

en.objective: 是次培訓活動為「史智承傳」系列的 內地考察必修課程 ，旨在透過廣州歷史文化考察、文化體驗活動及講座，讓教師認識配合初中中國歷史課程的歷史文化項目，欣賞、關懷及傳承中國歷史文化遺產，並啟發教師思考如何以中國歷史文化深厚的底蘊加強愛國主義教育。
en.description: 請參閱附件。
en.background:
《行政長官2024年施政報告》提出「由2024/25學年起三年內為約1 000位非主修歷史的初中中國歷科教師提供培訓名額」。就此，教育局現舉辦「史智承傳：非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師專業發展」計劃（簡稱「史智承傳」），支援非主修歷史的初中中國歷史科教師接受相關專業發展培訓，以提升教師在中國歷史教育的專業能力，強化學與教效能，以加強培養學生的國民身份認同。
「史智承傳」系列的專業發展課程涵蓋本地課程及內地考察兩個範疇，各範疇內容如下：
A. 本地課程（共12小時）：
1. 初中中國歷史科課程詮釋（必修，3小時）
2. 博物館參觀或歷史考察（必修，3小時）
3. 知識增益 / 教學策略（選修：任選兩個課程，6小時）
B. 內地考察：廣州考察（兩天一晚） * 包括簡介會及講座（必修，18小時）
凡完成30小時「史智承傳」系列專業發展計劃的教師，將獲頒發完成證書。
詳情可參看教育局通函第124/2026號
https://applications.edb.gov.hk/circular/upload/EDBCM/EDBCM26124C.pdf

en.objective: 本課程旨在增進初中地理老師對修訂中一至中三地理課程中所建議的探究式實地考察設計和實施的認識。透過實踐考察技能和實地考察等體驗式學習活動，學員可以在課堂上分析、探索、發現並重構考察設計。本課程從分析考察研習活動開始，引導學員探索並歸納有效考察設計的原則、步驟和評估方法，並透過實踐考察研習活動，加深了解設計原則和如何持續優化。本課程以學員分組設計和匯報配合地理課程、切合校情和學生學習需要的考察研習活動作結，讓學員可以應用所學，連繫理論與實踐。

en.objective:
學員修畢本課程後，應能：
1. 辨識從生理、心理、社會和文化因素對具多元學習需要幼兒（包括：有特殊需要或發展遲緩危機的幼兒）的個別差異和特徵所產生的影響。
2. 應用必要的知識和技能，以便提供公平和支持性的學習環境予具多元學習需要的幼兒。
3. 設計和實施適合的課程，以迎合所有在不同學前課室的幼兒之需要。
4. 為具有多元學習需要的幼兒採用廣泛的學與教策略。
5. 採用多元和適當的評估技巧以評估和監測具有不同需求的幼兒之進展。

zh.objective:
1.深入理解大型語言模型（LLM）的文字生成邏輯，靈活運用精准提示詞精煉教學腳本與分鏡腳本（Storyboards）
2. 精通 AI 文本轉語音（TTS）、智能圖像生成（Text-to-Image）技術，優化教學內容呈現
3. 運用 AI 智能剪輯與自動字幕生成（Auto-Captioning）技術，大幅縮短多媒體教材製作週期，提升教學資源產出效率
zh.description:
1. 運用 LLM 進行教學大綱拆解，快速生成具備教學法（Pedagogy）架構的短片腳本與分鏡說明
2. 示範透過圖像生成模型繪製高畫質教學插圖，並結合 TTS 技術生成自然多語種教學配音
3.操作 AI 數位人播報平台，將靜態腳本轉換為具備自然表情與口型同步（Lip-sync）的虛擬教師講課影片
4.使用 AI 剪輯軟體進行自動語音轉字幕、去噪與智能 B-roll 匹配，完成一站式教學短片產出

en.objective: 本教師專業進修課程證書旨在裝備幼兒教育工作者提升引導幼兒投入多感官大自然學習經驗的能力，通過探索自然世界和生活體驗，培養幼兒的好奇心和探索精神。此外，學員會研究以不同的方法連接幼兒與大自然，培養他們從小愛護大自然的價值觀、態度和行為。學員更將會在課程中學習到如何檢視幼兒在活動中的表現，以及如何把大自然教育融入校本課程中，以幫助幼兒掌握探索的技能，培養適齡的探究技能，為小學過渡作準備。

en.objective: 本課程旨在深化小學科學教師對天文與航天科學核心知識及最新發展的認識。透過探討小學階段的天文與航天科學核心課題，學員能理解並掌握主要天文現象的背後原理，以及航天科學的最新發展。課程亦會討論未來的太空探索與太空飛行商業化，並示範教授天文與航天科學的實用教學法和人工智能支援的學習平台。除了學科知識評估外，學員須設計一個校本天文與航天科學的課堂，從而讓教師能將所學到的學科知識與教學技巧，實際應用於課堂教學之中。

Workshop(1) aims at promoting participants’ ability to support non-Chinese speaking children to develop speaking and listening skills in Chinese by equipping
participants with relevant theories, knowledge, teaching strategies and skills on learning and teaching Chinese as additional language in early childhood context and by applying what participants learn in classrooms.

Two workshops with different themes will be held on 5 March 2027 and 19 March 2027 respectively in this school year. Applicants can apply for one of them or register for both workshops respectively.
Highlights of Workshop (1): Second Language Acquisition in Early Childhood: Teaching Listening and Speaking
‧Understanding the Difficulties and Challenges Non-Chinese Speaking Students Face in Developing Listening and Speaking Skills
‧Concepts and Teaching Methods for Developing Young Children's Chinese Listening and Speaking Abilities
en.background:
There are two different themed workshops aimed at enhancing the ability of participants who have not enrolled in basic courses to support non-Chinese speaking children in learning Chinese.
The workshops will strengthen participants' understanding and application of relevant theories, knowledge, and skills related to teaching Chinese as an additional language in early childhood contexts.

en.objective: This course aims to assist newly-joined teachers to understand their professional roles and demonstrate professional conduct and values.
en.description:
The content of this course includes "T-standard + " : Professional Standards for Teachers of Hong Kong, teachers’ professional conduct and relevant guidelines, etc.
After successful completion of the course, newly-joined teachers' (i.e. full-time teachers appointed to teach in public sector or DSS schools from the 2020/21 school year) training hours will be recorded under the "core training" of newly-joined teachers. Details of the relevant training requirements can be found in the EDB Circular No. 6/2020 and EDB Circular No. 29/2024 .
en.background: The Education Bureau (EDB) Circular No. 6/2020 issued on June 10, 2020 announced the establishment of Professional Ladder for Teachers and relevant measures. A training programme has been developed to help newly-joined teachers understand their professional roles, demonstrate professional values and conduct, and keep abreast of the latest developments in education policies. Starting from the 2020/21 school year, teachers appointed to teach in public sector or DSS schools for the first time are required to complete 30 hours of core training within the first three years of service, and not less than 60 hours of elective training based on individual professional development needs.

en.objective:
在這複雜多變的時代，幼兒教育領袖需要裝備自己，以應對瞬息萬變的社會環境，並滿足持份者日益增長的期望。本課程旨在為擔任領導角色的教育工作者提供應對21世紀新挑戰所需的技能，以促進學校改進和團隊創新。本課程同時促進未來幼兒教育領域中不同層面的創新領導發展。
學員修畢本課程後，應能：
1. 認識變革領導、創新領導及綜合領導的理論知識
2. 檢視學校改進的重要創新模式
3. 分析變革管理、危機管理、團隊管理及資訊科技管理的有效領導策略

en.objective:
本課程旨在提升學校領導人員對人工智能於學校領導及管理層面的理解與應用能力。課程將協助學員掌握 AI 的基礎概念及其對學校決策、治理及長遠發展的影響，培養策略性思維及倫理意識，並引導學員運用 AI 促進學校創新文化及專業實踐。透過案例分析及實作導向學習，課程期望裝備學員有效及負責任地領導學校在數碼時代的轉型與發展。
完成此課程後，學員將能夠：
1. 展示對有關人工智能 (AI) 在學校領導中的機遇、風險及其倫理影響的基本理解；
2. 制定並實施由AI驅動的策略，以提升學校運作，包括決策、風險管理、預算規劃及資源分配；以及
3. 於AI時代建立並帶領創新文化，並以推動新興科技的合乎道德的及負責任的使用為重點。

1. 展示對有關人工智能 (AI) 在學校領導中的機遇、風險及其倫理影響的基本理解；

3. 於AI時代建立並帶領創新文化，並以推動新興科技的合乎道德的及負責任的使用為重點。

en.objective:
資訊科技和互聯網絡的高速發展令大量知識迅速湧現，為學校領導在管理學校持續發展帶來相當大的挑戰和機遇。如何協助學校建立一個能促進知識分享和承傳的系統，強化學校獲取知識的學習能力，發展學校智慧資產，是學校領導者不能忽視的課題。這個課程提供一系列的知識管理理論、策略及技巧，透過行動學習發展學員知識審計、製定知識策略、建立知識共享及轉移機制和管理學校知識資本的能力，促進學校的持續發展。
本課程旨在：
1. 闡釋知識管理的理論、策略、方法和工具、以及在學校推行知識管理的技巧。
2. 裝備學員在規劃、推動、執行、監控和評鑑知識管理計劃等各方面的技能。
3. 提高學員的個人知識管理能力，藉以分析知識管理在發展智慧資本和促進學校效能的角色。
本課程適合有意應用知識管理促進學校持續發展的學校管理人員報讀。本課程包含下列三個單元：
1. 知識管理與學校發展（理論）;
2. 知識管理與學校發展（實踐）; 及
3. 學校智慧資本管理。

en.objective:
The Advanced Course would be equipped with a broadened and deepened view on effective learning and curriculum development.
Go beyond the specific contexts and incorporate knowledge and strategies related to general learning mechanisms and system-level measures at schools.
en.description:
This course is made up of 12 lecture sessions and 1 sharing session.
Highlights of the programme:
Session 1:
‧ The concepts and content of the 5+ Strategies for Supporting Non-Chinese-Speaking Children in Learning Chinese.
In-depth exploration of the concept and teaching strategies of listening and speaking instruction to effectively implement the idea of teaching non-Chinese-speaking preschoolers Chinese in Hong Kong.
Session 2:
‧ Based on the concept of "semantic framework", this study explores the concept and teaching strategies of character recognition instruction,
and combines it with cultural responsive teaching to effectively implement the idea of teaching non-Chinese-speaking preschoolers Chinese in Hong Kong.
Session 3 & 4:
‧ The concept and teaching strategies of reading and writing instruction, explores the principles and strategies for adapting or developing learning materials (such as children's songs, storybooks, teaching aids, etc.),
and designs suitable classes and courses for non-Chinese-speaking preschoolers to learn Chinese in Hong Kong.
Session 5 & 6:
‧ Explores assessment strategies for Chinese language proficiency and the application of the "assessment for learning" concept.
Session 7:
‧ Strategies for cultivating children's independent learning abilities.
Session 8:
‧ Participants’ sharing of the group work and Instructors’ feedback and recommendations
Session 9:
‧ The principles and strategies for reviewing, adapting, and developing school-based curriculum
Session 10:
‧ Advanced knowledge in promoting smooth transition for NCS students on Chinese learning from kindergartens to primary schools
Session 11:
‧ The principles and strategies for conducting effective classroom observations for curriculum leaders include. Use AI-powered tools to develop resources for effective teaching and learning.
Session 12:
‧ Strengthening Chinese language learning through school-wide participation; promoting home-school cooperation and utilizing community resources to enhance Chinese language learning.
Sharing session:
‧ Applying the acquired knowledge and strategies in classrooms and sharing integration of theories and practice with fellow participants
‧ Feedback from instructor to further promote teaching effectiveness
en.background:
Education for non-Chinese speaking (NCS) children is one of the important components of Kindergarten Education in Hong Kong.
The earlier the NCS children learn Chinese, the better effect of learning and social inclusion there will be for them.
With the launch of the Kindergarten Education Scheme in 2017/2018, the Advanced Course would be equipped with a broadened and deepened view on effective learning and curriculum development.
Go beyond the specific contexts and incorporate knowledge and strategies related to general learning mechanisms and system-level measures at schools.

zh.objective: 進階課程旨在強化幼稚園校長、主任及教師支援非華語幼兒學習中文的專業能力, 透過理論講授和分組討論, 為非華語幼兒學習中文提供實證理論及有效實踐經驗, 以提升學與教的質素,發展適切的校本支援策略。
zh.description:
本課程包括十二個授課課節及一個分享環節。
課程要點如下：
課節一：
‧ 支援非華語幼兒學習中文的「5+策略」的概念及內容；深入探討聽說教學的理念與教學策略，以有效實現香港非華語幼兒學習中文的理念
課節二：
‧ 以「語義框架」概念作基礎，深入探討識字教學的理念與教學策略，並結合文化回應教學，更有效實現香港非華語幼兒學習中文的理念
課節三及四：
‧ 深入探討讀寫教學的理念與教學策略；探討調適或發展學習材料(如兒歌、故事書、教具等)的原則與策略；設計適合香港非華語幼兒學習中文的課堂與課程
課節五及六：
‧ 深入探討中文能力評估策略；「學習促進評估」理念的應用
課節七：
‧ 培養幼兒自主學習能力的策略
課節八：
‧ 小組分享學習任務成果，討論與交流經驗
課節九：

en.objective:
本課程旨在讓學員認識傳統中華文化的核心概念及其對現代中國的影響，並提升他們在中、小學中國語文科推行愛國主義教育的效能。課程通過示例分析、講授、討論及小組研習，提升學員掌握選取教材、善用教學策略和評估，在日常課堂融入與愛國主義教育相關的學習元素，以促進學生學習。學員修畢本課程後，應能：
1. 理解中華經典的基本內容、中華文化的價值及其對當代中國的影響；
2. 理解中華文化與中國式現代化之間的互動與轉化，以及與文化安全的關係；
3. 認同優秀中華文化，培養對國家和民族的感情；以及
4. 在日常生活中欣賞和傳承優秀中華文化，掌握推動愛國主義教育的策略，並將其應用於課堂教學，以培養學生愛國情懷。

en.objective:
本課程旨在向在職小學及中學教師介紹自主學習的重要概念，包括在動機範疇 (motivational)、認知(cognitive)以及元認知(metacognitive)三方面的最新自主學習模式。通過本課程，學員將會探討在培養學生成為自主學習者的教學過程中，在設計教材、評估學生的自主學習能力時所面對的問題及挑戰。同時，本課程亦提供機會，讓教師發展和實踐結合自主學習理念的教學設計及教學範式，從而協助學生訂定學習計劃、自我調節學習，以及自我評鑑和檢視學習成效。
本課程旨在：
1. 提升學員在自主學習的學科教學知識，及深化其對自主學習相關理論的理解；
2. 發展教師運用自主學習元素，設計有效課堂教學的能力；
3. 讓教師掌握利用自主學習元素評鑑教學設計及教學實踐的知識和技巧，提升教師專業能力。

en.objective:
本課程旨在為校長和教師提供最新的知識和技能，讓他們能夠為7至12歲兒童實施有效的人工智能教學活動。對於兒童而言，其重點在於發展他們的人工智能知識與技能，並培養對其應用負責任的態度。本課程旨在支持教育領導者和教師理解人工智能和整合人工智能於教學和管理工作。本課程有四個核心目標：
1. 提供人工智能的基礎知識，包括機器學習的關鍵概念，特別是深度學習，以建立校長及教師在學校管理和教學等教育環境中合理和有效地使用人工智能。
2. 引入最新的人工智能技術並整合到各個科目或跨科的學習活動設計，促進校長及教師理解人工智能驅動的社會，並為人工智能影響的未來社會變革做好準備。
3. 介紹一系列前沿的人工智能平台、工具和應用程式，讓校長及教師在學校教育中使用，並借此促進參與者連接計算思維與未來人工智能發展的思考。
4. 使教育工作者與學校管理人員能有效應對個人資料隱私與網路安全挑戰。
參與者成功完成本課程將能：
• 運用人工智能知識及技術分析教育環境，並識別適當的人工智能使用方式，以促進學生的學習和支持有效的學校管理。
• 運用合適的人工智能平台、工具和應用程式，設計和開發創新性的教材，例如教育對話機器人，以滿足特定的教育需求和豐富課堂體驗。
• 運用最新的人工智能技術設計整合到各個科目或跨科的學習活動設計，以更好地理解充斥人工智能的未來社會。
• 運用校長及教師對計算思維的理解，特別是對算法思維的理解，獨立地審視當前人工智能技術的優缺點，並就其未來發展表達有依據的觀點。

en.objective:
This programme is designed to help primary English teachers integrate values education and positive psychology into their teaching practices.
Upon completion of the programme, participants will be able to:
Content Objectives
1. Understand the principles of positive psychology and the PERMA Model.
2. Explore key values such as perseverance, respect, and empathy.
3. Develop students’ language knowledge and skills through meaningful learning tasks and activities.
Pedagogical Objectives
1. Embed values education into English Language teaching.
2. Design engaging lesson plans and cross-curricular projects that connect with students' experiences.
3. Foster a whole-school approach to values education to promote a positive learning environment.
This programme equips teachers with strategies to support both academic and personal growth, preparing students to be well-rounded individuals in a diverse world.

en.objective: 本課程旨在提升在職幼稚園教師支援具自閉症譜系障礙相關特徵幼兒的專業能力。課程聚焦於幼兒在社交、溝通、情緒及行為方面的發展特徵與需要，並透過循序編排、結合理論講解、個案分析及課堂實踐的學習設計，協助教師掌握實證為本的教學與支援策略。完成課程後，學員將能在幼稚園環境中更有效地規劃課堂支援、制訂個別化學習計劃，並與家長及跨專業團隊協作，促進幼兒的整體發展。

en.objective:
本課程旨在協助在職中小學及特殊學校教師深入理解多項重要法律，學員修畢本課程後，應能：
1. 展示對教育相關的主要法律、法律原則、權利和義務的理解；
2. 在教學工作中遵守相關的法律概念和條例，從法律層面更好地保護學生；
3. 作為專業教師，反思如何運用解決問題和倫理決策的能力來解釋和應用相關法律原則。

en.objective: 本課程旨在為在職教師和學校領導者提供學校危機管理所需的核心知識和實用技能，課程核心在於掌握以實證爲本的預防策略、在不確定性下的應變策略，以及與多方協調的回應與善後流程。 參與者將發展出與學生、同事、家長及外部機構協作的能力，並著眼於清晰的溝通、行動的協調，以及以實證爲本的回應方案。 通過案例研究、實踐練習和模擬場景，教育工作者將增強帶領學校社群度過危機的信心，從而最大限度地減少干擾和創傷。

en.contentArea: - 學校行政及管理(與工作有關)

en.objective:
完成此課程後，學員將能夠：
1. 展現具備教導有學習困難的學生（包括有特殊教育需要的學生）學習數學所需的專業學科知識、實證教學策略及積極的專業態度；
2. 了解數學概念的漸進式學習軌道，辨識其中重要的學習微步，從而縮減學習斷層，協助學生深化理解及持續進步；
3. 設計有效且具差異化的數學學習活動，以回應學生的多元需求，並提供適切的鷹架及課程調適，以配合個別化的學習目標；以及
4. 將科技輔助與多感官教學法融入數學課堂，營造具吸引力且具支援性的學習環境，並切合不同學生的發展需要與學習特質。

en.objective:
本課程為期望通過學校自我評估（自評）及校外評核（外評）推動學校變革的校長而設。本課程旨在幫助校長學員：
1. 深入了解學校自評的性質與流程，及其與外評和「策劃 ─ 推行 ─ 評估」自評循環之間的關係；
2. 採用各種策略和方法將自評融入學校日常運作；
3. 檢視各種情境因素，將視外評轉化為促進學校完善的學習經歷；
4. 借鑑教育群體的良好經驗，與學界同工建立學習社群網絡；以及
5. 增強設計發展計劃的能力，以訂定切合校本需要及配合學校發展階段的發展計劃。

zh.objective:
本課程為期望通過學校自我評估（自評）及校外評核（外評）推動學校變革的校長而設。本課程旨在幫助校長學員：
1. 深入了解學校自評的性質與流程，及其與外評和「策劃 ─ 推行 ─ 評估」自評循環之間的關係；
2. 採用各種策略和方法將自評融入學校日常運作；
3. 檢視各種情境因素，將視外評轉化為促進學校完善的學習經歷；
4. 借鑑教育群體的良好經驗，與學界同工建立學習社群網絡；以及
5. 增強設計發展計劃的能力，以訂定切合校本需要及配合學校發展階段的發展計劃。

en.objective:
本課程旨在讓學員認識非華語學生學習中文的特點，選擇及探究適用於非華語學生的中國語文教材、教學策略及評估方法，並通過案例分析、講授、討論及小組研習，提升學員教導非華語學生學習中文的效能。學員修畢本課程後，應能：
1. 認識中國語文課程第二語言學習架構的重點；
2. 了解非華語學生學習中文的特點；
3. 選取或設計適合的教材；
4. 應用切合非華語學生學習中文的教學策略及評估方法；
5. 參考教學基本理論，設計有效的課堂教學活動與評估；
6. 運用恰當的教學策略和技巧，引導學生學習，並解決課堂教學的問題；及
7. 提升教育實務工作的處理能力。

en.objective:
本課程旨在提高在職教師教授閱讀策略的能力，幫助他們了解培養學生不同的閱讀技能的教學方法和原則。課程同時著重提升教師的評估素養，並幫助教師規劃課程和設計教材，以發展學生的高階閱讀能力。學員修畢本課程後，應能：
1. 理解閱讀能力的分類、不同的閱讀策略及其效能；
2. 熟悉語言評估的分類（如詞彙、語法及理解能力等）、語言評估不同層次水平標準及其功能；
3. 掌握有效的閱讀策略教學方法，能夠在日常教學中提高學生的不同閱讀技能；
4. 能夠在閱讀課中靈活運用進展性評估，並設計有效的總結性評估，提高學生的學習效能；
5. 掌握有效利用人工智能平台輔助閱讀教學和學習的策略。

en.objective: 本課程旨在提升參與者在數字時代中的評估素養，著重於評估數據分析與資料解讀及運用數字工具改進評估，以促進各個持份者的評估素養。參與者將學習設計評估任務、分析評估數據、解讀結果等，並運用回饋以改進學與教策略，提升傳統與數字教室中學生的學習成果。本課程亦旨在提升學校教師對於「促進學習的評估」及「作為學習的評估」概念的共同理解和意識，並促進各個持份者的合作，以提升教學和學習效能。
en.description:
此課程為五天課程（CWP013）的延長版。這個延長至五周的課程融合了理論與實踐，為參與者提供了一個扎實的學習體驗，旨在提升他們的評估素養。這涵蓋了在數字時代促進包括學生和家長在內的其他持份者的評估素養的發展。此課程將豐富參與者的教學理念，為他們提供實踐機會以分析和解讀評估資料，並加強他們運用評估數據的技能以促進教學和學生學習。
詳情請參閱 https://www.apply.eduhk.hk/pdp/zh-hant/programmes/bwp139
en.contentArea: - 工作表現管理(一般管理技巧)

en.objective:
本課程旨在提供進階知識和實務技巧，協助現職體育教師設計合適的體育課程（即：第一學習階段：基礎活動；第二至第三學習階段：小學呈分試、多元體育活動、小學體育至中學體育的銜接；第四學習階段：一般體育及高中體育選修科），並推行有效創新的教學方法，以促進學生在認知、社交、動作技能及文化層面的學習。課程將介紹、應用、研究及實踐多種認知、社交、文化及體驗式的學與教方法。此外，課程亦會探討另類課程及教學策略，如基本動作概念、新興運動、體育中的STEAM元素，以及促進學習的評估方式。
完成本課程後，參加者將能夠：
1. 展示對全球學校體育發展的理解；
2. 辨析學校體育的優勢與不足；
3. 制定並試行課程計劃，應用另類課程及教學模式，透過體育促進學生在認知、社交、動作技能及文化層面的學習；
4. 評估在香港學校體育中推廣及實施各種創新教學模式的可行性；
5. 展現具備正向態度的專業教學實踐，並具備全球視野及多元文化觀；
6. 設計和應用科技與教學策略，以提升學校體育的學習、教學及評估，並培養學生在數字時代的慎思明辨與適應能力。
