en.objective: 本課程旨在為在職科學科教師提供有關數字教育工具在科學教育中的知識與應用，協助教師將多元化的數字教育工具融入實際課堂。學員將探討如何運用不同的數字教育工具如人工智能、感應器、數據記錄器、實驗模擬器、擴增／虛擬實境（AR/VR）等科技於科學科課堂內。透過分析科學科課程要求及了解香港數字教育藍圖後，比較傳統教案與數字增強型教案的差異，探討如何將四種學習行為：被動、主動、建構及互動，應用於數字教育情境內。

1. 把人工智能(AI)工具、STEAM教育及音樂科技有效融入校本音樂課程設計；

3. 制定合適的學習評估策略，以優化音樂教學質素；以及
4. 提升音樂素養，並加強在綵排指導、流行音樂編曲及作曲等技巧上的能力。

en.objective:
本課程旨在讓小學教師能夠：
1. 比較不同地區在推動價值觀教育方面的經驗，以拓展視野；
2. 協助學校規劃和實施校本的價值觀教育；
3. 以小學生不同成長階段的成長及發展特質作為基礎，探索多元化的價值觀教育教學策略和檢視方法，並了解其效益；
4. 通過參與專業對話，促進課程規劃和教學實踐的交流和反思，加強教師推動價值觀教育的能力；
5. 明白和體會教師的育人角色，秉持高尚道德標準，言行得體，樹立榜樣，向學生灌輸正確的價值觀和積極的態度。

en.objective:
本課程旨在使參與者全面了解人工智能（AI）在中學數學教學中的核心原理與應用，包括有效運用ChatGPT、Grok、DeepSeek、Cosmos和Tableau等AI工具，教授數學關鍵主題如數與代數、度量、圖形與空間、數據處理及數學建模（適用於中一至中六學生）。此課程幫助設計具吸引力和互動性的課堂活動，滿足不同學生的需求，促進個性化和積極的學習環境。完成此課程後，教師將能：
1. 了解AI的基本概念及其在提升中學數學教學中的應用；
2. 展示整合AI工具促進複雜數學主題教學的實踐能力；
3. 設計以AI為支援的個性化教學活動和評估，以增進學生的數學理解與思維能力，同時確保學生不會過度依賴AI，從而培養其獨立的數學思考技能；
4. 批判性評估與AI相關的倫理和實務問題，並探索未來的創新應用。

en.contentArea: - 科目知識及教學法/學與教(與工作有關)

en.objective:
This programme aims at upgrading teachers’ knowledge and skills in the teaching of English at both the primary and secondary levels. It will focus on areas of English language knowledge and skills relevant to the current needs of teachers in the local school sector with particular emphasis on the teachers’ capabilities to support students with reading difficulties through various strategies, including the use of emerging technologies.
Upon completion of the programme, participants should be able to:
Content Objectives
• Demonstrate an understanding of the nature and causes of reading difficulties, as well as current knowledge of essential components of effective language teaching and specific teaching approaches, techniques and strategies for meeting the needs of learners with reading difficulties;
• Reflect on current practices in Hong Kong schools and apply what they have learned to design language learning and teaching activities that suit the needs of all language learners, especially students with reading difficulties;
• Evaluate peers’ teaching plans and give suitable recommendations to show an awareness of considerations for creating supportive learning conditions for learners with reading difficulties in the regular language classroom.
Pedagogical Objectives
• Demonstrate enhanced skills in teaching English to Hong Kong primary and secondary students.

en.objective:
The programme aims at enriching/updating teachers’ knowledge and skills in the teaching of English at the primary level. It will focus on areas of English language knowledge and skills relevant to the current needs of teachers in the local school sector with particular emphasis on enhancing teachers’ capacity to help students develop reading skills and implement Reading across the Curriculum (RaC).
Upon completion of the programme, participants will be able to:
Content Objectives
• Demonstrate an enhanced understanding of effective strategies for implementing RaC;
• Demonstrate an enhanced understanding of the roles of English teachers and the collaboration with teachers of other KLAs in implementing RaC;
• Demonstrate an understanding of curriculum planning, learning activities and materials design, and supporting students in developing reading skills.
Pedagogical Objectives
• Demonstrate enhanced skills in teaching English to Hong Kong primary students through Reading across the Curriculum (RaC).

en.objective: 本課程旨在加深高中地理老師對香港地質和地貌的認識，並強化其教授相關課題的教學能力。透過實踐工作坊和實地海岸考察等體驗式學習活動，學員可以在課堂上觀察、量度、觸摸不同岩石和礦物標本，也可以利用簡易物理測試和化學實驗進行辨識及驗證，分辨不同的礦物和岩石，並了解它們在香港的分佈和形成過程。本課程以全天6小時的實地海岸考察作結，讓學員可以在考察現場應用所學，連繫理論與實踐，並反思如何將考察經驗轉化為有效的課堂教學。

en.objective:
完成此課程後，教師將能夠：
1. 掌握社會性科學議題之中如何幫助學生科學探究；
2. 分析社會性科學議題如何幫助學生分辨科學事實，以及釐清對科學事實的誤解或錯誤觀念，並提出具證據的論證；
3. 評析有關社會科學議題和科學實踐的教學計劃和材料的範例;
4. 提升發展學員理解科學實踐和社會科學議題理解的評估能力素養，包括深入地審視國際總結性評估 (例如，香港中學文憑考試生物學作文題，英國普通教育高級程度會考)。

en.objective:
This programme aims at enhancing teachers’ knowledge and skills in utilising emerging technologies in teaching English at both the primary and secondary levels, with special attention given to nurturing digital literacy and the ethical uses of technology. It will focus on areas of English language knowledge and skills relevant to the current needs of teachers in the local school sector, with emphasis on the implementation of recent updates in the English Language curriculum, including expectations related to digital education, media and information literacy and multimodal digital texts.
Upon completion of the programme, participants should be able to:

en.objective:
This programme is designed to help ESL/EFL teachers integrate artificial intelligence (AI) into their teaching to enhance English language teaching and digital literacy.
Upon completion of the programme, participants will be able to:
Content Objectives
1. Understand the role of AI in English language teaching.
2. Learn about AI tools and their applications in the English classroom.
Pedagogical Objectives
1. Implement AI-driven and innovative strategies to personalize English language learning and assessment.
2. Design effective English learning and teaching activities using AI tools, including lesson sequences, formative tasks and assessment tasks.
3. Use AI to enhance feedback and media and information literacy.
4. Select and use AI tools responsibly to address diverse student needs and foster whole-person development.
This programme equips teachers with the skills to effectively integrate AI into their teaching practices, fostering engagement and preparing students for a digital world.

zh.objective:
This programme is designed to help ESL/EFL teachers integrate artificial intelligence (AI) into their teaching to enhance English language teaching and digital literacy.
Upon completion of the programme, participants will be able to:
Content Objectives
1. Understand the role of AI in English language teaching.
2. Learn about AI tools and their applications in the English classroom.
Pedagogical Objectives
1. Implement AI-driven and innovative strategies to personalize English language learning and assessment.
2. Design effective English learning and teaching activities using AI tools, including lesson sequences, formative tasks and assessment tasks.
3. Use AI to enhance feedback and media and information literacy.
4. Select and use AI tools responsibly to address diverse student needs and foster whole-person development.
This programme equips teachers with the skills to effectively integrate AI into their teaching practices, fostering engagement and preparing students for a digital world.

en.objective: 本課程旨在為中學中國歷史科教師提供深化的專業發展支援。課程緊密配合《初中中國歷史科課程指引》及《高中中國歷史科優化課程框架》的需要，聚焦於「探究式學習」與「全方位學習」的實踐。透過本地歷史考察與數碼人文知識，協助教師設計具啟發性的學與教活動，以增潤「政治演變」、「文化特色」及「香港發展」等核心學習元素的教學。課程亦著重探討如何運用生成式人工智能輔助史料分析及進展性評估，從而提升學生研習歷史的技能，並培養對國家民族的認同感與歸屬感。

en.objective:
This programme equips teachers with essential knowledge of assessment in the English language curriculum and practical skills to design, implement, and evaluate assessment tools and strategies. Participants will also strengthen their ability to reflect on and improve their own assessment practices.
Teachers will learn to integrate AI tools into language testing and assessment, including the use of AI assisted feedback. The programme emphasises applying assessment for, of, and as learning to support diagnostic, formative, and summative assessment purposes.
Upon completion of the programme, participants will be able to:
Content Objectives
• Demonstrate an enhanced understanding of aspects of language assessment;
• Demonstrate an enhanced understanding of assessment for, of, and as learning;
• Demonstrate an understanding of how this enhanced knowledge is applicable to assessing language and content learning in the Hong Kong primary and secondary curricula.
Pedagogical Objectives
• Demonstrate enhanced skills in teaching English to Hong Kong primary and secondary students.
